### Controlled loading and failure recovery

Example source: src/button/__demos__/controlled-loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("buttonControlledLoadingInline");

import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const saving = ref(false);
const failing = ref(false);
const messageKey = ref<keyof typeof inlineCopy.value>("clickSaveToStart");
const message = computed(() => inlineCopy.value[messageKey.value]);
const delay = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800));
async function save() {
  if (saving.value) return;
  saving.value = true;
  try {
    await delay();
    messageKey.value = "saved";
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}
async function recover() {
  if (failing.value) return;
  failing.value = true;
  try {
    await delay();
    throw new Error(inlineCopy.value.simulatedFailure);
  } catch {
    messageKey.value = "simulatedFailure";
  } finally {
    failing.value = false;
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="12">
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.asyncClickHandlersOwnTheir }}</p>
    <c-space wrap :size="12">
      <c-button :loading="saving" @click="save">{{ inlineCopy.save }}</c-button>
      <c-button :loading="failing" @click="recover">{{
        inlineCopy.failureRecovery
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Icons and content follow reading order; stacked content remains top to bottom without mirroring custom graphics. ButtonGroup uses its direction for horizontal arrangement, joined borders and end radii; individual buttons may override text direction. Single buttons retain full radii, and vertical groups keep top-to-bottom order. Native Tab, Enter and Space remain available; ordinary groups do not intercept arrow keys. Disabled and loading behavior is unchanged.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Button Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| status | Semantic color; inherits group, otherwise default | `SemanticStatus`<br>`'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `undefined` |
| variant | Appearance; inherits from the button group when omitted, otherwise outline | `default / text / outline / tonal` | `undefined` |
| size | Size resolves from the button, then its group, then ConfigProvider, falling back to md | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl` | `undefined` |
| html-type | Native button type | `button / submit / reset` | `button` |
| component | Root tag; link attributes fall through | `button / a` | `button` |
| round | Round button | `boolean` | `false` |
| block | Full available width | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading | Loading; blocks activation and navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading-type | Spinner animation; same as Loading.type; not used in line mode | `circle / wave / cube / rect / disappear` | `circle` |
| loading-mode | Inline, covering, or bottom progress line; line only uses loading-color | `default / fill / line` | `default` |
| loading-size | Indicator size; xs/sm/md/lg/xl map to 12/14/16/18/20px; numbers are px; follows button size when omitted; not used in line mode | `ComponentSize / number`<br>`ComponentSize: 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `undefined` |
| loading-color | Loading indicator color | `string` | `currentColor` |
| disabled | Disabled; inherits group, explicit false overrides | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| ripple | Click ripple | `boolean` | `true` |
| focusable | Allow sequential Tab focus; does not prevent programmatic focus | `boolean` | `true` |
| autofocus | Native autofocus | `boolean` | `false` |
| text-color | Custom text color | `string` | `undefined` |
| color | Custom background or variant base color | `string` | `undefined` |
| elevation | Shadow for the default variant; true means 1, false disables it, and numbers are rounded and clamped to 0–24; controlled by the group when grouped | `boolean / number` | `false` |
| stacked | Stack icon and text; inherits group when omitted | `boolean` | `undefined` |

### Button Events

| Event | Arguments and behavior |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| click | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |

`click` is a notification event. The component does not process listener return values or switch loading automatically. Business code controls `loading` and should restore it in `finally` after asynchronous work. Disabled or loading links have their effective `href` removed.

### Button Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------- | -------------------------------- | ---- |
| default | Button label; retained while loading | — |
| icon | Leading icon; above label when stacked | — |

### Button Methods

No custom public methods.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

### ButtonGroup Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status | Default semantic status for child buttons; individual buttons may override it | `SemanticStatus`<br>`'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | default |
| size | Default child button size; individual buttons may override it | xs / sm / md / lg / xl | undefined |
| variant | Default child appearance; adjacent buttons join using their effective variants, including mixed variants | default / text / outline / tonal | outline |
| color | Default custom child color; individual buttons may override it | string | undefined |
| text-color | Default child text color; individual buttons may override it | string | undefined |
| disabled | Default disabled state; an explicit child false overrides group true | boolean | false |
| stacked | Stack child icon and text vertically by default; a child may explicitly override with false | boolean | false |
| vertical | Vertical group layout, independent of button content stacking | boolean | false |
| elevation | Shadow for the entire group; true means 1 and numbers are normalized to 0–24; applies only to the default variant when the group is enabled | boolean / number | false |

The root defaults to `role="group"`. Supply `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` when the action group needs a name. Native attributes can override role. Ordinary groups retain native Tab / Enter / Space handling without arrow-key focus management.

**Inheritance:** explicit child status, size, variant, color, text-color, disabled and stacked values take precedence. An omitted group size inherits ConfigProvider and ultimately falls back to md. The group always owns elevation; individual button elevation is ignored. Nested groups use their nearest group's configuration and defaults without automatically accumulating outer disabled state.

### ButtonGroup Events

No custom events. `@click` forwards a native root event and may receive descendant bubbling; listen to each Button's click for its action. The group does not collect event Promises or manage tasks or selection.

### ButtonGroup Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Joined styling supports directly adjacent Button DOM nodes under the group root | — |

**Composition:** extra DOM wrappers, surrounding text and other controls are outside the joined appearance contract. Wrapped buttons may inherit configuration but do not receive the same joined styling. The group owns outer radii and does not preserve a standalone round button's circular appearance. Use Space for separate buttons or mixed content. In narrow areas, business code chooses scrolling, shorter labels or vertical layout; groups do not wrap automatically.

### ButtonGroup Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| buttonGroupProvider | Reactive group configuration with readonly ComputedRef fields; elevation is boolean / number and other fields match the Props |

No additional group action methods.

## Types

ButtonProps、ButtonVariant、ButtonLoadingMode、ButtonInstance、ButtonGroupProps、ButtonGroupInstance。

## CSS Variables

Button exposes 58 appearance tokens. `{status}-color` controls the solid background, `{status}-foreground-color` controls text/outline/tonal foreground, and `{status}-tonal-color` controls soft backgrounds. `solid-text-color` and `solid-state-layer-color` are shared by semantic statuses; default/tertiary foregrounds and primary/tertiary state layers retain theme-specific roles.

Sizes use xs/sm/md/lg/xl. Font sizes, transition duration, focus width/offset and stacked-height increments reuse system variables. Button groups and stacked buttons share border-radius. Four state opacity variables preserve hover/active differences. loading-duration controls only the bottom progress line; Loading controls other loading animations. Internal variables and fixed animation geometry are not public customization points.

<!-- Source: src/calendar/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/calendar/ -->

# Calendar

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

`allow-select=false` blocks date selection and disables the Today button. Previous and next navigation remain available without changing the selected value.

`day-start-of-week`, `is-week` and `modes` update reactively. With controlled `mode`, the built-in switch emits `update:mode` and the parent decides whether to accept it; `default-mode` only initializes uncontrolled mode.

`panel` uses compact views: the year view shows month choices and the month view shows compact dates. `panel-width` sets a reactive width in pixels; `panel-today-btn` shows a footer Today button, whose selection respects `allow-select`.

Use Tab to enter the date area, arrow keys to move focus, and Enter or Space to select. Moving focus does not change the selection. The compact year panel moves by month; browsing remains available when selection is disabled.

The default slot receives `year`, `month`, and `date` for dates in month and full year views. The compact year panel displays month choices and does not render date slots. Selecting a date or Today emits `change`, `update:modelValue`, and `panel-change`; navigating pages or changing the displayed year or month emits `panel-change`. A controlled mode switch emits `update:mode`.

When the timestamp of controlled `model-value` changes, the view moves to that date. Browsing or passing the same timestamp again does not reset the view. External updates do not emit an additional `panel-change`.

## Interaction and customization

### Controlled

Example source: src/calendar/__demos__/controlled.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space wrap>
    <c-button @click="selectToday">{{ demoCopy.today }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="selectTomorrow">{{ demoCopy.tomorrow }}</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <c-calendar
    v-model="value"
    class="calendar-demo"
    @change="record('selected', $event)"
    @panel-change="record('panel', $event)"
  />
  <c-alert status="info">{{ lastAction }}</c-alert>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { useDemoLocale, formatDemoDate } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, ref } from "vue";

const value = ref(new Date());
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("calendarControlled");
const action = ref<"selected" | "panel" | "external">();
const actionDate = ref(new Date());
const lastAction = computed(() =>
  action.value
    ? `${demoCopy.value[action.value]} ${action.value === "panel" ? formatMonth(actionDate.value) : format(actionDate.value)}`
    : demoCopy.value.hint,
);
function record(kind: "selected" | "panel" | "external", date: Date) {
  action.value = kind;
  actionDate.value = date;
}
const format = (date: Date) => formatDemoDate(date);
const formatMonth = (date: Date) =>
  formatDemoDate(date, { year: "numeric", month: "long" });
function selectToday() {
  value.value = new Date();
  record("external", value.value);
}
function selectTomorrow() {
  const tomorrow = new Date();
  tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
  value.value = tomorrow;
  record("external", value.value);
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.calendar-demo {
  margin: 12px 0;
}
</style>
```

### Custom Cell

Example source: src/calendar/__demos__/custom-cell.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-calendar v-model="value">
    <template #default="{ year, month, date }">
      <div v-if="items[key(year, month, date)]" class="cell-items">
        <span
          v-for="item in items[key(year, month, date)]"
          :key="item.label"
          class="cell-item"
          :style="{ '--item-color': item.color }"
          >{{ item.label }}</span
        >
      </div>
    </template>
  </c-calendar>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref(new Date());
const today = new Date();
const key = (year: number, month: number, date: number) =>
  `${year}-${month}-${date}`;
const relativeKey = (offset: number) => {
  const date = new Date(today);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + offset);
  return key(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth() + 1, date.getDate());
};
const items: Record<string, Array<{ label: string; color: string }>> = {
  [relativeKey(0)]: [
    { label: "产品评审", color: "rgb(var(--c-primary-6))" },
    { label: "版本发布", color: "rgb(var(--c-success-6))" },
  ],
  [relativeKey(2)]: [{ label: "客户回访", color: "rgb(var(--c-warning-6))" }],
  [relativeKey(5)]: [{ label: "团队周会", color: "rgb(var(--c-purple-6))" }],
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.cell-items {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.cell-item {
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--c-color-text-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cell-item::before {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  margin-right: 6px;
  background: var(--item-color);
  border-radius: 50%;
  content: "";
}
</style>
```

## API

### Calendar Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------- | :-----------------: |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value | `date` | `-` |
| default-value | Default value (uncontrolled state) | `date` | `-` |
| allow-select | Whether date selection is allowed | `boolean` | `true` |
| panel | Whether to use the compact panel | `boolean` | `false` |
| panel-width | Compact panel width in pixels | `number` | `undefined` |
| panel-today-btn | Whether to show the panel footer Today button | `boolean` | `false` |
| mode | Mode | `'month' \| 'year'` | `-` |
| default-mode | Default Mode | `'month' \| 'year'` | `'month'` |
| modes | Displayed mode | `('month' \| 'year')[]` | `['month', 'year']` |
| day-start-of-week | First day of the week | `0 \| 1` | `0` |
| is-week | Whether to show week numbers | `boolean` | `false` |

### Calendar Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | -------------------- | ------------ |
| change | Emitted when the selected date changes | date: `Date` |
| update:mode | Request a display mode change | mode: `'month' \| 'year'` |
| panel-change | Emitted when the displayed date panel changes | date: `Date` |

### Calendar Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop | Version |
| ------- | :--------------: | --------------------------------------------------- | :----- |
| header | Custom header content | year: `number`<br>month: `number` | 2.53.0 |
| default | Custom cell content | year: `number`<br>month: `number`<br>date: `number` | 2.53.0 |

```css
  --c-calendar-border-color: var(--c-color-neutral-3);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

# Card

Source changes synchronously invalidate render generations. Close, row direction, newer work, deactivation or disposal prevent old nextTick/timer/double-frame continuations from changing newer phases. Render/timer deliveries consume once. Recheck lifecycle/request/node after geometry hooks to reject reentrant disposal. Suspension cancels both timers and retained close/click input is inert; activation starts a fresh phase from current props without replay, and initial KeepAlive activation does not duplicate the wait.

Example source: src/card/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("comparison");
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "default", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from "vue";
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: "variant", values: ["default", "outline", "tonal"] },
  { name: "size", values: ["sm", "md"] },
];
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant");
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () =>
    demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)
      ?.values ?? [],
);

__demoAppearance["elevation"] = 2;
demoCompareFields.push({ name: "elevation", values: [0, 2, 6] });
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'tonal', value: 'tonal' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="elevation"
        ><c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['elevation']"
          aria-label="elevation"
          :options="[
            { label: '0', value: 0 },
            { label: '2', value: 2 },
            { label: '6', value: 6 },
          ]"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">{{ demoCopy.hint }}</p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      :aria-label="demoCopy.configuration"
      :options="
        demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({
          label: field.name,
          value: field.name,
        }))
      "
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <c-card
          title="Project overview"
          description="Keep the team informed."
          v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
        />
      </section>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>

  max-width: 100%;
}
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Floating scheduler lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `floating` | Floating expansion state; supports v-model:floating | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `ripple` | Click ripple | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `floating-duration` | Floating expansion transition duration in ms | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `title` | Title | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/card/__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("cardSchedulerLifecycleInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const floating = ref(false);
const ripple = ref(true);
const duration = ref(250);
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="floating = !floating">{{ inlineCopy.float }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">{{ inlineCopy.activate }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">{{ inlineCopy.mount }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="ripple = !ripple">{{ inlineCopy.rippleWait }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="duration = duration ? 0 : 250">{{
      inlineCopy.duration
    }}</c-button>
    <p>
      Toggle floating rapidly, suspend during500ms ripple wait or layout
      settlement, then activate. Old tasks must not reset a newer phase.
      Underlying doubleRaf frames are not physically canceled.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-card
        v-if="active"
        v-model:floating="floating"
        :ripple="ripple"
        :floating-duration="duration"
        :title="inlineCopy.floatingLifecycle"
      >
        {{ inlineCopy.cardContent }}
        <template #floating-content>
          <c-button @click.stop="floating = false">{{
            inlineCopy.collapse
          }}</c-button>
          <c-button @click.stop="active = false">{{
            inlineCopy.deactivate
          }}</c-button>
          <c-button @click.stop="mounted = false">{{
            inlineCopy.unmount
          }}</c-button>
        </template>
      </c-card>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

The same scenarios, parameters and interactions as Cedar. Only component prefixes differ; themes and site shells remain independent.

## Reading direction

Title, content and actions follow reading order. Default floating actions sit at inline end; images and custom slots are not mirrored.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

`row-reverse` reverses the horizontal cover and body order, with reading direction still following the container. Collapsed `floating-content` keeps its nodes and state but is inert to keyboard and assistive technology; it becomes interactive when expanded. Floating is available only in column direction.

The floating layer remains at the Card’s original DOM location. An ancestor’s transform or similar property may change the fixed-position containing block, and ancestor clipping may obscure the layer, so viewport coverage is not guaranteed. When focus is inside an expanded Card, Escape requests closing unless an inner control has already handled the key; a nested topmost popup handles Escape first. The layer does not provide modal focus management; use Dialog when modal interaction is required.

When focus is in a native dialog opened with `showModal()`, Escape goes to the dialog. A `cancel` handler can keep the dialog open, and the Card stays expanded.

When focus remains inside the expanded content or on the close button, closing attempts to return focus to the control used before expansion. If focus has moved elsewhere, it is not moved back. During the expansion delay, focusing the expanded content displays it immediately without waiting for the fade-in animation. Expanded content and the close button that are still hidden and unfocused during this delay are excluded from the accessibility tree; focusing either displays them immediately.

If the opener is inside an external closed Shadow Root, Card cannot access the internal control directly. The host must delegate focus or the application must restore focus. `delegatesFocus` can forward host focus into the root, but does not guarantee the original control when several controls are present.

The default close button uses the current locale's close label; override it with `close-button-aria-label`. `floating-duration` is a finite nonnegative number of milliseconds; 0 disables the delay and invalid values fall back to 250. With reduced motion enabled, opening and closing do not wait for ripple or transition animations; changing the preference during an animation also takes effect.

### Card Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | Appearance | `default / outline / tonal` | `outline` |
| size | Density; omitted value follows platform rules below | `sm / md` | `undefined` |
| direction | Order of cover and body, default column; supports row, column and row-reverse. Does not position the card itself | `row / column / row-reverse` | `column` |
| hoverable | Hover styling | `boolean` | `false` |
| title-style | Title row styles | `CSSProperties` | `undefined` |
| title | Title | `string` | `undefined` |
| subtitle | Subtitle | `string` | `undefined` |
| description | Description | `string` | `undefined` |
| top-divider | Top divider | `boolean` | `false` |
| bottom-divider | Bottom divider | `boolean` | `false` |
| image-src | Cover image URL; cover slot takes precedence | `string` | `undefined` |
| image-fit | Cover image fit | `fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down` | `cover` |
| image-height | Image height; numbers use px | `string / number` | `undefined` |
| image-width | Image width; numbers use px | `string / number` | `undefined` |
| image-alt | Image alternative text | `string` | `undefined` |
| elevation | Shadow for default variant; true means level 1, false disables it, numeric levels 0–24 | `boolean / number` | `0` |
| ripple | Click ripple | `boolean` | `false` |
| floating | Floating expansion state; supports v-model:floating | `boolean` | `false` |
| floating-duration | Floating expansion transition duration in ms | `number` | `250` |
| close-button-aria-label | Accessible name of the default close button | `string` | `—` |

### Card Events

| Event | Arguments and timing |
| --- | --- |
| click | `(event: Event)`, emitted when the card is clicked |
| update:floating | `(value: boolean)`, emits false when the built-in close button or Escape requests closing; expansion is controlled by the parent |

### Card Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Body | — |
| cover | Cover content; overrides the image-src image | — |
| header | Entire header; overrides title, title-action and subtitle | — |
| title | Title | `{ slotClass: string }` |
| title-action | Title action | — |
| subtitle | Subtitle | `{ slotClass: string }` |
| description | Description | `{ slotClass: string }` |
| footer | Footer actions | — |
| floating-content | Expanded content; column layout only | — |
| close-button | Custom close button; update floating yourself | — |

### Card Methods

No public methods.

### Usage notes

Props, event arguments and slots match. Cedar inherits the global size when size is omitted: xs/sm map to sm, all others to md. Maple falls back to md. Pass size explicitly for identical density. Themes and CSS prefixes remain platform-specific.
Use the Loading directive to compose a loading overlay on Card.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { CardProps } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```

Only the documented size presets are supported, rather than every ComponentSize value.

## CSS Variables

Regular/filled backgrounds and borders use `surface-default`, `surface-muted` and `border-default`. Titles, body and secondary text use `content-primary`, `content-tertiary` and `content-secondary`. Expanded floating buttons use `content-primary`; text and icons on dark close buttons use `content-on-dark`.

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-card-background: var(--c-sys-color-surface-default);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

### Sizing and motion

Use `--c-card-content-row-margin` for horizontal content spacing. Card supports only sm / md sizes. `--c-card-animation-duration` defaults to `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-slow)` and `--c-card-animation-easing` to `var(--c-sys-motion-easing-standard)`. Reduced motion disables Card transitions.

## Direction and layout

### Vertical

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slides-per-view` | Visible count; auto uses item size | Multi Slides, Centered Slides, Auto Sized |
| `space-between` | Item gap; numbers/numeric strings are px | Multi Slides, Centered Slides, Auto Sized |
| `draggable` | Mouse dragging, independent of touch | Multi Slides, Auto Sized |
| `centered-slides` | Center active slide | centered-slides、auto-sized |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical axis of carousel sliding, default horizontal; does not determine indicator position | Vertical |
| `model-value` | Controlled one-based slide number | Multi Slides |

### Multi Slides

Preview configuration: `:slides-per-view="2.5"`, `:space-between="10"`, `:model-value="current"`, `:loop="loop"`.

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/multi-slides.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("carouselMultiSlidesInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const current = ref(1);
const proposal = ref(1);
const changes = ref(0);
const accept = ref(true);
const loop = ref(true);
function update(value) {
  proposal.value = value;
  if (accept.value) current.value = value;
}
</script>

<template>
  <section class="multi-slides-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="accept"> {{ inlineCopy.acceptChanges }}</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="loop"> {{ inlineCopy.loop }}</c-checkbox>
    <p role="status">
      Current: {{ current }} · Proposal: {{ proposal }} · Changes: {{ changes }}
    </p>
    <c-carousel
      :slides-per-view="2.5"
      :space-between="10"
      :style="{ width: '600px', height: '200px' }"
      :model-value="current"
      :loop="loop"
      draggable
      keyboard
      @update:modelValue="update"
      @change="changes++"
    >
      <c-carousel-item v-for="i in 6" :key="i">
        <div
          style="
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: #4a90d9;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: bold;
          "
        >
          {{ i }}
        </div>
      </c-carousel-item>
    </c-carousel>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Auto Sized

- `height`: Constrains the component height.

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/auto-sized.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("carouselAutoSizedInline");

import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const current = ref(1);
const changes = ref(0);
const wider = ref(false);
const compact = ref(false);
const extra = ref(false);
const empty = ref(false);
const reversed = ref(false);
const widths = computed(() => {
  const items = empty.value
    ? []
    : [140, 220, 180, 260, ...(extra.value ? [200] : [])];
  return (reversed.value ? items.reverse() : items).map(
    (width) => width + (wider.value ? 80 : 0),
  );
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="auto-sized-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="wider"> {{ inlineCopy.widerCards }}</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="compact">
      {{ inlineCopy.text300pxViewport }}</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="extra"> {{ inlineCopy.extraCard }}</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="empty"> {{ inlineCopy.empty }}</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="reversed"> {{ inlineCopy.reverseCards }}</c-checkbox>
    <p role="status">Current: {{ current }} · Changes: {{ changes }}</p>
    <c-carousel
      v-model="current"
      slides-per-view="auto"
      :space-between="12"
      :style="{ width: compact ? '300px' : '100%' }"
      height="180px"
      centered-slides
      draggable
      @change="changes++"
    >
      <c-carousel-item
        v-for="width in widths"
        :key="width"
        :style="{ width: width + 'px' }"
      >
        <div class="carousel-demo-panel">{{ width }}px</div>
      </c-carousel-item>
    </c-carousel>
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.carousel-demo-panel {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  background: #e0e7ff;
  color: #312e81;
}
</style>
```

### Indicator style and position

All indicator presets use the same three local slides and active-slide model. Click an indicator or a navigation arrow in any specimen: every specimen changes to the same slide. The first group compares dot, line and slider; the second compares top and outer positions. The grid stacks on narrow screens.

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/indicator-comparison.vue


```vue
<template>
  <c-carousel :style="{ width: '600px', height: '240px' }">
    <c-carousel-item
      ><img
        src="/cat.jpg"
        style="
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: cover;
          pointer-events: none;
        "
    /></c-carousel-item>
    <c-carousel-item
      ><img
        src="/cat2.jpg"
        style="
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: cover;
          pointer-events: none;
        "
    /></c-carousel-item>
    <c-carousel-item
      ><img
        src="/cat3.jpg"
        style="
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: cover;
          pointer-events: none;
        "
    /></c-carousel-item>
    <template #indicator="{ slideNumber, length, to }">
      <div
        style="
          position: absolute;
          bottom: 10px;
          left: 50%;
          transform: translateX(-50%);
          display: flex;
          gap: 4px;
        "
      >
        <c-button
          v-for="i in length"
          :key="i"
          size="xs"
          round
          :variant="i === slideNumber ? 'default' : 'tonal'"
          :status="i === slideNumber ? 'primary' : 'default'"
          :aria-label="`跳转至第 ${i} 页`"
          @click="to(i)"
          >{{ i }}</c-button
        >
      </div>
    </template>
  </c-carousel>
</template>
```

### Autoplay

- `height`: Constrains the component height.

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/autoplay.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
const current = ref(1);
const playing = ref(true);
const changes = ref(0);
const sources = ["/cat.jpg", "/cat2.jpg", "/cat3.jpg"];
</script>

<template>
  <section class="carousel-autoplay-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="playing"> 自动播放</c-checkbox>
    <p role="status">当前页：{{ current }}；切换次数：{{ changes }}</p>
    <c-carousel
      v-model="current"
      height="180px"
      :auto-play="playing ? 2000 : false"
      @focusin="playing = false"
      @change="changes += 1"
    >
      <c-carousel-item v-for="(source, index) in sources" :key="source">
        <img
          class="carousel-autoplay-demo__image"
          :src="source"
          :alt="'示例图片 ' + (index + 1)"
        />
      </c-carousel-item>
    </c-carousel>
  </section>
</template>

.carousel-autoplay-demo__image {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
```

### Controlled

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/controlled.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("carouselControlledInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const current = ref(1);
const accept = ref(true);
const proposal = ref(1);
function update(value) {
  proposal.value = value;
  if (accept.value) current.value = value;
}
</script>
<template>

    draggable

  >

      ><div class="carousel-demo-panel">Slide {{ item }}</div></c-carousel-item
    >
  </c-carousel>
```

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("carouselSchedulerLifecycleInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const current = ref(1);
const playing = ref(false);
const moves = ref(0);
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="playing = !playing">{{ inlineCopy.autoplay }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">{{ inlineCopy.activate }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">{{ inlineCopy.mount }}</c-button>
    <p>
      {{ inlineCopy.current }} {{ current }}{{ inlineCopy.changes }}
      {{ moves }}. Suspend during autoplay or loop settlement, then activate.
      Old work must not replay.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-carousel
        v-if="active"
        v-model="current"
        :auto-play="playing ? { interval: 1000 } : false"
        :move-speed="600"
        :height="180"
        keyboard
        mousewheel
        @change="moves++"
      >
        <c-carousel-item v-for="item in 3" :key="item"
          >{{ inlineCopy.slide }} {{ item }}</c-carousel-item
        >
      </c-carousel>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Looping and autoplay

Each slide always has one component instance. Ordinary previous/next navigation recycles positions after the departing slide exits. Multi-slide or centered jumps that would require one slide in two positions settle immediately without animation, cloning interactive content or queuing unlimited transitions. Fewer items than visible slides are not cloned to fill space. Accessible names follow global Locale; explicit label props take precedence.

Native root listeners such as `keydown`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin` and `focusout` run alongside internal navigation and autoplay pause handling. Native `.once` listeners fire once for the root element lifetime.

`space-between` also accepts valid CSS lengths such as percentages and `calc()`. Multi-slide layout uses unscaled CSS pixels, so ancestor scaling does not change the gap-to-slide proportion.

If a focused slide becomes inaccessible through navigation or removal, focus moves to the carousel container. Focus in a still-visible slide or outside the carousel is preserved. The container is programmatically focusable but is not in the Tab order unless `keyboard` is enabled; an explicit `tabindex` remains under caller control.

The autoplay example sets `auto-play=false` on focus entry and provides an external switch for an explicit restart. The component itself only pauses temporarily while focus is inside; playback resumes on blur. This differs from the WAI-ARIA APG recommendation to stop on focus until the user explicitly restarts, and is not a claim of full APG conformance; applications requiring that behavior should control playback state. Reduced motion disables transitions but does not by itself stop automatic navigation.

Slide numbers start at 1; finite fractions are truncated toward zero and then wrapped or clamped according to `loop`. Finite `move-speed` values use non-negative milliseconds; non-finite values use the CSS transition duration. The root is a named region and default indicator buttons have localized slide names and current state; their container has no separate group name. `line` and `slider` share the same default bar dimensions; `slider` can grow into available container space and is not draggable.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the current slide number, starting at 1. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state only on creation; later changes do not reset it. An explicit bound value takes precedence. Initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`.

### Carousel Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model-value` | Controlled one-based slide number | `number` | `undefined` |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial index | `number` | `1` |
| `loop` | Loop without duplicating instances | `boolean` | `true` |
| `auto-play` | Autoplay configuration | `boolean \| number \| CarouselAutoPlayConfig` | `false` |
| `move-speed` | Explicit duration in milliseconds | `number` | `undefined (token)` |
| `trigger` | Indicator trigger | `click \| hover` | `click` |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical axis of carousel sliding, default horizontal; does not determine indicator position | `horizontal \| vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `show-arrow` | Arrow visibility | `always \| hover \| never` | `always` |
| `arrow-class` | Additional arrow class | `string` | `undefined` |
| `indicator` | Show indicators | `boolean` | `true` |
| `indicator-type` | Indicator appearance | `dot \| line \| slider` | `dot` |
| `indicator-position` | Indicator edge or outer region of the carousel container, default bottom. Not a trigger-relative popup placement | `bottom \| top \| left \| right \| outer` | `bottom` |
| `indicator-class` | Additional indicator class | `string` | `undefined` |
| `indicator-color` | Custom indicator background | `string` | `undefined` |
| `height` | Container height; numbers are px | `number \| string` | `undefined` |
| `transition-timing-function` | Explicit timing function | `string` | `undefined (token)` |
| `touchable` | Touch dragging | `boolean` | `true` |
| `draggable` | Mouse dragging, independent of touch | `boolean` | `false` |
| `mousewheel` | Wheel navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `keyboard` | Scoped arrow/Home/End navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `slides-per-view` | Visible count; auto uses item size | `number \| auto` | `1` |
| `space-between` | Item gap; numbers/numeric strings are px | `number \| string` | `0` |
| `effect` | Effect; all supported by both libraries | `slide \| fade \| card` | `slide` |
| `centered-slides` | Center active slide | `boolean` | `false` |
| `aria-label` | Carousel accessible name | `string` | Locale |
| `previous-button-aria-label` | Previous button accessible name | `string` | Locale |
| `next-button-aria-label` | Next button accessible name | `string` | Locale |

### Model and interaction
Public slide numbers start at 1. Controlled actions emit update:model-value, then change(slideNumber, previousSlideNumber, isManual), and do not move until the parent accepts current. External assignments do not emit change. Method option event:false suppresses only change, not the model proposal. isManual is true for user actions and false for autoplay.

loop moves existing children across boundaries without cloning component instances. Without looping or centering, the final viewport is clamped to avoid empty space; selection can move within the final visible group without moving the track. Partly visible slides remain accessible; fully offscreen slides are inert. fade displays one slide. auto uses explicit CarouselItem width horizontally or height vertically; vertical mode requires a container height. Only CarouselItem children, including those inside Vue Fragments, count as slides; comments and ordinary elements do not.

auto-play=true uses 3000ms and pauses on hover; a number sets milliseconds without hover pausing; an object configures interval/hoverToPause. Focus within, dragging, hidden documents/ancestors and KeepAlive deactivation always pause playback. Reduced-motion preferences are respected. Interactive children such as inputs/buttons keep native behavior; mark custom interactive areas with data-carousel-no-drag. show-arrow=hover also shows arrows on keyboard focus.

### Carousel Events
| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| update:model-value | slideNumber: number |
| change | slideNumber: number, previousSlideNumber: number, isManual: boolean |

### Carousel Slots
| Slot | Prop |
| --- | --- |
| default | CarouselItem |
| prev / next / indicator | { slideNumber, length, hovering, prev, next, to, resize } |

### Carousel Methods
| Method | Signature |
| --- | --- |
| prev / next | (options?: CarouselToOptions) => void |
| to | (slideNumber: number, options?: CarouselToOptions) => void |
| resize | () => void |

CarouselItem has no own props, events or methods. Its default slot supplies slide content.

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-carousel-arrow-background: rgb(0 0 0 / 35%);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

# Cascader

Hierarchical option selection with single, multiple and path models.

When cascading multiple selections, toggling a parent affects only selectable descendants; already selected disabled descendants are retained.

```ts
import type { CascaderProps, CascaderInstance } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes null unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In confirmation mode, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model. Without confirmation, clearing commits directly.

The candidate `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. Components own loading, cancellation and stale results, and emit load-error on failure. Choice groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields load when queries change. Root tree loaders remain independent of existing load-more child loading.

## Reading direction

Inherits source dir. Child columns, expansion icons and separators follow reading direction. Horizontal keys enter loaded children or return to the parent in the visible direction, skipping disabled children; vertical keys retain logical order. Search preserves native horizontal caret editing. Path and multiple-value arrays are not reversed. Clearing the last value while closed resets navigation before reopening.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/cascader/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-cascader v-model="value" :options="options" placeholder="请选择地区" />
    <p role="status">当前值：{{ value ?? '未选择' }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { CascaderProps } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'

const value = ref<CascaderProps['modelValue']>()

const options = [
  {
    value: 'beijing',
    label: 'Beijing',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'chaoyang',
        label: 'ChaoYang',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'datunli',
            label: 'Datunli',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        value: 'haidian',
        label: 'Haidian',
      },
      {
        value: 'dongcheng',
        label: 'Dongcheng',
      },
      {
        value: 'xicheng',
        label: 'Xicheng',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'jinrongjie',
            label: 'Jinrongjie',
          },
          {
            value: 'tianqiao',
            label: 'Tianqiao',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: 'shanghai',
    label: 'Shanghai',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'huangpu',
        label: 'Huangpu',
      },
    ],
  },
]
</script>
```

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ |
| `options` | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches | Appearance configuration comparison, Control Sizes |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections | Appearance configuration comparison, Control Sizes |
| `size` | Supports all five sizes; inherits group/form settings | Control Sizes |
| `variant` | filled, outline, standard; inherits InputGroup | Control Sizes |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Control Sizes |
| `multiple` | Multiple selection; enables search by default | Control Sizes |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Choose an axis to compare its available values with the same content and model. Other settings remain unchanged while comparing.

Example source: src/cascader/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("comparison");
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("shanghai");
const options = [
  {
    label: "华东",
    value: "east",
    children: [
      { label: "上海", value: "shanghai" },
      { label: "杭州", value: "hangzhou" },
    ],
  },
];
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "filled", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from "vue";
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: "variant", values: ["filled", "outline", "standard"] },
  { name: "size", values: ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] },
];
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant");
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () =>
    demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)
      ?.values ?? [],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'filled', value: 'filled' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">{{ demoCopy.hint }}</p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      :aria-label="demoCopy.configuration"
      :options="
        demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({
          label: field.name,
          value: field.name,
        }))
      "
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <c-cascader
          v-model="value"
          :options="options"
          clearable
          v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
        ></c-cascader>
      </section>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo-config-comparison {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.demo-config-comparison > section {
  min-width: 0;
}
.demo-config-comparison p {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}
</style>
```

### Control Sizes

- `size`: The size of the select
- `variant`: Selects the visual variant.
- `options`: Options for cascader
- `placeholder`: Placeholder

Example source: src/field-decorator/__demos__/control-sizes.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("fieldDecoratorControlSizesInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const sizes = ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] as const;
const variants = ["outline", "filled", "standard"] as const;
const size = ref<(typeof sizes)[number]>("md");
const variant = ref<(typeof variants)[number]>("outline");
const options = [
  { value: "beijing", label: "Beijing" },
  { value: "shanghai", label: "Shanghai" },
];
const cascaderOptions = [{ value: "china", label: "China", children: options }];

const inputValue = ref("Beijing");
const selectValue = ref("beijing");
const cascaderValue = ref("beijing");
const selectMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectedOptions = [
  ...options,
  {
    value: "long",
    label:
      "A very long selected option label for overflow comparison — full text preview keeps the selected value unchanged.",
  },
];
const selectedCascaderOptions = [
  { value: "china", label: "China", children: selectedOptions },
];
function resetSelections() {
  inputValue.value = "Beijing";
  selectValue.value = "beijing";
  cascaderValue.value = "beijing";
  selectMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  selectOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
}
</script>
<template>
  <section
    aria-label="Form control size comparison"
    class="control-size-comparison"
  >
    <c-space wrap :size="12">
      <c-radio-group v-model="size" aria-label="Comparison size">

          item
        }}</c-radio>
      </c-radio-group>
      <c-radio-group v-model="variant" aria-label="Comparison variant">
        <c-radio v-for="item in variants" :key="item" :value="item">{{
          item
        }}</c-radio>
      </c-radio-group>
    </c-space>
    <div class="control-size-comparison__grid">
      <div data-control="Input">
        <p>Input</p>
        <c-input :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Input" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Button">
        <p>Button</p>
        <c-button :size="size" variant="outline">Button</c-button>
      </div>
      <div data-control="Select">
        <p>Select</p>
        <c-select
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="options"
          placeholder="Select"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Date">
        <p>Date</p>
        <c-date :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Date" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Time">
        <p>Time</p>
        <c-time :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Time" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="InputNumber">
        <p>InputNumber</p>
        <c-input-number :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Number" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="AutoComplete">
        <p>AutoComplete</p>
        <c-auto-complete
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="options"
          placeholder="AutoComplete"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Cascader">
        <p>Cascader</p>
        <c-cascader
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="cascaderOptions"
          placeholder="Cascader"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="DateRange">
        <p>DateRange</p>
        <c-date-range
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :placeholder="['Start', 'End']"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="TimeRange">
        <p>TimeRange</p>
        <c-time-range
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :placeholder="['Start', 'End']"
        />
      </div>
    </div>

    <section
      aria-label="Selected control size comparison"
      class="control-size-comparison__states"
    >
      <c-space wrap align="center" :size="12">
        <span>Selected / Clearable / Multiple — 有值、可清空与多选不换行</span>
        <span>{{ inlineCopy.hoverOrFocusTruncatedText }}</span>
        <c-button size="sm" variant="outline" @click="resetSelections">{{
          inlineCopy.reset
        }}</c-button>
      </c-space>
      <div class="control-size-comparison__grid">
        <div data-control="InputValue">
          <p>Input · clearable</p>
          <c-input
            v-model="inputValue"
            :size="size"
            :variant="variant"
            clearable
            placeholder="Input value"
          />
        </div>
        <div data-control="ButtonReference">
          <p>Button · reference</p>
          <c-button :size="size" variant="outline">Button</c-button>
        </div>
```

## Selection modes and paths

### Multiple

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- |
| `options` | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches | Multiple, Check Strictly, Path Mode |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Multiple, Check Strictly, Path Mode |
| `multiple` | Multiple selection; enables search by default | Multiple, Check Strictly |
| `default-value` | Default value (uncontrolled state) | Check Strictly, Path Mode |
| `expand-trigger` | Menu / List expansion: click or hover | Check Strictly, Path Mode |
| `check-strictly` | Allow parent selection; unlink parent/child checks | Check Strictly |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `options`: Options for cascader
- `placeholder`: Placeholder
- `multiple`: Whether it is a multi-selection state (The search is turned on by default in the multi-select mode)

Example source: src/cascader/__demos__/multiple.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-cascader :options="options" :style="{ width: '320px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." multiple />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const options = [
      {
        value: 'beijing',
        label: 'Beijing',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'chaoyang',
            label: 'ChaoYang',
          },
          {
            value: 'haidian',
            label: 'Haidian',
            isLeaf: true,
          },
          {
            value: 'dongcheng',
            label: 'Dongcheng',
            isLeaf: true,
          },
          {
            value: 'xicheng',
            label: 'Xicheng',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        value: 'shanghai',
        label: 'Shanghai',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'huangpu',
            label: 'Huangpu',
            isLeaf: true,
          },
        ],
      },
    ]
    return {
      options,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Case Sensitive

- `options`: Options for cascader
- `filterable`: Whether to allow searching
- `placeholder`: Placeholder

Example source: src/cascader/__demos__/case-sensitive.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref<string[]>([])
const caseSensitive = ref(false)
const options = [{ value: 'fruit', label: 'Fruit', children: [{ value: 'apple', label: 'Apple' }] }]
</script>

  <c-space direction="column" fill>
    <c-space><c-switch v-model="caseSensitive" /><span>区分大小写</span></c-space>
```

### Load More

- `options`: Options for cascader
- `placeholder`: Placeholder
- `load-more`: Data lazy loading function, open the lazy loading function when it is passed in

Example source: src/cascader/__demos__/load-more.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("cascaderLoadMoreInline");

import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";
import type { CascaderOption } from "../types";
const roots = () => [{ value: "root", label: "Remote group", isLeaf: false }];
const options = ref<CascaderOption[]>(roots());
const requests = shallowRef<((children?: CascaderOption[]) => void)[]>([]);
const stale = shallowRef<((children?: CascaderOption[]) => void)[]>([]);
const statusKey = ref<keyof typeof inlineCopy.value>(
  "expandRemoteGroupThenSettle",
);
const status = computed(() => inlineCopy.value[statusKey.value]);
const loadMore = (
  _option: CascaderOption,
  done: (children?: CascaderOption[]) => void,
) => {
  requests.value = [...requests.value, done];
};
function settle(success: boolean) {
  const callbacks = requests.value;
  requests.value = [];
  callbacks.forEach((done) =>
    done(
      success
        ? [{ value: "leaf", label: "Loaded child", isLeaf: true }]
        : undefined,
    ),
  );
  statusKey.value = success ? "childrenReceived" : "retryByExpandingAgain";
}
function replace() {
  stale.value = [...stale.value, ...requests.value];
  requests.value = [];
  options.value = roots();
  statusKey.value = "dataReplacedOldCallbacksAre";
}
function settleOld() {
  stale.value.forEach((done) =>
    done([{ value: "stale", label: "Stale child", isLeaf: true }]),
  );
  stale.value = [];
  statusKey.value = "oldResponsesMustNotAdd";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-cascader
      :options="options"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :load-more="loadMore"
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.expandRemoteGroup"
    />
    <c-cascader-panel :options="options" :load-more="loadMore" />
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="!requests.length" @click="settle(true)">{{
        inlineCopy.resolve
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!requests.length" @click="settle(false)">{{
        inlineCopy.retry
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="replace">{{ inlineCopy.replaceData }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!stale.length" @click="settleOld">{{
        inlineCopy.resolveOld
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.loadmoreUsesACallbackIts }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

```vue
const options = ref<Record<string, unknown>[]>([])
const loading = ref(false)
async function load() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    options.value = await Promise.resolve([
      { id: 'factory', name: '工厂', nodes: [
        { id: 'device-1', name: '设备一' },
        { id: 'device-2', name: '设备二' },

      :field-names="{ label: 'name', value: 'id', children: 'nodes' }" placeholder="选择设备路径" />
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

In direct mode, the hierarchical popup is a named dialog containing column menus. The root menu uses the localized selection prompt. Each submenu is named after its full parent path, including when its parent row scrolls out of the virtual window. With the popup open and the input focused, press ArrowDown to enter an enabled menu item, then use the arrow keys to navigate the hierarchy. A panel branch's `aria-expanded` reflects whether its child column is actually displayed; focus or hover alone does not mark it expanded. Leaves have no `aria-expanded`. Selectable leaves and selectable strict-mode branches in a single-select hierarchical menu use `menuitemradio` and `aria-checked`; expansion-only branches remain `menuitem`, and selectable items in a multiple-select hierarchy expose unchecked, checked, or mixed state. Tab enters or leaves the menu, arrow keys move focus, and Space toggles selection. Clicking the checkbox also toggles selection. Custom slot controls retain their own tab stops. Single-select hierarchical panels have one Tab entry; arrow keys move between columns and options, while Tab or Shift+Tab leaves the menu. With virtualization, the entry remains among rendered options; custom interactive controls in option slots manage their own focus. Search results do not declare hidden submenus. Direct single-select search uses `listbox` and `option`, with the input referencing the popup and active item; editor single-select search uses `menuitemradio` and `aria-checked`, with one Tab entry. Hovering another option does not move that entry while an option owns focus. Multiple-select search retains checkboxes. Direct multiple-select search uses a named dialog by default; ArrowDown from the open input focuses the first enabled checkbox, and Space toggles it. Explicit popup roles or external relationships remain caller-controlled. After hydration, same-root popups use ID references. Browsers with ARIA element reflection can also associate the input with a popup in an ancestor root (such as the document body) and its active single-select option. For sibling or descendant shadow roots, render the popup in the input’s root to establish the relationship. On the server, inline popups receive automatic ID references. For teleported popups, the component determines the available relationship after hydration. For direct single- or multiple-select search inside Shadow DOM, set `:popup-container="false"` to render the popup inline in the same root as the input, allowing the automatic `aria-controls` relationship and, for single selection, `aria-activedescendant`. Inline rendering can be affected by ancestor clipping and stacking; verify the actual layout and test with assistive technology. In multiple-select editor search, ArrowDown in the search input focuses the first enabled result checkbox; focus stays in the input if none is available. In direct single-select search, the popup icon adds no Tab stop; click it or press ArrowDown in the input to open.

When options are added or removed at the end of a virtual column, options still within the rendered range retain their nodes and focus. Switching parents does not reuse the previous column's scroll position. Options can unmount when removed or outside the virtual window; business code should retain any long-lived input state used by slots.

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Use `v-model`, `v-model:open` and `v-model:input-value` for controlled state. Clear values are `''` for single selection and `[]` for multiple selection. Select uses `undefined` when an actual empty-string option exists.

### Cascader Events / Methods

In direct mode, Arrow Down requests opening when the field is closed. Once opened, the first enabled option becomes active if no option is already active and focus remains in the field, including when options arrive asynchronously. Losing focus, closing, or interacting again cancels the pending activation. A controlled `open` changes only when the parent accepts the request.

When a menu option has focus, Enter or Space activates it. Search inputs and nested checkboxes keep their own keyboard behavior. In a multiple-selection editor, search results form a named group; Tab reaches each checkbox and Space or Enter toggles it.

- `keydown(event)`: keyboard event from the field, candidate menu, or editor panel; `preventDefault()` suppresses internal keyboard handling.

- `update:modelValue`, `change(value)`: emitted on commit, not while editing a draft.
- `update:open`, `open-change(open)`: request an expanded-state change.
- `update:inputValue`, `input-value-change(text)`, `search(text)`: search state.
- `focus(event)`, `blur(event)`, `clear(event)`: native field events; only the field owner notifies Form.
- `load-error(error)`: current options source failure notification; listener Promises are not collected.
- Methods: `focus()`, `blur()` and `refresh(): Promise<void>`; refresh does not open the editor.

### Slots and option data

Use `label({ data })` for custom `selected` labels; `selected` replaces the whole selection area. Also supports `prefix`, `suffix`, `clear-icon({ clear })`, `arrow-icon`, `loading-icon`, `search-icon`, `empty`, and `option({ data })`.

Option `label` is searchable plain text. Use `render` or the `option` slot for custom `option` content, and `format-label` or `label` slot for selected content. Values identify selections; labels never do. `disabled` blocks selection/removal, and `tagProps` customizes selected tags.

Buttons, links, input controls, list options, tree nodes, grid cells, elements with non-negative tabindex, audio/video with controls and nested Cascaders inside custom options manage their own clicks without selecting the outer option; ordinary content remains selectable. When `role` contains multiple tokens, the first role supported by the component determines click ownership. A standalone panel inside Shadow DOM moves option focus within its own root when using arrow keys. A click canceled with `preventDefault` does not trigger an option action, and continues to bubble according to DOM rules.

## Types

### CascaderOption

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------- | :-----: |
| value | Option value | `string \| number \| Record<string, any>` | `-` |
| label | Option text | `string` | `-` |
| render | Custom render function | `RenderFunction` | `-` |
| disabled | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `false` |
| tagProps | Property used for the displayed label | `TagProps` | `-` |
| children | Child options | `CascaderOption[]` | `-` |
| isLeaf | Whether this is a leaf node | `boolean` | `false` |

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { CascaderProps } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

### Editing and confirmation

Use `edit-mode` to configure editing; field > FormItem > Form precedence applies, defaulting to `direct`. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-direct modes open an editor through the field value. Single selection commits on choice by default; need-confirm enables a draft and confirmation. Multiple selection defaults to confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards an uncommitted draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Field editing uses edit-mode: Cedar supports direct/click/dblclick, and Maple supports direct/popup. The old menu/list/picker editing values are not retained. Popup editors reuse the existing option index, search, asynchronous loading and virtual-list algorithms.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omission preserves the existing default. The UI displays null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In confirmation mode, clearing changes the draft and confirm commits it; without confirmation, clearing commits directly.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

### Lazy-loading completion and errors

When an expandable option has unloaded children, Enter, Space, or the forward arrow starts lazy loading and displays its pending state. The forward arrow moves into children only if focus remains on the input or option that received the key. Search results do not expand children.

`loadMore(option, done)` keeps a callback-only contract in the field and standalone panel. Call `done(children)` to accept children or `done()` to end waiting and allow retry. Only the first callback is accepted; return values, including a resolved Promise, do not replace `done`. A synchronous loader exception releases waiting and reaches Vue's `errorCaptured` / application `errorHandler`. The `load-error` event remains specific to the `options` data source; it does not report `loadMore` exceptions. Handle asynchronous callback-based request failures in business code and call `done()`.

Replacing options, including nested mutations, field mappings or the loader invalidates old requests and cached lazy children. Unmounting or deactivation invalidates pending callbacks; stale results cannot modify replacement nodes or clear a newer request's pending state.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests.

The existing CascaderEditMode type is exported from both the component subentry and the root entry, matching the edit-mode values supported by the current platform.

### Selection actions during loading

While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching.

Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing.

option({ data }) receives normalized CascaderOptionInfo; data.raw is the original option and data.path is the normalized root-to-current path. label({ data }) receives the field display item key/value/label/closable/tagProps. arrow-icon({ focus, menuOpen }) receives the real field focus and open state. read({ value, text }) retains null/undefined and the original model shape.

Public types include CascaderBaseValue, CascaderOptionInfo, CascaderReadScope, CascaderEmits, CascaderSlots and CascaderExpose from the root and cascader entry points. Standalone CascaderPanel accepts option arrays and does not own a root candidate loader.

Follow-up acceptance testing (not yet completed): use real screen readers, such as VoiceOver and NVDA, with supported browsers to verify spoken field names, hierarchical navigation and expansion state, search and selection, single and multiple selection, virtual lists, and form errors.

### Checked All Indeterminate

Preview configuration: `:model-value="checkedAll"`, `:indeterminate="indeterminate"`, `value="1"`, `value="2"`.

Example source: src/checkbox/__demos__/checked-all-indeterminate.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-checkbox :model-value="checkedAll" :indeterminate="indeterminate" @change="handleChangeAll">Check All </c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox-group v-model="data" @change="handleChange">
      <c-checkbox value="1">Option 1</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox value="2">Option 2</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox value="3">Option 3</c-checkbox>
    </c-checkbox-group>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const indeterminate = ref(false)
    const checkedAll = ref(false)
    const data = ref<string[]>([])

    const handleChangeAll = (value) => {
      indeterminate.value = false
      if (value) {
        checkedAll.value = true
        data.value = ['1', '2', '3']
      } else {
        checkedAll.value = false
        data.value = []
      }
    }

    const handleChange = (values) => {
      if (values.length === 3) {
        checkedAll.value = true
        indeterminate.value = false
      } else if (values.length === 0) {
        checkedAll.value = false
        indeterminate.value = false
      } else {
        checkedAll.value = false
        indeterminate.value = true
      }
    }

    return {
      indeterminate,
      checkedAll,
      data,
      handleChangeAll,
      handleChange,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Group Methods

```vue
      <c-button @click="proposal = group?.checkAll() ?? []">全选</c-button>
```
