<!-- Source: src/form/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/form/ -->

# Form


Horizontal form items use zero Row gutter by default, preserving the standard 16px item spacing. Explicit `row-props.gutter` overrides remain available. Input and selection fields default to `outline`; `filled` and `standard` remain explicit options.

## Field names

After mounting, the default label focuses the only text input, textarea or select in the field content. Adding a second independent control gives the group the visible label’s name. Give each control its own accessible name. For the association to work in server-rendered HTML, or to target a specific control in a composite field, set `label-attrs.for` and the matching control `id`. When both `for` and `htmlFor` are supplied, `for` takes precedence. Read-only display clears the target.

When `validate-status="error"` has no automatic validation error, the field associates visible `help` text or slot content through `aria-describedby`, preserving any supplied description. An automatic error takes precedence.

In SSR with Vue 3.2.47, if multiple asynchronous form items resolve in opposite orders on the server and client, updating one item can duplicate generated description IDs or associate it with another field’s error. Giving the Input a stable `id` alone does not prevent this; the same scenario passed with Vue 3.5.45.

For a deferred Slider inside Shadow DOM, a popup teleported to `body` may not resolve ID references to hints or errors inside the shadow root. Set `:popup-container="false"`, or pass an element within the same ShadowRoot as `popup-container`, to keep the popup and hints in the same root. Provide clear control names, and account for the container’s styling, positioning, and clipping.

A nested `no-style` field in `read-pretty` mode hides its validation feedback. Calling `setFields` for that field keeps the message out of the parent’s error description. Editable siblings continue to report their own errors.

For a single deferred Input, the visible FormItem label targets the trigger while closed and the native input while editing. When adding a second input, give each field its own accessible name. The FormItem label names their group.

In direct edit mode, for a visible label on a single field, match FormItem `label-attrs.for` to the control `id`. The native inputs in selection, date and time fields do not let their placeholder override an associated label. An explicit `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` retains its native accessible-name precedence. Placeholder is only a fallback when no label is supplied; provide clear labels. Date and time range fields in FormItem associate the form label with their group; use `input-attrs` to give the endpoints distinct names. If `label-attrs.for` targets another control, the label is not associated with the range group. A range field on its own inherits the visible label. When the client identifies a range field alongside an independent input, the visible label names the whole group. Give the individual fields distinct names. When `for` matches a single-value Slider’s `id`, its thumb and optional numeric input use the label; clicking the default native label focuses the enabled thumb; preventing the label click default cancels that focus. When `for` matches a range Slider’s `id`, the form label names the group; use an `aria-label` array to name the endpoints separately. The `tooltip` button is independently focusable and its name is not added to the field label.

A standalone Transfer or ColorPicker can use its FormItem label. When the client identifies multiple fields in that item, the label names the whole group. For mixed fields, place each in a separate FormItem, or give each control an explicit name and associate labels with the other fields separately.

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

### Switching no-style dynamically

Fields can be edited and validated when `no-style` stays unchanged for the lifetime of a FormItem. Currently, changing it dynamically remounts descendant fields, which can lose focus, uncommitted internal drafts and validation state, and can change their reset baseline. To preserve these states, keep the property stable and adjust the layout outside the field; you can also commit or save drafts before switching.

### Multiple controls under one label

For mixed controls, give the visible label a unique ID and explicitly name a group with it. Give each control its own name as well. Use a unique ID for each FormItem instance.

```vue
<script setup>
import { useId } from 'vue'

const contactLabelId = useId()
</script>

<template>
  <c-form-item label="Contact" label-component="span" :label-attrs="{ id: contactLabelId }">
    <div role="group" :aria-labelledby="contactLabelId">
      <c-input aria-label="Email" />
      <input aria-label="Phone" />
    </div>
  </c-form-item>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Form and FormItem accept start/end/left/center/right for content-align and start/end/left/right for label-align. Content defaults to start and labels to end: default LTR placement stays the same while RTL follows reading order. Explicit left/right remain physical. Item overrides and explicit label-column styles retain precedence. Direction changes preserve values, validation and disabled/readonly state.

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { FormProps } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form ref="refForm" :model="form" @submit="handleSubmit">
    <c-form-item field="name" label="Username" required>
      <c-select v-model="form.name">
        <c-optgroup label="Group-1">
          <c-option>Beijing</c-option>
          <c-option>Shanghai</c-option>
        </c-optgroup>
        <c-option>Guangzhou</c-option>
        <c-option disabled>Disabled</c-option>
      </c-select>
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item>
      <c-button html-type="submit">Submit</c-button>
    </c-form-item>
  </c-form>
  {{ form.name }}
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
import type { FormInstance } from "../index";

const refForm = ref<FormInstance>();
const form = reactive({ name: "", post: "", isRead: false });
const handleSubmit = (data: any) => refForm.value?.resetFields(data);
</script>
```

## Form appearance and layout

### Disabled

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `layout` | The layout of the form, including horizontal, vertical, and multi-column | Layout, Decoration, Label width strategies |
| `model` | Form data object | Decoration, Label width strategies |
| `disabled` | Whether to disable the form | Disabled |
| `label-align` | Label alignment | Label width strategies |
| `auto-label-width` | Automatically measure label widths; only effective with `layout="horizontal"` | Label width strategies |
| `label-col-flex` | Label-column flex; numbers are flex ratios, unit-bearing strings are widths | Label width strategies |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `disabled`: Whether to disable the form

Example source: src/form/__demos__/disabled.vue

```vue
<template>

    </c-form-item>
  </c-form>
</template>
<script lang="ts">

export default defineComponent({
  })
</script>
```

### Layout

`edit-mode` describes editing behavior: `direct` always shows the control; `click` and `dblclick` activate the existing editor overlay near the field. `readPretty` is an independent boolean. FormItem and fields inherit the mode when omitted. 

Combine `layout`, `content-align` with `direct / click / dblclick` editing and the independent `readPretty` boolean to compare label, value and wrapped-text alignment. Notes can override the form layout, and values survive every switch. Click or double-click a value to edit in a popover; readPretty displays saved text.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/layout.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";
import type {
  FieldEditMode,
  FormContentAlign,
  FormLayout,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const copy = useDemoLocale("layout");
const layout = ref<FormLayout>("horizontal");
const itemLayout = ref<FormLayout | "inherit">("inherit");
const mode = ref<FieldEditMode>("direct");
const readPretty = ref(false);
const contentAlign = ref<FormContentAlign>("start");
const contentAlignOptions = ["start", "end", "left", "center", "right"].map(
  (value) => ({
    label: value,
    value,
  }),
);
const modeOptions = computed(() =>
  (["direct", "click", "dblclick"] as const).map((value) => ({
    label: copy.value.editModes[value],
    value,
  })),
);
const model = reactive({ ...copy.value.initialModel });
const layouts = ["vertical", "horizontal", "inline"] as const;
const layoutOptions = layouts.map((value) => ({ label: value, value }));

const itemLayoutOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: copy.value.labels.inherit, value: "inherit" },
  ...layoutOptions,
]);
</script>

<template>
  <c-space
    direction="column"
    align="stretch"
    :size="16"
    data-config-comparison="form-layout"
  >
    <c-form layout="vertical" edit-mode="direct">
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.layout">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="layout"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.layout"
          :options="layoutOptions"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.itemLayout">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="itemLayout"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.itemLayout"
          :options="itemLayoutOptions"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.mode">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="mode"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.mode"
          :options="modeOptions"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.contentAlign">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="contentAlign"
          :aria-label="copy.labels.contentAlign"
          :options="contentAlignOptions"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.labels.readPretty">
        <c-checkbox v-model="readPretty" data-read-pretty-toggle
          >readPretty</c-checkbox
        >
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>
      {{ copy.labels.hint }}<br />{{ copy.labels.description[layout] }}<br />{{
        copy.labels.modeDescription[readPretty ? "readPretty" : mode]
      }}
    </p>
    <c-form
      class="layout-comparison-form"
      :model="model"
      :layout="layout"
      :content-align="contentAlign"
      :edit-mode="mode"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      label-align="left"
      label-col-flex="6rem"
    >
      <c-form-item field="name" :label="copy.labels.name" required>
        <c-input v-model="model.name" :placeholder="copy.labels.placeholder" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="department" :label="copy.labels.department">
        <c-input
          v-model="model.department"
          :placeholder="copy.labels.placeholder"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="notes"
        :label="copy.labels.notes"
        :layout="itemLayout === 'inherit' ? undefined : itemLayout"
        :help="copy.labels.help"
      >
        <c-input v-model="model.notes" :placeholder="copy.labels.placeholder" />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">{{ copy.labels.model }}：{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.layout-comparison-form :deep(.c-form-item-layout-inline) {
  width: min(100%, 22rem);
  margin-inline-end: 0;
}
p {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
```

### Partial form section

Group only the onsite SOP, safety notice and key points. The end divider separates the following ungrouped fields. Switch between line, plain and card above the form; your entries are preserved. Toggle the title marker and end divider to compare boundaries. Card uses its outer border instead of a separate end divider.  Section adapts its layout to the parent Form. Fields receive label sizing, disabled state and validation directly from Form; use Form/FormItem layout props to configure them. Supply a title or title slot. Folding and local layout overrides are not supported.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/section.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SectionVariant } from "../../section/props";
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";
const copy = useDemoLocale("section");

const variant = ref<SectionVariant>("line");
const showMarker = ref(true);
const showEndDivider = ref(true);
const variantOptions = computed(() =>
  (["line", "plain", "card"] as const).map((value) => ({
    value,
    label: copy.value.variants[value],
  })),
);

const model = reactive({
  event: "abnormal",
  level: "3",
  tags: [],
  remote: ["review"],
  onsite: ["review"],
  safety: "1",
  points: "1",
  skill: "L3",
  certificates: ["electric", "entry", "height", "high"],
});
const certificateOptions = computed(() => [
  { value: "electric", label: copy.value.lowVoltage },
  { value: "entry", label: copy.value.entryPermit },
  { value: "height", label: copy.value.workAtHeight },
  { value: "high", label: copy.value.highVoltage },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <div data-form-section-demo="variants">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item :label="copy.variantLabel">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="variant"
          :options="variantOptions"
          :aria-label="copy.variantLabel"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item :label="copy.optionsLabel">
        <c-space wrap>
          <c-checkbox v-model="showMarker">{{ copy.markerLabel }}</c-checkbox>
          <c-checkbox v-model="showEndDivider" :disabled="variant === 'card'">{{
            copy.endLabel
          }}</c-checkbox>
        </c-space>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>{{ copy.styleHint }}</p>

    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="horizontal"
      label-col-flex="7rem"
      edit-mode="direct"
    >
      <c-form-item field="event" :label="copy.text.event" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.event"
          :options="[{ value: 'abnormal', label: copy.text.abnormal }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="level" :label="copy.text.level" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.level"
          :options="[{ value: '3', label: copy.levelThree }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="tags" :label="copy.text.tags">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.tags"
          multiple
          :options="[{ value: 'review', label: copy.text.review }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="remote" :label="copy.text.remote">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.remote"
          multiple
          :options="[{ value: 'review', label: copy.text.review }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>

      <c-section
        :title="copy.text.section"
        :variant="variant"
        :show-marker="showMarker"
        :show-end-divider="showEndDivider"
      >
        <c-form-item field="onsite" :label="copy.text.onsite">
          <c-select
            v-model="model.onsite"
            multiple
            :options="[{ value: 'review', label: copy.text.review }]"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="safety" :label="copy.text.safety">
          <c-textarea
            v-model="model.safety"
            :max-length="200"
            show-word-limit
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="points" :label="copy.text.points">
          <c-textarea
            v-model="model.points"
            :max-length="200"
            show-word-limit
          />
        </c-form-item>
      </c-section>

      <c-form-item field="skill" :label="copy.text.skill">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.skill"
          :options="[{ value: 'L3', label: 'L3' }]"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="certificates" :label="copy.text.certificates">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.certificates"
          multiple
          :options="certificateOptions"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Section header actions

The extra slot places actions at the right of the title. Use template fills the three onsite fields; Clear resets them. Edit the outside skill level, then use either action to verify that it stays unchanged.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/section-actions.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const copy = useDemoLocale("section");
const model = reactive({ sop: "", safety: "", points: "", skill: "L3" });
const feedback = ref<"applied" | "cleared" | "">("");
function applyTemplate() {
  Object.assign(model, {
    sop: copy.value.templateSop,
    safety: copy.value.templateSafety,
    points: copy.value.templatePoints,
  });
  feedback.value = "applied";
}
function clearSection() {
  Object.assign(model, { sop: "", safety: "", points: "" });
  feedback.value = "cleared";
}
</script>
<template>
  <div data-form-section-demo="actions">
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="horizontal"
      label-col-flex="7rem"
      edit-mode="direct"
    >
      <c-section
        :title="copy.text.section"
        :description="copy.actionsDescription"
        show-end-divider
      >
        <template #extra>
          <c-space size="sm" wrap>
            <c-button variant="text" size="sm" @click="applyTemplate">{{
              copy.applyTemplate
            }}</c-button>
            <c-button variant="text" size="sm" @click="clearSection">{{
              copy.clearSection
            }}</c-button>
          </c-space>
        </template>
        <c-form-item field="sop" :label="copy.text.onsite"
          ><c-input v-model="model.sop"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="safety" :label="copy.text.safety"
          ><c-textarea v-model="model.safety" :max-length="200" show-word-limit
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="points" :label="copy.text.points"
          ><c-textarea v-model="model.points" :max-length="200" show-word-limit
        /></c-form-item>
      </c-section>
      <c-form-item field="skill" :label="copy.text.skill"
        ><c-input v-model="model.skill"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p v-if="feedback" role="status">{{ copy[feedback] }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Label width strategies

Enter values, then switch between measured labels, responsive columns and fixed widths: all three strategies retain the same form model. Edit the longest label or hide the contact field to observe remeasurement. Below 576px, the responsive strategy stacks labels above controls; fixed widths use 6rem with an 8rem contact-field override.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/label-width-comparison.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";
const copy = useDemoLocale("labelWidthComparison");
const mode = ref<"auto" | "columns" | "fixed">("auto");
const showExtra = ref(true);
const customLabel = ref("");
const model = reactive({ name: "", department: "", contact: "" });

const choices = computed(() =>
  (["auto", "columns", "fixed"] as const).map((value) => ({
    label: copy.value.labels[value],
    value,
  })),
);
</script>
<template>
  <div class="label-width-comparison" data-config-comparison="form-label-width">
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="mode"
      :options="choices"
      :aria-label="copy.labels.strategy"
    />
    <p>{{ copy.labels.hint }}</p>
    <c-checkbox v-model="showExtra">{{ copy.labels.extra }}</c-checkbox>
    <label
      >{{ copy.labels.edit
      }}<c-input v-model="customLabel" :placeholder="copy.labels.contact"
    /></label>
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="horizontal"
      label-align="left"
      :auto-label-width="mode === 'auto'"
      :label-col-flex="mode === 'fixed' ? '6rem' : undefined"
      :label-col-props="
        mode === 'columns' ? { span: 6, xs: 24, sm: 6 } : undefined
      "
      :wrapper-col-props="
        mode === 'columns' ? { span: 18, xs: 24, sm: 18 } : undefined
      "
    >
      <c-form-item field="name" :label="copy.labels.name"
        ><c-input v-model="model.name"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="department" :label="copy.labels.department"
        ><c-input v-model="model.department"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        v-if="showExtra"
        field="contact"
        :label="customLabel || copy.labels.contact"
        :label-col-flex="mode === 'fixed' ? '8rem' : undefined"
        ><c-input v-model="model.contact"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">{{ copy.labels.model }}: {{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.label-width-comparison {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}
p {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
```

## Fields and data model

### Nested Data

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/nested-data.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form :model="form" :style="{ width: '600px' }">
    <c-form-item
      label="Username"
      :content-flex="false"
      :merge-props="false"
      extra="Show error message together"
    >
      <c-row :gutter="8">
        <c-col :span="12">
          <c-form-item
            field="together.firstname"
            validate-trigger="input"
            :rules="[{ required: true, message: 'firstname is required' }]"
            no-style
          >
            <c-input
              v-model="form.together.firstname"
              placeholder="please enter your firstname..."
            />
          </c-form-item>
        </c-col>
        <c-col :span="12">
          <c-form-item
            field="together.lastname"
            validate-trigger="input"
            :rules="[{ required: true, message: 'lastname is required' }]"
            no-style
          >
            <c-input
              v-model="form.together.lastname"
              placeholder="please enter your lastname..."
            />
          </c-form-item>
        </c-col>
      </c-row>
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item label="Username" :content-flex="false" :merge-props="false">
      <c-row :gutter="8">
        <c-col :span="12">
          <c-form-item
            field="separate.firstname"
            validate-trigger="input"
            extra="Show error message separate"
            :rules="[{ required: true, message: 'firstname is required' }]"
            hide-label
          >
            <c-input
              v-model="form.separate.firstname"
              placeholder="please enter your firstname..."
            />
          </c-form-item>
        </c-col>
        <c-col :span="12">
          <c-form-item
            field="separate.lastname"
            validate-trigger="input"
            :rules="[{ required: true, message: 'lastname is required' }]"
            hide-label
          >
            <c-input
              v-model="form.separate.lastname"
              placeholder="please enter your lastname..."
            />
          </c-form-item>
        </c-col>
      </c-row>
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item label="Posts" :content-flex="false" :merge-props="false">
      <c-space direction="column" align="stretch">
        <c-form-item field="posts.post1" label="Post1">
          <c-input
            v-model="form.posts.post1"
            placeholder="please enter your post..."
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item field="posts.post2" label="Post2">
          <c-input
            v-model="form.posts.post2"
            placeholder="please enter your post..."
          />
        </c-form-item>
      </c-space>
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item field="isRead">
      <c-checkbox v-model="form.isRead"> I have read the manual </c-checkbox>
    </c-form-item>
  </c-form>
  {{ form }}
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref, defineComponent } from "vue";
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const form = reactive({
      together: {
        firstname: "",
        lastname: "",
      },
      separate: {
        firstname: "",
        lastname: "",
      },
      posts: {
        post1: "",
        post2: "",
```

### Cross Field

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/cross-field.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";

const formRef = ref();
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ source: "", confirmation: "" });
const result = ref("尚未提交");
const submissions = ref(0);
const snapshot = ref("");
const message = "两次代码须相同且不能为空";
const sourceRules = [{ required: true, message: "请输入源代码" }];
const paused = ref(false);
const pending = shallowRef([]);
let epoch = 0;
function complete() {
  const [resolve, ...rest] = pending.value;
  pending.value = rest;
  resolve?.();
}
function cleanup() {
  epoch++;
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((resolve) => resolve());
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
const confirmationRules = [
  {
    validator: async (value, callback) => {
      if (paused.value)
        await new Promise((resolve) => {
          pending.value = [...pending.value, resolve];
        });
      if (!value || value !== model.source) callback(message);
    },
  },
];
function submitted({ errors, values }) {
  submissions.value++;
  result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
  snapshot.value = JSON.stringify(values);
}
async function validateConfirmation() {
  const current = ++epoch;
  const errors = await formRef.value?.validateField("confirmation");
  if (current === epoch) result.value = errors ? "确认值未通过" : "确认值通过";
}
function reset() {
  cleanup();
  result.value = "已重置";
  snapshot.value = "";
}
</script>

<template>
  <section class="cross-field-form-demo">
    <p>
      仅使用本地合成代码。校验时确认值比较当前源代码；修改源代码不自动复验依赖字段。
    </p>
    <c-form ref="formRef" :model="model" @submit="submitted" @reset="reset">
      <c-form-item
        field="source"
        label="源代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-source' }"
        :rules="sourceRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-source'" v-model="model.source" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="confirmation"
        label="确认代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-confirmation' }"
        :rules="confirmationRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-confirmation'" v-model="model.confirmation" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap>
        <c-button html-type="submit">提交代码</c-button>
        <c-button @click="validateConfirmation">只校验确认值</c-button>
        <c-button html-type="reset">重置代码</c-button>
      </c-space>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">结果：{{ result }}；提交次数：{{ submissions }}</p>
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :aria-pressed="paused"
      @click="paused = !paused"
      >暂停跨字段校验</c-button
    >
    <c-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pending.length" @click="complete"
      >返回跨字段结果</c-button
    >
    <p class="cross-field-pending">等待：{{ pending.length }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>模型：{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
    <ModelOutput>上次提交值：{{ snapshot || "-" }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Empty markers and required validation

The API uses -1 for no selection. Validate the initial value to see a required error, choose a department and validate successfully, then clear to -1 and validate again. Form provides recognition settings; the field defines clear output. Custom validators still receive the original value.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/en-US/empty-values-validation.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ department: -1 as number | null | undefined });
const form = ref();
const result = ref("Not validated");
const options = [
  { value: 1, label: "Engineering" },
  { value: 2, label: "Product" },
];
async function validate() {
  const errors = await form.value.validate();
  result.value = errors ? "Required error" : "Valid";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      Validate the initial -1, then select a department and validate again.
      Clearing restores -1.
    </p>
    <c-form
      ref="form"
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]"
    >
      <c-form-item field="department" label="Department" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.department"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="-1"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="validate">Validate</c-button>
    <p role="status">{{ result }}</p>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ String(model.department) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Reading placeholders and inheritance

Initially in reading mode, Name inherits Form’s default “-”, Code uses the FormItem override, Nickname uses the field override, and Quantity remains 0. Changing Form text only affects inheriting fields. Toggling reading/editing does not rewrite the model. Precedence is Field > FormItem > Form; custom read slots win.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/en-US/empty-text.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const reading = ref(true);
const emptyText = ref("-");
const model = reactive({
  name: null as string | null,
  code: null as string | null,
  nickname: null as string | null,
  quantity: 0 as number | null | undefined,
});
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      Initially, reading mode shows “-” for Name, overrides for Code and
      Nickname, and the valid number 0 for Quantity.
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="reading = !reading">Toggle reading/editing</c-button>
      <c-button @click="emptyText = 'No data'">Use “No data”</c-button>
      <c-button @click="emptyText = '-'">Use default “-”</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :read-pretty="reading"
      :empty-text="emptyText"
    >
      <c-form-item field="name" label="Name: inherits Form"
        ><c-input v-model="model.name"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="code"
        label="Code: FormItem override"
        empty-text="Unassigned"
        ><c-input v-model="model.code"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="nickname"
        label="Nickname: field override"
        empty-text="Unassigned"
        ><c-input v-model="model.nickname" empty-text="Anonymous"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="quantity" label="Quantity"
        ><c-input-number v-model="model.quantity"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Scroll Assign

- `model`: Form data object
- `scroll-to-error`: Scroll to the first (start) or last (end) invalid field; omitted disables scrolling

Example source: src/form/__demos__/scroll-assign.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-button @click="formRef && formRef.validate()">Submit</c-button>
    <c-button @click="formRef && formRef.resetFields()">Reset</c-button>
    <c-button @click="formRef && formRef.scrollToField('name19')">Scroll to the last field</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <c-form
    ref="formRef"
    style="width: 500px; height: 300px; margin-top: 20px; padding-right: 16px; overflow: auto"
    :model="form"
    scroll-to-error="start"
  >
    <template v-for="(fieldName, index) in fieldNames" :key="index">
      <c-form-item :field="fieldName" :label="'user' + index" :rules="[{ required: true, message: 'Name is required' }]">
        <c-input v-model="form[fieldName]" />
      </c-form-item>
    </template>
  </c-form>
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref, defineComponent } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const formRef = ref<FormInstance>()
    const fieldCount = 20
    const fieldNames = Array.from({ length: fieldCount }, (_, index) => `name${index}`)
    const form = reactive(
      Object.fromEntries(fieldNames.map((fieldName, index) => [fieldName, index === 7 ? '' : index.toString()])),
    )

    return {
      form,
      formRef,
      fieldCount,
      fieldNames,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Confirmation event source

Example source: src/form/__demos__/change-source.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("formChangeSourceInline");

import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({
  input: "Draft",
  textarea: "Notes",
  number: 1,
  toggle: false,
});
const changes = ref([]);
function record(field, value, event) {
  changes.value.unshift({
    field,
    value,
    source: event?.type || "programmatic",
  });
}
</script>
<template>
  <section>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.openAFieldEditAnd }}</p>
    <c-input
      v-model="model.input"
      edit-mode="click"
      @change="(value, event) => record('input', value, event)"
    />
    <c-textarea
      v-model="model.textarea"
      edit-mode="click"
      @change="(value, event) => record('textarea', value, event)"
    />
    <c-input-number
      v-model="model.number"
      edit-mode="click"
      @change="(value, event) => record('number', value, event)"
    />
    <c-switch
      v-model="model.toggle"
      edit-mode="click"
      @change="(value, event) => record('switch', value, event)"
    />
    <pre role="status">{{ JSON.stringify(changes, null, 2) }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
```

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/dynamic-form.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form :model="form" :style="{ width: '600px' }">
    <c-form-item field="name" label="Username">
      <c-input v-model="form.name" placeholder="please enter your username..." />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item
      v-for="(post, index) of form.posts"
      :field="`posts[${index}].value`"
      :label="`Post-${index}`"
      :key="index"
    >
      <c-input v-model="post.value" placeholder="please enter your post..." />
      <c-button @click="handleDelete(index)" :style="{ marginLeft: '10px' }">Delete</c-button>
    </c-form-item>
  </c-form>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="handleAdd">Add Post</c-button>
  </div>
  {{ form }}
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { reactive, defineComponent } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const form = reactive({
      name: '',
      posts: [{ value: '' }],
    })
    const handleAdd = () => {
      form.posts.push({
        value: '',
      })
    }
    const handleDelete = (index) => {
      form.posts.splice(index, 1)
    }

    return {
      form,
      handleAdd,
      handleDelete,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

```vue
      <c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button html-type="submit" status="primary" :loading="submitting"
            >提交</c-button
          >
          <c-button html-type="reset">重置</c-button>
          <c-button @click="setStatus">模拟服务端错误</c-button>
        </c-space>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">提交结果：{{ result }}；活动校验：{{ pendingCount }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ form }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ModelOutput from '../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue'

import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, reactive, ref, useId } from "vue";
import type { FormInstance, FieldRule } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const formRef = ref<FormInstance>();
const demoId = useId();
const form = reactive({ name: "", post: "", isRead: false });
const result = ref("尚未提交");
const submitting = ref(false);
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const pending = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
let generation = 0;
let submittedGeneration = -1;
const rules: FieldRule[] = [
  {
    validator: (value, callback) =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const current = generation;
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          pending.delete(timer);
          pendingCount.value = pending.size;
          if (current === generation && value !== "admin")
            callback("用户名必须是 admin");
          resolve();
        }, 600);
        pending.set(timer, resolve);
        pendingCount.value = pending.size;
      }),
  },
];

function beginSubmit() {
  submittedGeneration = generation;
  submitting.value = true;
  result.value = "校验中";
}
function cancelPending() {
  generation++;
  pending.forEach((resolve, timer) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    resolve();
  });
  pending.clear();
  pendingCount.value = 0;
  submitting.value = false;
}
function handleSubmit({ errors }: { errors?: unknown }) {
  if (submittedGeneration !== generation) return;
  submitting.value = false;
  result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function handleReset() {
  cancelPending();
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function setStatus() {
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端用户名错误" },
    post: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端岗位错误" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误已展示";
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
</script>
```

### Async Fields

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-fields.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
const formRef = ref();
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ name: "", code: "" });
const pending = shallowRef([]);
const submissions = ref(0);
const submittedResult = ref("-");
function submitted({ errors }) {
  submissions.value++;
  submittedResult.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
const result = ref("尚未校验");
let run = 0;
function request(field, value) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { field, value, resolve }];
  });
}
function rules(field) {
  return [
    {
      validator: async (value, callback) => {
        const answer = await request(field, value);
        if (answer !== true) callback(answer);
      },
    },
  ];
}
const nameRules = rules("name");
const codeRules = rules("code");
async function validate() {
  const current = ++run;
  result.value = "校验中";
  const errors = await formRef.value?.validate();
  if (current === run) result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function complete(field, latest = false) {
  const tasks = pending.value.filter((item) => item.field === field);
  const task = latest ? tasks.at(-1) : tasks[0];
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = pending.value.filter((item) => item !== task);
  task.resolve(
    task.value === (field === "name" ? "admin" : "1234")
      ? true
      : field === "name"
        ? "用户名必须是 admin"
        : "代码必须是 1234",
  );
}
function reset() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.resetFields();
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function clear() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
  result.value = "已清空";
}
function serverError() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端拒绝" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误";
}
function cleanup() {
  run++;
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(true));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>
<template>
  <section class="async-fields-form-demo">
    <p>
      两个独立本地 Promise 规则分别接受 admin 和
      1234；手动返回各字段，不访问网络。
    </p>
    <c-form ref="formRef" :model="model" @submit="submitted">
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="用户名"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-name' }"
        :rules="nameRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-name'" v-model="model.name" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="code"
        label="代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-code' }"
        :rules="codeRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-code'" v-model="model.code" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-button html-type="submit">原生异步提交</c-button>
    </c-form>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="clear">清空校验</c-button>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="serverError">写入服务端错误</c-button>
    <p class="async-submit-status">
      原生提交：{{ submissions }}；结果：{{ submittedResult }}
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="validate">校验两个字段</c-button>
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'name')"
        @click="complete('name')"
        >返回用户名结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'code')"
        @click="complete('code')"
        >返回代码结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'name')"
        @click="complete('name', true)"
        >返回最新用户名结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'code')"
        @click="complete('code', true)"
        >返回最新代码结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="reset">重置两个字段</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">
      结果：{{ result }}；用户名等待：{{
        pending.filter((item) => item.field === "name").length
      }}；代码等待：{{ pending.filter((item) => item.field === "code").length }}
    </p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Presentation State

- `model`: Form data object
- `disabled`: Whether to disable the form
- `readonly`: Whether form controls are readonly
- `rules`: Form item validation rules

Example source: src/form/__demos__/presentation-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";

const form = ref();
const editMode = ref("dblclick");
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const model = ref({ title: "原名称", note: "原备注", department: "dev" });

const choices = [
  { value: "dev", label: "研发" },
  { value: "design", label: "设计" },
];

const check = (predicate) => [
  {
    validator: (value, callback) => {
      const result = predicate(value);
      callback(result === true ? undefined : result);
    },
  },
];
const rules = { title: check((value) => Boolean(value) || "名称必填") };

const scenario = ref("success");
const scenarios = [
  { value: "success", label: "保存成功" },
  { value: "failure", label: "保存失败，保留草稿" },
  { value: "reset", label: "等待期间重置表单" },
  { value: "disabled", label: "等待期间设为禁用" },
  { value: "readonly", label: "等待期间设为只读" },
];
const pending = shallowRef();
const result = ref("尚未保存");
const current = computed(() => JSON.stringify(model.value));
function save(value, { signal }) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = { id: undefined };
    let settled = false;
    const task = {
      value,
      finish(error, aborted = false) {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        clearTimeout(timer.id);
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
        if (pending.value === task) pending.value = undefined;
        result.value = aborted
          ? "保存已取消，旧结果不会提交"
          : error
            ? "保存失败，保留草稿"
            : "保存成功";
        if (error) reject(new Error("模拟保存失败，请重试"));
        else resolve(aborted ? false : undefined);
      },
    };
    const abort = () => task.finish(false, true);
    if (signal.aborted) {
      abort();
      return;
    }
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    pending.value = task;
    result.value = "模拟保存中（1.2 秒）";
    timer.id = setTimeout(() => {
      if (scenario.value === "reset") form.value.resetFields();
      else if (scenario.value === "disabled") disabled.value = true;
      else if (scenario.value === "readonly") readonly.value = true;
      else task.finish(scenario.value === "failure");
    }, 1200);
  });
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => pending.value?.finish(false, true));
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" :size="16">
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="异步保存场景">
      <c-radio-group
        v-model="scenario"
        aria-label="异步保存场景"
        :options="scenarios"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-checkbox v-model="disabled">禁用状态示例</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly">只读状态示例</c-checkbox>
    <p>
      编辑名称、备注或部门并保存，模拟等待 1.2
      秒。选择保存结果，或在等待时禁用、只读、重置，观察草稿是否提交。
    </p>
    <c-form
      ref="form"
      :model="model"
      :edit-mode="editMode"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :rules="rules"
    >
      <c-form-item field="title" label="事务名称"
        ><c-input v-model="model.title" :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="note" label="事务备注"
        ><c-textarea v-model="model.note" :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="department" label="事务部门"
        ><c-select
          v-model="model.department"
          :options="choices"
          filterable
          :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-space>
      <c-button @click="form.resetFields()">重置状态示例</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status" aria-label="事务保存状态">{{ result }}</p>
    <ModelOutput aria-label="事务当前模型">{{ current }}</ModelOutput>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Async Race

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-race.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="async-race-form-demo">

      >

        >返回最新结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!mounted" @click="serverError"
        >写入服务端错误</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="clear">清空校验</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">校验结果：{{ result }}；等待结果：{{ pending.length }}</p>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
import type { FormInstance, FieldRule } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

interface Pending {
  value: unknown;
  resolve: (result: true | string) => void;
}
const demoId = useId();
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const mounted = ref(true);
const formRef = ref<FormInstance>();
const model = reactive({ name: "" });
const pending = shallowRef<Pending[]>([]);
const result = ref("尚未校验");
const checkedValue = ref("");
let run = 0;

function request(value: unknown) {
  return new Promise<true | string>((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { value, resolve }];
  });
}
const rules: FieldRule[] = [
  {
    validator: async (value, callback) => {
      const answer = await request(value);
      if (answer !== true) callback(answer);
    },
  },
];

function validate() {
  return validateScope(false);
}
function validateAll() {
  return validateScope(true);
}
async function validateScope(all: boolean) {
  const current = ++run;
  checkedValue.value = model.name;
  result.value = "校验中";
  const errors = await (all
    ? formRef.value?.validate()
    : formRef.value?.validateField("name"));
  if (current === run) result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function complete(latest: boolean) {
  const task = latest ? pending.value.at(-1) : pending.value[0];
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = pending.value.filter((item) => item !== task);
  task.resolve(task.value === "admin" ? true : "用户名必须是 admin");
}
function clear() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
  result.value = "已清空";
}
function serverError() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端拒绝" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误";
}
function reset() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.resetFields();
  checkedValue.value = "";
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function cleanup() {
  run++;
  result.value = "已取消";
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(true));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>

  gap: 12px;
}
```

### Async submit input ownership

A native submission owns the reactive model and validation definitions it starts with. Changing model fields (including other fields and change-then-restore), replacing model/rules, changing FormItem rules/required/field, or adding/removing registered fields invalidates a waiting submission. Its eventual success or error does not emit submit, submit-success or submit-failed and does not trigger automatic error scrolling. Submit again to validate the latest inputs. This is logical invalidation, not request cancellation or automatic resubmission, and does not change imperative validation return contracts. Completed submission history is retained. Use reactive state so Vue can observe input changes. Ordinary event listener Promises are not collected.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/submit-inputs.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("formSubmitInputsInline");

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ name: "allowed" });
const pending = shallowRef<
  { value: unknown; resolve: (result: boolean | string) => void }[]
>([]);
const submissions = ref(0);
const snapshot = ref("-");
function request(value: unknown) {
  return new Promise<boolean | string>((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { value, resolve }];
  });
}
const rules = [
  {
    validator: async (value: unknown, callback: (message?: string) => void) => {
      const result = await request(value);
      if (result !== true) callback(String(result));
    },
  },
];
function complete() {
  const [task, ...rest] = pending.value;
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = rest;
  task.resolve(task.value === "allowed" ? true : inlineCopy.value.enterAllowed);
}
function submitted(data: {
  values: Record<string, unknown>;
  errors?: unknown;
}) {
  submissions.value++;
  snapshot.value = JSON.stringify({ values: data.values, valid: !data.errors });
}
function cleanup() {
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(false));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>
<template>
  <section>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.editWhileWaitingThenResolve }}</p>
    <c-form :model="model" edit-mode="direct" @submit="submitted">
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="Name"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id }"
        :rules="rules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id" v-model="model.name" edit-mode="direct" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-space>
        <c-button html-type="submit">{{ inlineCopy.submit }}</c-button>
        <c-button
          html-type="button"
          :disabled="!pending.length"
          @click="complete"
          >{{ inlineCopy.resolveOldest }}</c-button
        >
      </c-space>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">
      Submissions: {{ submissions }}; pending: {{ pending.length }}
    </p>
    <pre class="submitted-values">{{ snapshot }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Dynamic field identity and reset

A reused FormItem automatically unregisters the old field and registers the new nonempty field. Clearing field unregisters it. Each field path retains its first available initial value within that item instance; revisiting a field does not replace its initial value with current edits. Reset clones that field baseline, including 0, false, null and missing/undefined values. Identity changes cancel its editor and invalidate old feedback and field-set callbacks. Already-started imperative validation promises still settle independently; callers own their result text.

An existing model object with a missing property captures undefined. Model/rule replacement does not rebase an already-captured initial value. For async initial data, bind the field or render the item when that data is ready. Recreating the item starts fresh initial baselines.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/field-identity.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("formFieldIdentityInline");

import { reactive, ref, useId } from "vue";
const id = useId();
const form = ref();
const model = reactive({ a: "A initial", b: "B initial" });
const field = ref("a");
const submissions = ref(0);
const result = ref("-");
function reset() {
  if (field.value) form.value?.resetFields(field.value);
}
function submitted(data) {
  submissions.value++;
  result.value = data.errors ? "invalid" : "valid";
}
</script>
<template>
  <section>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.theSameItemRetainsA }}</p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="field === 'a'" @click="field = 'a'">{{
        inlineCopy.bindA
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="field === 'b'" @click="field = 'b'">{{
        inlineCopy.bindB
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!field" @click="field = ''">{{
        inlineCopy.unbind
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-form ref="form" :model="model" edit-mode="direct" @submit="submitted">
      <c-form-item
        :field="field"
        :label="field ? 'Field ' + field.toUpperCase() : 'Unbound'"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id }"
        required
        feedback
        :validate-trigger="[]"
      >
        <c-input
          v-if="field"
          :id="id"
          v-model="model[field]"
          edit-mode="direct"
        />
        <span v-else>{{ inlineCopy.noBoundField }}</span>
      </c-form-item>
      <c-space>
        <c-button html-type="button" :disabled="!field" @click="reset">{{
          inlineCopy.resetCurrent
        }}</c-button>
        <c-button html-type="submit" :disabled="!field">{{
          inlineCopy.validateAndSubmit
        }}</c-button>
      </c-space>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">
      Field: {{ field || "-" }}; submissions: {{ submissions }}; result:
      {{ result }}
    </p>
    <pre class="field-model">{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Five density levels and item spacing

xs/sm/md/lg/xl select geometry through size classes. All sizes default to 16px item spacing; control height and label font size still follow size. Item bottom spacing and reserved validation-message height both use size-*-item-margin-bottom. Inline layout uses inline-item-margin-bottom; error/help do not add item bottom spacing again.

| Variable | Default |
| ------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `--c-form-size-xl-height` | `var(--c-size-xl)` |
| `--c-form-size-xl-label-font-size` | `var(--c-sys-font-size-lg)` |
| `--c-form-size-xl-item-margin-bottom` | `var(--c-spacing-7)` |

### edit-mode inheritance

Form supports `direct / click / dblclick`. When unset, each field retains its own default; FormItem and fields inherit explicitly configured ancestor values, and an explicit field value takes precedence. readPretty controls reading independently of readonly/disabled. Submitting the form fails while a confirmation editor remains unfinished, preserving its draft; reset cancels editing. Existing default slots and v-model are unchanged, and no editor slot is required.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## Business workflows

### Task Workflow

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| -------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------- |
| `model` | Form data object | Task Workflow |
| `layout` | The layout of the form, including horizontal, vertical, and multi-column | Task Workflow |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `model`: Form data object
- `layout`: The layout of the form, including horizontal, vertical, and multi-column

Example source: src/form/__demos__/task-workflow.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
const fresh = () => ({ title: "", department: "ops", priority: "normal" });
const draft = ref(fresh());
const saved = ref(null);
const stage = ref("edit");
const message = ref("填写任务后进入确认；也可以直接提交空表单查看校验。");
const busy = ref(false);
const failNext = ref(false);
const formRef = ref();
const rules = [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: "请输入任务名称" }];
const departments = [
  { value: "ops", label: "运营部" },
  { value: "dev", label: "研发部" },
  { value: "design", label: "设计部" },
];
const priorities = [
  { value: "normal", label: "普通" },
  { value: "urgent", label: "紧急" },
];
const departmentLabel = computed(
  () =>
    departments.find((item) => item.value === draft.value.department)?.label,
);
let timer;
let epoch = 0;
function cancelPending() {
  epoch++;
  clearTimeout(timer);
  busy.value = false;
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
function review({ errors }) {
  if (errors) {
    message.value = "请补全必填项，任务尚未提交。";
    return;
  }
  stage.value = "review";
  message.value = "核对信息后确认提交；返回修改不会改变上次提交记录。";
}
function submit() {
  if (busy.value) return;
  const current = ++epoch;
  const snapshot = { ...draft.value };
  const shouldFail = failNext.value;
  failNext.value = false;
  busy.value = true;
  message.value = "正在本地模拟保存…";
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    if (current !== epoch) return;
    busy.value = false;
    if (shouldFail) {
      message.value = "保存失败：草稿已保留，请点击“重试提交”。";
      return;
    }
    saved.value = snapshot;
    stage.value = "done";
    message.value = "提交成功，已生成任务记录。";
  }, 500);
}
function reset() {
  cancelPending();
  draft.value = fresh();
  saved.value = null;
  stage.value = "edit";
  failNext.value = false;
  message.value = "已重置，可以重新演示。";
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
}
function fill() {
  draft.value = {
    title: "展厅设备巡检",
    department: "ops",
    priority: "urgent",
  };
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
}
</script>
<template>
  <section class="workflow-demo" aria-label="巡检任务完整流程">
    <ol class="workflow-demo__steps" aria-label="任务流程">
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'edit' ? 'step' : undefined">
        01 填写与校验
      </li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'review' ? 'step' : undefined">
        02 核对与提交
      </li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'done' ? 'step' : undefined">
        03 结果与记录
      </li>
    </ol>
    <c-form
      v-if="stage === 'edit'"
      ref="formRef"
      :model="draft"
      layout="vertical"
      @submit="review"
    >
      <c-form-item label="任务名称" field="title" :rules="rules" feedback
        ><c-input
          v-model="draft.title"
          edit-mode="direct"
          placeholder="例如：展厅设备巡检"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="执行部门" field="department"
        ><c-select
          v-model="draft.department"
          :options="departments"
          edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="任务优先级" field="priority"
        ><c-select
          v-model="draft.priority"
          :options="priorities"
          edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button html-type="submit" status="primary">校验并预览</c-button
        ><c-button @click="fill">填入演示数据</c-button></c-space
      >
    </c-form>
    <div v-else-if="stage === 'review'">
      <h4>确认巡检任务</h4>
      <dl>
        <dt>任务</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.title }}</dd>
        <dt>部门</dt>
        <dd>{{ departmentLabel }}</dd>
        <dt>优先级</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.priority === "urgent" ? "紧急" : "普通" }}</dd>
      </dl>
      <c-checkbox v-model="failNext" :disabled="busy"
        >模拟下一次保存失败（本地）</c-checkbox
      >
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button
          status="primary"
          :loading="busy"
          :disabled="busy"
          @click="submit"
          >{{
            message.includes("保存失败") ? "重试提交" : "确认提交"
          }}</c-button
        ><c-button :disabled="busy" @click="stage = 'edit'"
          >返回修改</c-button
        ></c-space
      >
    </div>
    <div v-else>
      <h4>任务已创建</h4>
      <p>
        {{ saved.title }} ·
        {{ saved.priority === "urgent" ? "紧急处理" : "普通处理" }}
      </p>
      <c-button @click="stage = 'edit'">继续编辑</c-button>
    </div>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
    <c-collapse>
      <c-collapse-item title="查看已提交记录" name="saved">
        <pre>{{
          saved
            ? JSON.stringify(saved, null, 2)
            : "尚无记录；校验失败、返回修改或保存失败都不会创建记录。"
        }}</pre>
      </c-collapse-item>
    </c-collapse>
    <c-button @click="reset">重新演示</c-button>
    <small
      >本例使用本地模拟保存，不访问业务服务。校验、确认、保存与失败恢复由业务流程组合。</small
    >
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.workflow-demo {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps li {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--c-color-fill-1);
}
.workflow-demo__steps [aria-current] {
  color: var(--c-color-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.workflow-demo dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
}
.workflow-demo dd {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.workflow-demo pre {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.workflow-demo small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: var(--c-color-text-2);
}
</style>
```

## API

Use edit-mode for editing presentation and read-pretty for reading state. The internal descriptor fieldEditModeProp is not a public Form or FormItem prop.


### Empty values and reading placeholders

Form / FormItem provide empty recognition through `empty-values`; each field defines clear output with its own `empty-value`. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Cedar rule protocol

FieldRule retains object rules and callback errors: callback(message) reports business validation failure. An asynchronous rule must return a Promise; normal completion without an error callback means success. A delayed callback without a returned Promise is not awaited. Returning false or an error string does not replace callback.

Unexpected throws or Promise rejection reject public validate. Handle them with try/catch. The current task releases validating and restores the previous business error without synthesizing a new validation failure. A stale exception cannot clear a newer pending task.

```ts
import type { FieldRule } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
const nameRule: FieldRule<string> = {
  validator: async (value, callback, context) => {
    await Promise.resolve()
    if (!value) callback(`${context?.field} is required`)
  },
}
```

### Public validation and notification contract

Form and FormItem default slots have no scoped arguments. FormItem also provides label, help and extra slots without model helpers. Form manages state through the model object and field paths.

`validate(callback?)` and `validateField(fields, callback?)` await their rules, returning undefined on success or an error record by field on business failure. Callbacks only notify for a current task. Errors contain field, message, label, value, type and isRequiredError. The value remains the original field value.

submit-success precedes submit; business failure sends submit-failed before submit. An unfinished editing session sends only submit-failed. Its errors.editing contains only field="editing" and message, without fabricated field-validation data. FormSubmitError distinguishes this notice from a full ValidatedError.

These events notify only: listener Promises are not awaited and do not execute requests or control loading. Business code manages asynchronous-save loading. Native reset prevents default behavior, resets fields and then notifies reset. Form resetFields writes to model; an inner Form inside FilterForm has its own scope.

`beforeCommit` belongs to fields supporting editing transactions. Its signature is `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`. The payload contains value and previousValue; context contains signal and an optional event. Returning undefined waits for done; a boolean or Promise settles by its result. It is not a Form submit event or general loading entry point.

```ts
import type {
  FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance,
  ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData,
  FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError,
  BeforeFieldCommit,
} from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```
Custom form controls can call `useFormErrorDescription()` in `setup` and bind `describe(existingIds)` to the interactive element's `aria-describedby`. Existing descriptions are preserved, and the FormItem error ID follows the visible error. Outside FormItem, only the existing descriptions are retained.

See [Section](llms/en-US/components/section.md) for section props and slots.

# Grid

CSS Grid columns, spans, gaps, collapse and suffix items. Use Row / Col for 24-column Flex layouts.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

## Basic examples

### Columns, spans and offsets

Example source: src/grid/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template><div>
  <c-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"><c-grid-item v-for="i in 8" :key="i" class="cell">{{ i }}</c-grid-item></c-grid>
  <c-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"><c-grid-item :span="2" class="cell">span 2</c-grid-item><c-grid-item :offset="1" class="cell soft">offset 1</c-grid-item><c-grid-item :span="4" class="cell">span 4</c-grid-item></c-grid>
</div></template>

<style scoped>
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cell { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c-color-primary); color: var(--c-color-white); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.soft { opacity: .7; }
</style>
```

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Grid Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cols | Columns per row, minimum 1 | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `24` |
| row-gap | Row gap in px | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `0` |
| col-gap | Column gap in px | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `0` |
| collapsed | Collapse overflowing rows | `boolean` | `false` |
| collapsed-rows | Visible rows while collapsed, minimum 1 | `number` | `1` |

### Grid Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |

### Grid Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Layout content |

### Grid Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

### GridItem Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| span | Grid span | number / ResponsiveValue | 1 |
| offset | Empty tracks from the logical inline start | number / ResponsiveValue | 0 |
| suffix | Suffix at the end of the row | boolean | false |

The default slot receives `{ overflow: boolean }`, indicating whether the parent Grid hides ordinary items due to collapse. Every GridItem, including suffix items, reads this shared state; it does not describe that item’s own overflow. It is false when expanded. SSR and the initial pre-mount render show every item; collapse is computed after mounting, which can change the initial layout. Offset reserves space from the logical inline start and mirrors in RTL. Span counts content tracks, while offset is included separately in the track budget. There are no custom events or public methods.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Breakpoints use the browser viewport: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Configured values resolve downward from the largest matching breakpoint. SSR starts with xs and responds to the viewport after mounting. Grid collapsing and dynamic ordering are calculated after mounting. These layout containers add no keyboard shortcuts; callers supply content semantics and focusable elements. There are no public methods or dedicated theme tokens.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Import the independent Row and Col components from the library root or their row/col subpaths; installing Grid does not register them.

## Numeric values and collapse budgeting

Numeric inputs must be finite. Existing finite-value rules remain: cols is rounded down with a minimum of 1; collapsed-rows has a minimum of 1; negative gaps and offsets become zero; nonpositive spans are hidden. Non-finite or malformed inputs fall back to the property default: cols=24, collapsed-rows=1, span=1, and gaps/offset=0. Responsive objects accept only the six breakpoints and retain valid fields; undefined is omitted. Development diagnostics use standard Vue prop validation.

Collapse budgeting follows actual DOM order. Suffix items may appear first, in the middle or last; budgeting never moves content nodes. A suffix occupies the logical end of its row, so later ordinary items may wrap. Ordinary items retain the fitting continuous prefix, while every suffix remains visible. If suffix items alone exceed the row budget, keeping them visible takes precedence over limiting total rows. Layout does not change DOM, keyboard or assistive technology reading order.

## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

This component declares no independent public CSS variables. Use the configuration and layout APIs documented on this page.

Internal custom properties and measurement values are implementation details and are not customization APIs.

# Hover

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Preview configuration: `:hovering="hovering"`, `:focusing="focusing"`.

Example source: src/hover/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Hover, useHoverOverlay } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
import '@cedar-design/ui-vue/hover/style'

const vHover = Hover
const { hovering, handleHovering } = useHoverOverlay()
const focusing = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-button v-hover="handleHovering" class="hover-example-target" @focus="focusing = true" @blur="focusing = false">
      将鼠标移入，或用 Tab 聚焦
      <c-hover-overlay :hovering="hovering" :focusing="focusing" />
    </c-button>
    <span role="status">悬停：{{ hovering ? '是' : '否' }}；焦点：{{ focusing ? '是' : '否' }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.hover-example-target { position: relative; }
</style>
```

## API

### HoverOverlay Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hovering | boolean | false | Hover decoration state |
| focusing | boolean | false | Focus decoration state |

`useHoverOverlay()` returns `hovering` and `handleHovering` for directive callbacks. The overlay has no declared events, slots or business instance methods and does not capture interaction. It uses absolute positioning, so the host needs a positioning context; for standalone use import `@cedar-design/ui-vue/hover/style`.

Object styles override only the supplied properties. Leaving or disabling restores their original inline values and `!important` priorities; changing the desktop/mobile argument removes old listeners.

## Types

### Directives

| Usage | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `v-hover="callback"` | Notifies `(hovering: boolean) => void` on mouse enter and leave |
| `v-hover="styleObject"` | Applies styles on mouse enter and restores them on leave |
| `v-hover:desktop` / `v-hover:mobile` | Enabled according to the directive's platform detection; this does not imply real touchscreen hover support |

### Catalog

Preview configuration: `clearable`, `placeholder="搜索图标名称"`.

Example source: src/icon/__demos__/catalog.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import { iconNames } from "@cedar-design/icons-vue";
import * as CedarIcons from "@cedar-design/icons-vue";
import { Message } from "../../message";

const keyword = ref("");
const filteredIcons = computed(() =>
  keyword.value
    ? iconNames.filter((name) =>
        name.includes(keyword.value.trim().toLowerCase()),
      )
    : iconNames,
);

const groupRules = [
  [
    "方向",
    /(^|-)(arrow|caret|chevron|left|right|up|down|expand|shrink|swap|rotate|fullscreen|backward|forward)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "状态与反馈",
    /(^|-)(alert|check|close|error|exclamation|info|question|success|warning|empty|stop)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "编辑",
    /(^|-)(align|attachment|bold|brush|copy|delete|edit|eraser|filter|font|formula|italic|link|list|paste|quote|redo|scissor|sort|underline|undo|zoom)(-|$)/,
  ],
  ["文件", /(^|-)(archive|book|bookmark|drive|file|folder|save|storage)(-|$)/],
  [
    "媒体",
    /(^|-)(camera|image|live|music|mute|pause|play|record|skip|sound|video|voice)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "通信与用户",
    /(^|-)(email|message|notification|phone|send|share|subscribe|user|robot)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "品牌",
    /(alipay|bytedance|codepen|facebook|github|gitlab|google|lark|qq|tiktok|twitter|wechat|weibo|xigua)/,
  ],
  ["天气", /(^|-)weather-|(^|-)sun(-|$)|(^|-)moon(-|$)/],
  ["商业", /(^|-)(barcode|cart|gift|shopping|tag)(-|$)/],
] as const;

const iconGroups = computed(() => {
  const groups = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const name of filteredIcons.value) {
    const label = groupRules.find(([, rule]) => rule.test(name))?.[0] ?? "通用";
    if (!groups.has(label)) groups.set(label, []);
    groups.get(label)?.push(name);
  }
  return [...groupRules.map(([label]) => label), "通用"].flatMap((label) => {
    const names = groups.get(label);
    return names?.length ? [[label, names.sort()] as const] : [];
  });
});

function pascalCase(name: string) {
  return name
    .split("-")
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))
    .join("");
}

function resolveIcon(name: string) {
  return CedarIcons[`Icon${pascalCase(name)}` as keyof typeof CedarIcons];
}

async function copyIcon(name: string) {
  const markup = `<c-icon-${name} />`;
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(markup);
    Message.success(`已复制 ${markup}`);
  } catch {
    Message.error("复制失败，请检查浏览器剪贴板权限");
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input v-model="keyword" clearable placeholder="搜索图标名称">
    <template #prefix><c-icon-search /></template>
  </c-input>
  <section v-for="[group, names] in iconGroups" :key="group" class="icon-group">
    <h3>
      {{ group }} <small>{{ names.length }}</small>
    </h3>
    <div class="icon-catalog">
      <c-button
        v-for="name in names"
        :key="name"
        class="icon-card"
        variant="outline"
        @click="copyIcon(name)"
      >
        <span class="icon-card-content">
          <component :is="resolveIcon(name)" :size="40" />
          <span class="icon-name">{{ name }}</span>
        </span>
      </c-button>
    </div>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>
.icon-catalog {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 168px), 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.icon-group {
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.icon-group h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.icon-group small {
  margin-left: 6px;
  color: var(--color-text-3);
  font-weight: normal;
}

.icon-card {
  min-height: 132px;
  height: auto;
  justify-content: center;
  font: inherit;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 20px 14px;
  color: var(--color-text-1);
  background: var(--color-bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.icon-card:hover {
  color: rgb(var(--c-primary-6));
  border-color: rgb(var(--c-primary-6));
}
.icon-card-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.icon-name {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  white-space: normal;
}
</style>
```
