### Paste a link and fetch its title

Paste a URL or type one and press Enter to simulate fetching its title. The input displays a loading state while waiting. The model contains only URLs; `fallback-option` reads titles from reactive application data. Submit displays the URL data without sending a request.

Example source: src/input-tag/__demos__/link-title.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("inputTagLinkTitleInline");

import { ref } from "vue";

const links = ref<string[]>([]);
const error = ref("");
const submitted = ref<string[] | null>(null);

// 模拟接口：实际业务在服务端解析链接标题，并将 signal 传给 fetch。
async function searchLinks(query: string, { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }) {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(query.trim());
    if (
      !["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) ||
      !url.hostname.includes(".")
    )
      return [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
  const titles: Record<string, string> = {
    "vuejs.org": "Vue.js",
    "github.com": "GitHub",
  };
  if (!titles[url.hostname]) return [];
  error.value = "";
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const cancel = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError"));
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);
      resolve();
    }, 400);
    if (signal.aborted) cancel();
    else signal.addEventListener("abort", cancel, { once: true });
  });
  return [{ value: query.trim(), label: titles[url.hostname] }];
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="12">
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.pasteOrTypeOneOf }}</p>
    <c-input-tag
      v-model="links"
      :options="searchLinks"
      :min-search-length="8"
      :search-delay="300"
      auto-commit-single
      unique-value
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.pasteOrTypeAURL"
      :aria-label="inlineCopy.pasteOrTypeAURL"
      clearable
      @load-error="error = inlineCopy.couldNotFetchTheTitle"
    />
    <p v-if="error" role="alert">{{ error }}</p>
    <c-button :disabled="!links.length" @click="submitted = [...links]">{{
      inlineCopy.submit
    }}</c-button>
    <pre v-if="submitted !== null" aria-live="polite">{{
      JSON.stringify({ links: submitted }, null, 2)
    }}</pre>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Field state and native input

Unset disabled, readonly and error inherit from FormItem / Form. InputGroup supplies disabled, readonly, size and variant; explicit field values, including false, take precedence. The standalone variant defaults to outline. Deferred editors follow the same state and discard their draft when disabled or readonly.

Native id, name, aria/data attributes, constraints and keyboard listeners belong to the actual input; class/style stay on the shell. The name submits the separate input draft, not the tag array. Controlled input drafts restore the accepted value. Composition publishes once and canceled sessions cannot publish later.

Manual loading supports loading-mode="default" (default) or "line" and keeps the input editable. The default clear control is a named native button. The clear-icon slot receives clear(event?) for a custom control. Clearing tags preserves the separate input draft and retains the update:modelValue, change, clear notification order. The clear event accepts Event, including custom control events; a programmatic deferred change may omit its source event.

### Display labels for primitive values

Use `fallback-option` to synchronously read application-managed display data. The model contains only URLs; clicking the button simulates labels arriving without changing the model.

Example source: src/input-tag/__demos__/fallback-option.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("inputTagFallbackOptionInline");

import { reactive, ref } from "vue";

const urls = ref(["https://vuejs.org", "https://github.com"]);
const titles = reactive<Record<string, string>>({});
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number) => ({
  value,
  label: titles[String(value)] ?? String(value),
});

function loadTitles() {
  // 实际应用由业务请求并更新映射；组件不发起请求。
  titles["https://vuejs.org"] = "Vue.js";
  titles["https://github.com"] = "GitHub";
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="12">
    <c-input-tag v-model="urls" :fallback-option="fallbackOption" />
    <c-button @click="loadTitles">{{ inlineCopy.loadMockTitles }}</c-button>
    <pre>{{ JSON.stringify(urls, null, 2) }}</pre>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Restore saved values asynchronously

This example simulates saving the ID array in memory, remounts the component, then loads names asynchronously. IDs appear while loading; the synchronous `fallback-option` resolves names when data arrives without changing the saved values. Applications own persistence and fetching display data by ID.

Example source: src/input-tag/__demos__/async-fallback-restore.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("inputTagAsyncFallbackRestoreInline");

import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from "vue";

const values = ref(["shuai.meng", "xiaoming", "lisi"]);
const saved = ref([...values.value]);
const names = ref<Record<string, string>>({
  "shuai.meng": "孟帅",
  xiaoming: "小明",
  lisi: "李四",
});
const generation = ref(0);
const readPretty = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

// fallback 只同步读取业务数据，未找到时返回 undefined。
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number) => {
  const label = names.value[String(value)];
  return label === undefined ? undefined : { value, label };
};

function saveAndReload() {
  // 用内存模拟数据库保存；实际业务应保存 values.value，再按 ID 请求姓名。
  saved.value = [...values.value];
  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
  names.value = {};
  values.value = [...saved.value];
  generation.value++; // 重新挂载组件，模拟打开已保存的数据。
  loading.value = true;
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    names.value = { "shuai.meng": "孟帅", xiaoming: "小明", lisi: "李四" };
    loading.value = false;
  }, 1500);
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
});
</script>

<template>
  <c-space
    direction="column"
    style="width: 100%"
    :size="12"
    data-demo="input-tag-async-fallback-restore"
  >
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.saveAndReloadToResolve }}</p>
    <c-input-tag
      :key="generation"
      v-model="values"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
    />
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="saveAndReload">{{ inlineCopy.saveAndReload }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="readPretty = !readPretty">{{
        readPretty ? inlineCopy.edit : inlineCopy.read
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <div role="status">
      {{ loading ? inlineCopy.loadingNames : inlineCopy.namesLoaded }}
    </div>
    <div>
      {{ inlineCopy.savedValues
      }}<code data-saved-value>{{ JSON.stringify(saved) }}</code>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Keyboard interaction

Follow-up acceptance testing (not yet completed): use real screen readers, such as VoiceOver and NVDA, with supported browsers to verify spoken input and tag names, creation and removal, keyboard operation, and form error messages.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`unique-value` compares normalized object and string tag values using the merged `field-names.value` mapping. Numeric `1` and string `"1"` are distinct. Duplicates remain legal by default, with a stable private identity per occurrence and a separate overflow key. Folding affects display only; it does not truncate the model.

Public Props exclude the internal composition controls `baseCls`, `focused`, `disabledInput` and `uninjectFormItemContext`. A synchronous undefined return from before-commit waits for done; ordinary change / press-enter listeners do not await Promises. A deferred change may omit its source DOM event. Clearing defaults to [] in multiple mode and null in single mode; an explicit empty-value takes precedence.

### InputTag Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | :--------: |
| multiple | Allow multiple tags; false replaces the previous value | `boolean` | `true` |
| model-value **(v-model)** | An array in multiple mode; a scalar or null in single mode | `InputTagValue` | `-` |
| default-value | Default value (uncontrolled state) | `InputTagValue` | `[]` / `null` |
| input-value **(v-model)** | The value of the input | `string` | `-` |
| default-input-value | The default value of the input (uncontrolled state) | `string` | `''` |
| options | Candidate array or remote loader; Enter selects a candidate or adds the raw input when no results remain | `InputTagOption[] \| (query, { signal }) => InputTagOption[] \| Promise<InputTagOption[]>` | `-` |
| min-search-length | Minimum query length before searching; empty input never searches | `number` | `1` |
| search-delay | Remote search debounce delay in milliseconds | `number` | `250` |
| auto-commit-single | Automatically commit the sole enabled result after a search completes | `boolean` | `false` |
| placeholder | Placeholder | `string` | `-` |
| disabled | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `-` |
| error | Whether it is an error state | `boolean` | `-` |
| readonly | Whether it is read-only mode | `boolean` | `-` |
| clearable | Enables the clear action | `boolean` | `false` |
| size | The size of the input | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| variant | The variant of the input | `'filled' \| 'outline' \| 'standard'` | `'outline'` |
| max-tag-count | Finite nonnegative integer; 0 is unlimited, invalid values diagnose and fall back to unlimited display | `number` | `0` |
| retain-input-value | Whether to keep the content of the input box | `boolean \| { create?: boolean; blur?: boolean }` | `false` |
| format-label | Format tag content | `(data: TagData) => string` | `-` |
| fallback-option | Synchronously resolve display data for primitive values; show the value when unresolved | `(value: string \| number) => TagData \| null \| undefined` | `-` |
| unique-value | Whether to create only unique values | `boolean` | `false` |
| field-names | Customize fields in `TagData` | `InputTagFieldNames` | `-` |
| tag-nowrap | Tag content does not wrap | `boolean` | `false` |

| loading | Business-controlled loading state; does not block input | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading-mode | Shared field feedback appearance, independent of Loading animation types | `'default' \| 'line'` | `'default'` |
| empty-value | Value emitted when cleared; defaults to [] in multiple mode and null in single mode | `InputTagValue \| (() => InputTagValue)` | `[]` |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form | `readonly unknown[]` | `-` |
| empty-text | Read empty text; an explicit empty string is valid | `string` | `'-'` |
| edit-mode | Editing mode; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form | `'direct' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'` | `'direct'` |
| read-pretty | Independent read presentation; explicit false overrides the parent | `boolean` | `false` |
| before-commit | Guard before saving a deferred edit; return a boolean or Promise, or complete via done | `(payload: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown }, done: (allow?: boolean) => void, context: { signal: AbortSignal; event?: Event }) => void \| boolean \| Promise<void \| boolean>` | `-` |
| open | Controlled editor visibility, separate from native input focus | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Initial visibility of an uncontrolled editor | `boolean` | `false` |
| popup-container | Editor mount container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |

### InputTag Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------------ | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| update:modelValue | Tag model update proposal; deferred mode notifies after saving | value: `InputTagValue` |
| update:inputValue | Separate input draft update proposal | inputValue: `string` |
| update:open | Controlled editor visibility update | open: `boolean` |
| open-change | Actual editor visibility change | open: `boolean` |
| search | Emitted when input changes after the minimum query length is reached | query: `string` |
| select | Emitted when a candidate is committed | value: `string \| number`, option: `SelectOptionInfo` |
| load-error | Remote candidate loading failed | error: `unknown` |
| change | Emitted when the value changes | value: `InputTagValue`<br>ev?: `Event` |
| input-value-change | Emitted when the input value changes | inputValue: `string`<br>ev: `Event` |
| press-enter | Emitted when Enter is pressed | inputValue: `string`<br>ev: `KeyboardEvent` |
| remove | Emitted when a tag's remove button is clicked | removed: `string \| number`<br>ev: `Event` |
| clear | Emitted when the clear action is invoked | ev: `Event` |
| focus | Emitted when the input gains focus | ev: `FocusEvent` |
| blur | Emitted when the input loses focus | ev: `FocusEvent` |

### InputTag Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| ------ | ---------------- | ---- | ------ |
| focus | Focus the current editor; deferred mode first opens an editable panel | - | - |
| blur | Blur the current input | - | - |

Public methods remain callable from initial component mount. Stored methods resolve the current editor on every call and never use an old input after closure, reopening, or mode changes. Native input references are undefined while no editor is mounted.

### InputTag Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------ | :------------------: | --------------- |
| label | Display content for selected tags | data: `TagData` |
| prefix | Prefix content | - |
| suffix | Suffix content | - |
| clear-icon | Custom clear control | clear: `(event?: Event) => void` |
| read | Custom read content, taking precedence over empty-text | value: `InputTagValue`<br>text: `string` |

```ts
import type { InputTagProps, InputTagValue, InputTagEmits, InputTagSlots, InputTagExpose, InputTagInstance, InputTagFieldNames, TagData } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

## Tags and close buttons

Tag controls tag and close-button appearance. Disabled, readonly and nonclosable tags cannot be removed with the close button.

The accessible name of each close button combines the localized close action with the displayed tag label. For custom tag slots that do not render plain text, the item label is used; set `tagProps.closeButtonAriaLabel` to provide the full name explicitly.

## InputTag wrapper and content responsibilities

InputTag uses FieldDecorator variables for its outline, filled and standard appearance. The filled backgrounds use fill-1, fill-2 and fill-3 for default, hover and focus. Form manages validation messages.

input-tag-* controls content density, default tag backgrounds and disabled text. Disabled styles take precedence over focus. Sizes xs/sm/md/lg/xl are supported. xl uses 32px tags, 16px input text and 4px vertical padding.

Use field-variant-{variant}-background for field backgrounds, field-border-radius for corners, field-placeholder-text-color for placeholders, and field-clear-icon-color / field-clear-icon-size for clear icons. Prefer `size` for dimensions and InputTag variables for tag content.

Default text, disabled text, tag backgrounds and focus backgrounds use the corresponding system semantic colors. Disabled state does not override explicit color / status; keep text readable when supplying custom colors. Parent disabled / readonly takes precedence over tagProps.closable / checkable. Loading or explicitly nonclosable tags cannot be removed with Backspace.

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

<!-- Source: src/input/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/input/ -->

# Input

Text input with controlled and uncontrolled values.

## Server-side rendering

With Vue 3.2–3.4, when multiple asynchronous components resolve in a different order on the server and client, generated IDs may cause floating labels to reference the wrong inputs. In this scenario, give each Input an `id` that is unique on the page and identical on the server and client, for example `<Input id="account-name" />`.

## Reading direction

The input inherits `dir` from its page or local scope. Affixes, clear actions and input groups follow reading order. Runtime changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; the browser handles caret movement, mixed text and composition without swapping editing keys. Parent rerenders preserve the native composition buffer; older selection-restoration tasks do not overwrite a newer composition.

## Basic examples

### Control Sizes

- `size`: Controls the component size.
- `variant`: Selects the visual variant.

Example source: src/field-decorator/__demos__/control-sizes.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("fieldDecoratorControlSizesInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
const sizes = ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] as const;
const variants = ["outline", "filled", "standard"] as const;
const size = ref<(typeof sizes)[number]>("md");
const variant = ref<(typeof variants)[number]>("outline");
const options = [
  { value: "beijing", label: "Beijing" },
  { value: "shanghai", label: "Shanghai" },
];
const cascaderOptions = [{ value: "china", label: "China", children: options }];

const inputValue = ref("Beijing");
const selectValue = ref("beijing");
const cascaderValue = ref("beijing");
const selectMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectedOptions = [
  ...options,
  {
    value: "long",
    label:
      "A very long selected option label for overflow comparison — full text preview keeps the selected value unchanged.",
  },
];
const selectedCascaderOptions = [
  { value: "china", label: "China", children: selectedOptions },
];
function resetSelections() {
  inputValue.value = "Beijing";
  selectValue.value = "beijing";
  cascaderValue.value = "beijing";
  selectMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  selectOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
}
</script>
```

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------- | ------------------ | ------------------ |
| `placeholder` | Hint text | Form Feedback, Floating Hint |
| `hint` | Whether hint text floats | Form Feedback, Floating Hint |
| `clearable` | Whether to allow the input to be cleared | Form Feedback, Floating Hint |
| `variant` | Field appearance | Floating Hint |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Choose an axis to compare its available values with the same content and model. Other settings remain unchanged while comparing.

Example source: src/input/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("comparison");
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("示例内容");
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "filled", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from "vue";
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: "variant", values: ["filled", "outline", "standard"] },
  { name: "size", values: ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] },
];
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant");

  () =>
    demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)
      ?.values ?? [],
);
```

### Form Feedback

Example source: src/input/__demos__/form-feedback.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form :model="model">
    <c-form-item field="account" label="账户" feedback :validate-status="status" :help="status === 'error' ? '请输入账户后重试' : undefined">
      <c-input v-model="model.account" placeholder="请输入账户" clearable />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button status="primary" :loading="status === 'validating'" @click="validate">模拟异步校验</c-button>
  </c-form>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const model = reactive({ account: '' })
const status = ref<'validating' | 'success' | 'error'>()
let request = 0
async function validate() {
  const current = ++request
  const value = model.account
  status.value = 'validating'
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
  if (current === request) status.value = value.trim() ? 'success' : 'error'
}
</script>
```

### Floating Hint

When `hint` is omitted it inherits InputGroup; the standalone library default is `false`. An outer FormItem label suppresses the floating hint. Explicit `false` uses the native placeholder; explicit `true` remains subject to outer-label suppression. `text-color`, `focus-color`, and `blur-color` override text and hint colors.

- `variant`: Selects the visual variant.

Example source: src/input/__demos__/floating-hint.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <c-input v-model="name" hint placeholder="姓名" clearable />
    <c-input v-model="email" hint variant="standard" placeholder="邮箱" />
    <c-input v-model="phone" hint placeholder="带前缀的电话" clearable><template #prefix>+86</template></c-input>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const name = ref('')
const email = ref('')
const phone = ref('')
</script>
```

## Input content and layout

### Word Limit

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `placeholder` | Hint text | Word Limit, Prefix, Group |
| `clearable` | Whether to allow the input to be cleared | Word Limit, Prefix, Group State |
| `max-length` | Finite nonnegative length or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; 0 is unlimited; invalid values diagnose and fall back to no limit | Word Limit |
| `show-word-limit` | Show the character counter | Word Limit |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent | Group State |
| `disabled` | Disabled state; can inherit from Form | Group State |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/input/__demos__/word-limit.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-input v-model="normalValue" :max-length="10" clearable show-word-limit placeholder="超出后截断" />
    <c-input
      v-model="errorOnlyValue"
      :max-length="{ length: 6, errorOnly: true }"
      show-word-limit
      placeholder="允许超出，但标记错误"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const normalValue = ref('Cedar')
const errorOnlyValue = ref('超过六个字符后显示错误')
</script>
```

`max-length` accepts a finite nonnegative number or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; `0` means unlimited. Object `length` follows the same numeric constraint and `errorOnly` is an optional boolean. Invalid values use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and fall back to no limit; null is treated as unset. Default slicing counts UTF-16 code units. Supply `word-length / word-slice` together for custom counting and slicing.

`InputGroupLabel` renders a span for content attached outside the input. Associate a visible name by matching FormItem `label-attrs.for` to the Input `id`, or use a native label with for/id. You can also provide `aria-label` explicitly.

### Group State

- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.
- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

## Value model and interaction

### Default Value

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `clearable` | Whether to allow the input to be cleared | Event Pipeline, Clear icon and manual deletion |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent | Default Value |
| `aria-label` | Native input accessible label | Default Value |
| `disabled` | Disabled state; can inherit from Form | Interaction state comparison |
| `readonly` | Readonly state; can inherit from Form | Interaction state comparison |
| `error` | Error state; can inherit from FormItem | Interaction state comparison |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/input/__demos__/default-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { ref } from "vue";

const copy = useDemoLocale("defaultValue");
const seed = ref("A: initial text");
const instanceKey = ref(0);
const lastUpdate = ref<string | null>(null);
const updateCount = ref(0);
const controlled = ref("");
function record(value: string) {
  lastUpdate.value = value;
  updateCount.value += 1;
}
function remount() {
  instanceKey.value += 1;
  lastUpdate.value = null;
  updateCount.value = 0;
}
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <p>
      {{ copy.uncontrolledHint }}
    </p>
    <c-input
      :key="instanceKey"
      :default-value="seed"
      :aria-label="copy.uncontrolledInput"
      @update:model-value="record"
    />
    <p>
      defaultValue = <code>{{ seed }}</code>
    </p>
    <p role="status">
      update:modelValue × {{ updateCount }}; {{ copy.lastUpdate }} =
      <code>{{
        lastUpdate === null ? copy.none : JSON.stringify(lastUpdate)
      }}</code>
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button
        @click="
          seed = seed.startsWith('A:') ? 'B: new default' : 'A: initial text'
        "
        >{{ copy.changeDefault }}</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="remount">{{ copy.remount }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p>
      {{ copy.uncontrolledSteps }}
    </p>
    <p>
      {{ copy.controlledHint }}
    </p>
    <c-input
      v-model="controlled"
      default-value="This default is ignored"
      :aria-label="copy.controlledInput"
    />
    <p role="status">
      v-model = <code>{{ JSON.stringify(controlled) }}</code>
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="controlled = 'Parent supplied text'">{{
        copy.updateParent
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="controlled = ''">{{ copy.clearParent }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p>
      {{ copy.formHint }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

`v-model.trim` follows Vue model event rules: `update:modelValue` is trimmed during input, while `input` reports the original text after length normalization. An uncontrolled editor may retain surrounding whitespace while editing and normalizes its local display on commit; committing does not repeat the same model proposal already reported. Controlled display follows the final parent value, and `change` still denotes a commit.

### Clear icon and manual deletion

Set clear output to null. Clear with the icon, restore the initial value, then delete all text with Backspace. The model shows null for the icon and an empty string for manual deletion.

Example source: src/input/__demos__/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ text: "Hello" as string | null });
</script>
<template>

      The clear icon produces null; Backspace to empty produces an empty string.
    </p>
    <c-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item field="text" label="Keyword">
        <c-input
          v-model="model.text"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="null"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="model.text = 'Hello'">Restore initial value</c-button>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model.text) }}</output>
    </p>
```
```vue
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Event Pipeline

Example source: src/input/__demos__/event-pipeline.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref('可编辑内容')
const events = ref<string[]>([])
const record = (name: string) => { events.value = [...events.value.slice(-7), name] }
</script>
<template>
  <div class="input-pipeline-demo">
    <c-input v-model="value" clearable placeholder="输入后尝试清空" @clear="record('clear')" @input="record('input')" @update:model-value="record('update:modelValue')" @change="record('change')" />
    <p>输入：input → update；清空：clear → input → update → change。</p>
    <output>{{ events.join(' → ') || '等待操作' }}</output>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.input-pipeline-demo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.input-pipeline-demo p { margin: 0; }
</style>
```

### Commit approval

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes null unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

Example source: src/input/__demos__/en-US/commit-protocol.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref<string | null>("Project A");
const message = ref("");
async function beforeCommit(
  { value: next, previousValue }: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown },
  _done: (allow?: boolean) => void,
  { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal },
) {
  if (next === previousValue) return true;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
  if (signal.aborted) return false;
  message.value = `Saved: ${String(next)}`;
  return true;
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-input
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="click"
      clearable
      :empty-value="null"
      :before-commit="beforeCommit"
    />
    <p role="status">{{ message }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Loading and waiting

## Composition input

IME composition preserves the native text being entered; external model updates do not replace it before composition completes. Existing formatting and controlled-owner acceptance apply after completion. Queued restoration from an earlier input cannot replace the text or caret of a later edit or composition. Length limits and modifiers retain their existing post-composition input/commit timing.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Input Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | :---------: |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value | `string \| null` | `-` |
| `loading` | Loading presentation; keeps the input editable | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loading-mode` | Loading layout: default indicator or bottom line | `default / line` | `default` |
| model-modifiers | `v-model` modifiers; supports `trim` | `{ trim?: boolean }` | `{}` |
| default-value | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent | `string` | `''` |
| variant | Field appearance | `'filled' \| 'outline' \| 'standard'` | `'outline'` |
| size | Input size | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| clearable | Whether to allow the input to be cleared | `boolean` | `false` |
| empty-value | Clear output; omission clears to an empty string and manual deletion is unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `undefined` |
| disabled | Disabled state; can inherit from Form | `boolean` | `-` |
| readonly | Readonly state; can inherit from Form | `boolean` | `-` |
| error | Error state; can inherit from FormItem | `boolean` | `-` |
| placeholder | Hint text | `string` | `-` |
| hint | Whether hint text floats | `boolean` | Inherits when unset; defaults to `false` when used independently |
| line | Whether to draw a border or underline | `boolean` | `true` |
| text-color | Input text color | `string` | `-` |
| focus-color | Focused hint and supported border colors; does not control the caret | `string` | `-` |
| blur-color | Unfocused hint color | `string` | `-` |
| aria-label | Native input accessible label | `string` | `-` |
| autofocus | Focus automatically after mount | `boolean` | `false` |
| enterkeyhint | Mobile virtual-keyboard enter-key hint | `string` | `-` |
| max-length | Finite nonnegative length or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; 0 is unlimited; invalid values diagnose and fall back to no limit | `number \| { length: number; errorOnly?: boolean }` | `0` |
| show-word-limit | Show the character counter | `boolean` | `false` |
| word-length | Length-counting function | `(value: string) => number` | `-` |
| word-slice | Text-slicing function, used with wordLength | `(value: string, maxLength: number) => string` | `-` |
| input-attrs | Attributes for the internal input element | `object` | `-` |
| `type` | Input type: text/password/number/tel/email | `InputType`<br>`'number' \| 'text' \| 'email' \| 'tel' \| 'password'` | `text` |
| `edit-mode` | Editor mode; inherits FormItem/Form | `direct / click / dblclick` | `undefined` |
| `read-pretty` | Reading presentation; inherits FormItem/Form | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `open` | Controlled editor visibility in deferred modes | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `default-open` | Uncontrolled initial editor visibility; creation-only | `boolean` | `false` |
| `before-commit` | Deferred save approval: (payload, done, context) | `BeforeFieldCommit` | `undefined` |
| `popup-container` | Deferred editor portal target; false renders in place | `PopupContainer` | `undefined` |

`disabled / readonly / size` resolve from child → InputGroup → FormItem/Form → library defaults; Cedar size also supports ConfigProvider. `clearable` applies only to nonempty editable inputs: PC shows it on hover/focus, while touch devices and Maple keep it visible. Native name/id/aria-*/data-* reach the input; class/style stay on the wrapper. `input-attrs` cannot override controlled value, type, disabled/readonly state or length policy.

### Input Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| input | Emitted on user input | value: `string`<br>ev: `Event` |
| change | Emitted on blur, Enter submission or clearing | value: `string \| null`<br>ev?: `Event` |
| press-enter | Emitted when the user presses Enter | ev: `KeyboardEvent` |
| clear | Emitted when the user clicks the clear button | ev: `Event` |
| focus | Emitted when the input gains focus | ev: `FocusEvent` |
| blur | Emitted when the input loses focus | ev: `FocusEvent` |
| `update:modelValue` | Model proposal; includes explicit null | `value: string \| null` |
| `update:open` | Editor visibility request | `open: boolean` |
| `keydown` | Native keyboard notification | `event: KeyboardEvent` |
| `click` | Native input click notification | `event: MouseEvent` |

### Input Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| ------ | ---------------- | ---- | ------ |
| focus | Focus the input | - | - |
| blur | Blur the input | - | - |
| select | Select all text | - | - |

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { InputProps } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

Public types: `InputEmits`, `InputSlots`, `InputExpose`, `InputGroupSlots`, `InputPasswordEmits`, `InputPasswordSlots`, `InputPasswordExpose`.

### Form presentation inheritance

Supports `edit-mode`: `direct / click / dblclick`. Inherits FormItem/Form when unset; standalone usage defaults to direct. readPretty displays plain text; popup editing updates v-model after confirmation by default. Optional before-commit can intercept saving after candidate validation. See the Form documentation for usage and comparison demos.

### Input caret theme

| CSS variable | Default | Description |
| ----------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `--c-input-caret-color` | `currentColor` | Caret color, independently overridable from text color |

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-input-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

InputPassword forwards all Input props, events and slots. `open` controls only the deferred editor; direct mode has no editor. Initial `open`/default-`open` does not request an initialization close, and later default-`open` changes do not reopen the editor.

### Native busy metadata

When neither loading nor commit waiting is active, Input preserves native aria-busy metadata. Internal busy takes precedence over an external false hint. Setting aria-busy alone does not create an indicator or async task.

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-input-caret-color: var(--c-field-caret-color);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content inherits reading direction. Sider placement=left/right remains physical; collapse and ResizeBox handle meanings do not reverse. Header and content may use their own local dir.

Set a local mode with an outer `<c-theme-provider theme="dark">`. This component has no theme prop. Nest theme="light" for a light region; library popups follow their owning provider.

## API

### Layout Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| scrollable | Native scrolling on the layout; constrain its height | `boolean` | `false` |
| has-sider | Force sider layout, including SSR; mounted Sider children are also detected | `boolean` | `false` |

### LayoutHeader Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bordered | Show the bottom border | `boolean` | `false` |

### LayoutContent Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| scrollable | Native scrolling on the content; constrain its height | `boolean` | `false` |

### LayoutFooter Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bordered | Show the top border | `boolean` | `false` |

### LayoutSider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bordered | Show the border next to the content | `boolean` | `false` |
| placement | Physical sider placement; RTL does not swap left/right | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'left'` |
| collapse-mode | width changes available width; transform retains expanded content width and translates/clips it | `'width' \| 'transform'` | `'width'` |
| collapsed | Controlled when provided; waits for parent writeback | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| default-collapsed | Initial uncontrolled collapsed state | `boolean` | `false` |
| collapsible | Show the default trigger; does not block external or responsive collapse | `boolean` | `false` |
| width | Expanded base width; finite nonnegative pixels or a nonempty CSS width string | `number \| string` | `200` |
| collapsed-width | Collapsed width; finite nonnegative pixels, with a recovery trigger at zero | `number` | `48` |
| reverse-arrow | Reverse the default arrow; right placement also reverses it | `boolean` | `false` |
| breakpoint | Request collapse on narrow screens after mounting; re-evaluate changed configurations immediately | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' \| 'xxl'` | `undefined` |
| resize-directions | Use ResizeBox instead of the default div; physical edges, with handles removed while collapsed | `ResizeBoxDirection[]`<br>`ResizeBoxDirection: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `undefined` |
| hide-trigger | Hide the default trigger; the caller supplies recovery access | `boolean` | `false` |

### LayoutSider Events

| Component | Event | Parameters and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Layout / LayoutContent / LayoutSider | scroll | Native Event; scrolling notification |
| LayoutSider | update:collapsed | boolean; collapsed-state update request |
| LayoutSider | collapse | boolean and 'clickTrigger' / 'responsive'; request source |
| LayoutSider | breakpoint | boolean; whether the environment requests collapse, independently of controlled state |

### LayoutSider Slots

| Component | Slot | Parameters and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Layout / LayoutHeader / LayoutContent / LayoutFooter / LayoutSider | default | Unscoped layout content |
| LayoutSider | trigger | Scope { collapsed: boolean }; rendered inside a native button, so do not nest another button |

### LayoutSider Methods

Layout, LayoutContent and LayoutSider expose scrollTo(options: ScrollToOptions) and scrollTo(x: number, y: number); Header/Footer have no dedicated instance methods.

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { LayoutProps } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```

### Additional layout capabilities

| Component | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Content | scrollable | boolean | false | Use this element as a native scroll container |
| Header / Footer / Sider | bordered | boolean | false | Show the border next to the content |
| Sider | placement | 'left' / 'right' | 'left' | Sidebar placement; handles arrows automatically, while reverse-arrow remains supported |
| Sider | collapse-mode | 'width' / 'transform' | 'width' | Resize or translate content while collapsing |

Layout, Content and Sider emit `scroll`(event: Event) and expose `scrollTo(options: ScrollToOptions)` / `scrollTo(x: number, y: number)`. Sider scrolls its internal content node by default. `width` accepts numeric px or CSS lengths. Percentage widths with transform mode are discouraged; use definite lengths such as px/rem.

The collapse control is a native button supporting Tab, Enter and Space. With `collapsed-width="0"`, the hidden region is inert and the expansion entry stays at the sidebar edge. A custom trigger slot should contain display content without nested buttons.

## Responsive sider

Breakpoint subscriptions begin after mounting; SSR retains the initial collapsed or default-collapsed state. Changing the breakpoint immediately evaluates the current viewport. Removing it stops automatic responses and keeps the current collapsed state. The xs breakpoint requests collapse at widths up to 575px; other breakpoints request collapse below their minimum width, consistently collapsing on narrow screens.

The breakpoint event reports the current narrow-screen state on initial subscription and breakpoint configuration changes, then on matching-state changes, independently of collapsed. update:collapsed and collapse(..., responsive) are requested only when the target differs from the current collapsed state. Controlled mode waits for the parent to update the prop; environmental notifications still occur when the parent declines a state request. Notification events do not await promises returned by listeners.

## Resizable sider width ownership

When resize-directions is provided, Sider owns the current width: expanded mode retains the most recently resized width; collapsed mode uses collapsed-width and removes resize handles; expanding restores the latest expanded width. Collapse/expand preserves content nodes and input state. A collapsed-width of zero still supports the recovery trigger outside the content area. When the width prop value changes, temporary resizing is cleared and the new numeric or CSS length value takes effect. Controlled collapsed still waits for parent writeback. Transform-mode content width and translation use the latest expanded width.

Development uses Vue prop validation for enums, non-finite/negative widths and duplicate/unknown resize edges. Runtime filters/deduplicates edges, defaults invalid width/collapsed-width to 200/48 and placement to left, and does not subscribe to invalid breakpoints. Default trigger names use locale.layout.expandSider/collapseSider through global useLocale or ConfigProvider.locale. Public Props derive from actual components with typed event listeners; resizeDirections uses ResizeBoxDirection[].

```ts
import type { LayoutProps, SiderProps } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
const layout: LayoutProps = { onScroll: (event) => event.preventDefault() }
const sider: SiderProps = { resizeDirections: ['right'], onCollapse: (collapsed, reason) => console.log(collapsed, reason) }
```

## CSS Variables

Sider text, background and its collapse trigger follow the current theme. Variables whose names contain `light` can be overridden in both light and dark themes. Use `--c-layout-sider-light-box-shadow` for the Sider shadow, or `none` to disable it. `bordered` and `--c-layout-border-color` control borders independently.

## Interaction and control

### Link Loading

Preview configuration: `loading`, `:loading="loading"`.

Example source: src/link/__demos__/link-loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from "vue";

const loading = ref(false);
const ready = ref(false);
const href =
  "data:text/plain;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent("示例报告：准备完成。");
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

function prepareDownload(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (ready.value) {
    return;
  }
  event.preventDefault();
  loading.value = true;
  // 模拟业务准备；完成后再次激活链接，交给浏览器原生下载。
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    ready.value = true;
    loading.value = false;
    timer = undefined;
  }, 1000);
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer));
</script>
<template>
  <c-space size="sm">
    <c-link :href="href" download="report.txt" loading>加载中</c-link>
    <c-link
      :href="href"
      download="report.txt"
      :loading="loading"
      @click="prepareDownload"
    >
      {{ loading ? "准备中" : ready ? "下载示例报告" : "准备下载报告" }}
    </c-link>
  </c-space>
  <p>
    首次点击或按 Enter 准备报告；完成后再次激活链接，浏览器下载文本文件。loading
    由业务手动控制。
  </p>
</template>
```

## API

### Native links and manual loading

Supply href for navigation. Disabled/loading links that originally had href retain the link role, remove navigation attributes and leave the Tab order. Native download, hreflang, referrerpolicy and ARIA attributes are forwarded. loading takes precedence over the icon slot. click is a MouseEvent notification using Vue once semantics; returned Promises do not manage loading. Use Button for business actions without a navigation target.

On first activation, business code prepares the report. Once ready, activation uses the browser's native download behavior. Unmounting cancels preparation.


### Link Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | Five text, icon and spinner sizes | 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | 'md' |
| `href` | Native link destination | string | - |
| `target` | Native target | string | - |
| `rel` | Native link relationship | string | - |
| `status` | Semantic status | `SemanticStatus`<br>`'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | 'default' |
| `underline` | Underline policy | 'always' \| 'hover' \| 'none' | 'none' |
| `hoverable` | Padded hover/active backgrounds | boolean | false |
| `icon` | Show the leading icon; icon slot takes priority | boolean | false |
| `loading` | Show spinner and block navigation/click | boolean | false |
| `disabled` | Disable the link | boolean | false |

### Custom styling

Customize appearance through `--c-link-*` CSS variables. Keyboard focus supports `--c-link-focus-width` (2px), `--c-link-focus-offset` (2px), `--c-link-focus-color` (currentColor) and `--c-link-focus-opacity` (0.8). Reduced motion disables loading rotation and transitions.

Text colors match Button text variants: default uses content-primary; secondary/tertiary use content-secondary; colored statuses use their semantic content colors; disabled/loading use content-disabled. Both brands inherit these in light/dark modes.

Size variables: `--c-link-size-xs-font-size`, `--c-link-size-sm-font-size`, `--c-link-size-md-font-size`, `--c-link-size-lg-font-size`, `--c-link-size-xl-font-size`. Defaults are 12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 18px. md references `--c-link-font-size`; icons/loading icons use 1em.

## Lifecycle

### Virtual Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | Data consumed by item slot | Virtual Lifecycle |
| `virtual-list-props` | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | Virtual Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

On KeepAlive reactivation, the virtual list restores its last recorded vertical and horizontal scroll positions within the current scrollable range. A new scroll command issued during reactivation takes precedence.


- `data`: Supplies the example data.

Example source: src/list/__demos__/virtual-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, key) => ({ key }));
let retained:
  | { scrollIntoView: (options: { key: number; align: "top" }) => void }
  | undefined;
const capture = (instance: typeof retained) => {
  if (instance) retained = instance;
};
const jump = () => retained?.scrollIntoView({ key: 50, align: "top" });
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / deactivate</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / dispose cache</c-button>
    <c-button @click="jump">Retained command: row 51</c-button>
    <p>Inactive/disposed commands do nothing. Activation never replays them.</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-list
        v-if="active"
        :ref="capture"
        :data="rows"
        :virtual-list-props="{
          height: 100,
          fixedSize: true,
          estimatedSize: 20,
          buffer: 2,
          itemKey: 'key',
        }"
      >
        <template #item="{ item }"
          ><div style="height: 20px">{{ item.key + 1 }}</div></template
        >
      </c-list>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

The virtual list covers the viewport before prerendering additional items on either side according to `buffer`; `buffer=0` is valid. `estimatedSize` must be finite and positive, including values below 1; invalid values fall back to 30px. `fixedSize` can change dynamically. Variable-height mode uses measured and estimated sizes and, when available, `ResizeObserver` to watch measurable mounted roots. The `item` slot receives the original index and unknown data, may return multiple measurable root nodes, and should provide a stable `itemKey`; measurement uses the combined root bounds for each item. To expose the complete collection to assistive technology, business rows can supply `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` using the actual data.

The virtual list cannot currently measure or position multi-root child components reliably when they are returned directly as items. As a workaround, wrap the component in a real DOM element within the slot, or make the child component return a single real DOM root. Choose an element appropriate to the list semantics. This limitation does not affect slots that directly return multiple measurable elements.

Server rendering currently fails when the same node combines `v-for` and `v-memo` inside the `default`, `header`, `footer`, `empty` or `item` slot. Data mode is affected with or without virtualization. Temporarily remove `v-memo` from that node and verify update behavior.

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### List Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

## Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List handles display and an optional virtual viewport. Compose InfiniteScroll status/target behavior for pagination rather than duplicating its loading state machine inside List.

## API

### Loading Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| type | Loading animation type | `circle \| wave \| cube \| rect \| disappear` | `circle` |
| size | Loading-indicator size; numbers are px | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl \| number` | `md` |
| radius | Radius for `circle` indicators | `string \| number` | - |
| color | Indicator and hint-text color | `string` | - |
| loading | Whether loading; effective only when wrapping content | `boolean` | `false` |
| tip | Prompt copy | `string` | - |
| hide-icon | Whether to hide the loading indicator | `boolean` | `false` |

`v-c-loading` accepts boolean shorthand or `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }`. The object's `loading` field controls state; other props match `Loading`.

### Loading Slots

| Slot | Description |
| ------- | ---------------------- |
| default | Content covered by the loading mask |
| tip | Custom hint content |
| icon | Custom loading indicator |

The `icon` slot replaces every built-in `type` animation. Without it, the ConfigProvider `loading` slot takes precedence over built-in animations. `hide-icon=true` hides all indicators while allowing tip content to remain visible.

## Types

### Registration

`v-c-loading` renders Cedar's built-in `Loading` component. The `c-` prefix avoids collisions with other libraries’ directives. Register it in any of the following ways.

```ts
// 1. Full installation: registers Loading and v-c-loading automatically
import CedarVue from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

app.use(CedarVue);
```

```ts
// 2. Install Loading on demand: registers the component and directive
import { Loading } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

app.use(Loading);
```

```ts
// 3. Register only the directive manually
import { vLoading } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

app.directive("c-loading", vLoading);
```

With `CedarResolver()`, `unplugin-vue-components` resolves template `v-c-loading` automatically. `directives: false` disables directive resolution.

The component exports the following types:

```ts
import type { LoadingProps } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

The loading-directive mask prevents default click behavior and propagation. Clicking it does not activate Card or ordinary parent click handlers. Normal clicking resumes after loading. It does not disable keyboard access to underlying controls; set those controls’ `disabled` props to block all interaction.

### Overlay styles

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-loading-overlay-background` | Directive overlay background; the background option overrides this value. |

Content-overlay class: `.c-loading__content-overlay`.

Each directive update replaces the complete configuration; omitted options and boolean `true` use defaults. Changing `fullscreen` while loading moves the overlay between the host and its owner document body. Host children stay in place. Multiple `fullscreen` instances share a counted scroll lock: closing a local instance does not unlock `fullscreen` instances, and the final `fullscreen` instance preserves an existing external lock class.

### Icons and status messages

A numeric `size` sets the custom indicator container's font size in pixels. Named sizes control built-in animations. Custom icons inherit the `--c-loading-indicator-size` font size (20px by default): `1em` children scale with it, while SVGs with fixed pixel dimensions keep their own size. Use the `icon` slot for graphics and `tip` or its slot for status text.

Standalone Loading has `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Without a tip it includes localized visually hidden status text, even when the icon is hidden. Wrapper mode retains `aria-busy`. The directive sets `aria-busy="true"` on the original host and restores its previous value on cleanup, preserving a later external change.

Assistive technology may defer announcements within a busy region. For business start, completion or failure messages, maintain a persistent status region outside the busy region and update its text. The overlay does not disable keyboard interaction. See [WAI-ARIA `aria-busy`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-busy) and [ARIA22 status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22).

## CSS Variables

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--c-loading-color` | `rgb(var(--c-primary-6))` | `background-color`, `color` |
| `--c-loading-directive-z-index` | `2000` | `z-index` |

# Map

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Content and presentation

### Auth

The original `map-core` runtime dependency is not included. Applications can provide an explicit `MapSdk` adapter through `sdk`, containing `Map`, `LngLat`, `MapService`, and `SearchService`; a fallback is shown when no valid implementation is available. Legacy global integration remains supported, but the explicit adapter takes precedence and does not require replacing the native browser `Map`. The adapter must handle initialization, authorization, and resource disposal for its map service.

`MapSdk`, `MapSdkMapOptions`, `MapSdkSearchOptions`, `MapSdkSearchCompletion`, `MapSdkMap`, `MapSdkLngLat`, and `MapSdkSearchService` are exported from both the root and `map` entry. An explicit adapter must call the supplied completion callback for that specific `search(query, complete)` request; stale and duplicate callbacks are ignored. `MapSdkSearchOptions.complete` exists for legacy global SDK compatibility and cannot submit results for explicit adapters. Map and search services may provide `off` and `destroy` for cleanup; the application owns vendor adaptation and authorization.

Example source: src/map/__demos__/auth.vue

```vue
<template>

  </c-alert>
```
```vue
</template>
```

## API

### Map Props

GIS search uses the current `enable-gis-search`, `base-path`, and `fetch` on the next input. Changing these settings or `is-international` clears old results and ignores earlier GIS search responses.

When the SDK is available, changing `sdk`, `map-type`, `is-international`, `base-path`, `driver`, `fetch`, `geocoder-url`, or `geocoder-handler` retires the old instance and initializes a new one. Objects and functions are compared by reference. Changes in the same update are coalesced, and stale results cannot update the new instance. Actual resource disposal depends on the SDK adapter.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| model-value(**v-model**) | Controlled location model; the input object is not mutated | `Object` | - |
| default-value | Default map center | `{ [key in valueKeyAlias[keys]]: any }` | - |
| sdk | Explicit map SDK adapter; replacement or removal reinitializes the map | `MapSdk` | `-` |
| driver | SDK driver object | `object` | `-` |
| fetch | Service with get/post methods | `MapFetch` | `-` |
| geocoder-url | Geocoder endpoint URL | `string` | `-` |
| geocoder-handler | Processes geocoding-service responses | `MapGeocoderHandler` | - |
| base-path | Base URL for map data | `String` | `'/pe/powerpro'` |
| is-international | Whether this is a Google map | `Boolean` | - |
| popup-container | MapSelect dialog mount target; unused by Map itself | `PopupContainer` | Library default |
| show-name | Whether to show the floating location name | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-locate-me-button | Whether to show the current-location button | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-edit-address-button | Whether to show the floating change-location button | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-map-tips | Whether to show tips above the map | `boolean` | `true` |
| map-type | Map type | `'qqmaps'\|'google'\|'amaps'` | `'qqmaps'` |
| enable-gis-search | Whether to enable GIS search; `fetch` is required when enabled | `boolean` | `false` |
| value-key-scope | String array of values displayed on the map | `Array` | `valueKeyScope` |
| value-key-alias | Mapping from map keys to values | `Object` | `valueKeyAlias` |

Programmatic map moves share an update guard, so an older cooldown cannot end a newer move. When locations are selected in succession, an older place-detail or lookup result cannot overwrite the later selection. For successive map moves, only the latest reverse-geocoding result can commit; a parent location change or unmount invalidates older requests. Unmounting during initialization prevents later map creation or processing of the initial geocoding result. Model updates during initialization do not create duplicate maps; the center synchronizes to the latest model when initialization completes.

### MapSelect Props

Includes Map Props, plus:

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | Disable opening and clearing | `boolean` | `false` |
| clearable | Show the clear button | `boolean` | `false` |
| map-style | Styles applied directly to the map; can set map height | `object` | `{ height: '300px'}` |

SDK initialization failures report the original error and show a retry button. Deactivation during initialization retires the old instance and restarts initialization after activation. The application must still provide a usable map SDK runtime.

### Map Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| error | SDK initialization, search, place selection, geolocation, or reverse geocoding after a map move failed | Original cause `unknown` |
| change | Position change notification | `(scopedValue, fullValue)` |
| init | Emitted after map initialization | `(initialValue, completedValue)` |
| loading:address | Emitted while resolving the selected location's address | `-` |
| loaded:address | Emitted when address resolution settles, including failure or cancellation; failures also emit error | `-` |
| update:modelValue | Proposes a new location model | New model object |

### MapSelect Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | Current reverse geocoding, map SDK initialization, search, place selection, geolocation, or move geocoding failed | Original cause `unknown` |
| `clear` | Clear was requested | None |
| `change` | Position change proposed | `(scopedValue, fullValue)` |
| `init` | Map initialization forwarded | `(initialValue, completedValue)` |
| `update:modelValue` | Proposed model preserving other existing fields | New model object |

The parent owns `model-value`. Selection and geocoding propose a new object via `update:modelValue`; the display follows the accepted value. Results from obsolete requests or after deactivation or unmount do not commit.


`geocoder-handler` receives numeric longitude and latitude and can synchronously or asynchronously return an object containing `address`, `poi`, `area_code`, `country_code`, `city`, and `country`; it takes precedence over `fetch`. Otherwise reverse geocoding uses `geocoder-url`, or derives a default from `map-type` and `base-path`; `fetch.get` must return a response with `isValid()` and `data`. MapSelect fallback uses updated aliases and service configuration for subsequent requests; zero is a valid coordinate. Runtime SDK service reconfiguration requires verification when the SDK is restored. The root and `map` entry export `MapProps`, `MapSelectProps`, `MapFetch`, `MapGeocoderHandler`, `MapGeocoderResult`, and component instance types. The map SDK is not included in the current build; map interaction is unavailable when it is not configured.
