# Mention

Text input with mention suggestions supplied by the application.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/mention/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg" style="width: 100%">
    <c-mention v-model="value" :options="['Bytedance', 'Bytedesign', 'Bytenumner']" placeholder="enter something" />
    <c-mention
      v-model="text"
      :options="['Bytedance', 'Bytedesign', 'Bytenumner']"
      type="textarea"
      placeholder="enter something" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const text = ref('')
</script>
```

### Atomic mentions and display fallback

With `atomic`, selected mentions are edited and deleted as units. The model stores identity as `@[encoded ID]`. Supply unresolved names synchronously through `fallback-option`; the component does not request display data. Atomic values support strings, finite numbers and booleans with their types preserved; object values are unsupported. Literal `@[` and backslashes are escaped. `atomic` is off by default, so existing plain text is not automatically reinterpreted.

For example, string ID `shuai.meng` is stored as `@[shuai.meng]`; numeric `0` is `@[!n:0]`, distinct from string `@[0]`. A non-`@` prefix is encoded as well: a `##` mention of `topic` is `@[%23%23|topic]`. Labels resolve from current options, then `fallback-option`, then the component's selected-item cache, and finally the original value. The per-instance cache is shared by editing and read-pretty presentations, and entries are removed when mentions are removed. Applications must still supply names for unresolved initial values and own data requests and persistent storage.

Local candidates are matched case-insensitively against both `value` and `label`. For example, typing `@xiaoming` or `@小明` finds the same candidate; choosing it displays `@小明` and stores `@[xiaoming]`. In atomic mode, when there are no candidates, Enter also creates a mention if `fallback-option` returns an object for the typed ID. Unconfirmed text is not converted. Remote loaders receive the query and their results are not filtered again locally. During requests the field and suggestion dropdown show loading feedback; stale responses cannot replace the latest results.

Example source: src/mention/__demos__/atomic-mention.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("mentionAtomicMentionInline");

import { reactive, ref } from "vue";

const content = ref("请联系 @[shuai.meng] 跟进");
const fallbackContent = ref("");
const people = [{ value: "xiaoming", label: "小明" }];
const names = reactive<Record<string, string>>({
  "shuai.meng": "孟帅",
  xiaoming: "小明",
});
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number | boolean) => ({
  value,
  label: names[String(value)] ?? String(value),
});
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="12">
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.typeToSelectAPerson }}</p>
    <c-mention
      v-model="content"
      atomic
      type="textarea"
      :options="people"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      :aria-label="inlineCopy.atomicMentions"
    />
    <c-button @click="names['shuai.meng'] = '孟帅（已更新）'">{{
      inlineCopy.updateMockName
    }}</c-button>
    <pre>{{ content }}</pre>
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.withoutOptionsTypeXiaomingAnd }}</p>
    <c-mention
      v-model="fallbackContent"
      atomic
      :options="[]"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      :aria-label="inlineCopy.fallbackOnly"
    />
    <pre>{{ fallbackContent }}</pre>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

After confirming a mention, a space is added unless whitespace already follows; the space is part of the saved value. Mention text uses the primary brand foreground without a background.

## Data and options

### Filtering and async search

With a local array, type `@小` or `@xiaoming` to match a name or ID. The async example passes the query to application code and shows loading in the dropdown. Quickly change `@xi` to `@lisi` to see only the latest result. It uses mock data; a real loader can pass `signal` to `fetch`.

Example source: src/mention/__demos__/search-options.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("mentionSearchOptionsInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
import type { OptionsLoader } from "../../_hooks/use-option-request";

const localValue = ref("");
const remoteValue = ref("");
const autoValue = ref("");
const people = [
  { value: "xiaoming", label: "小明" },
  { value: "xiaohong", label: "小红" },
  { value: "lisi", label: "李四" },
];

// 实际业务可以在这里调用接口，并将 signal 传给 fetch。
const searchPeople: OptionsLoader<(typeof people)[number]> = (
  query,
  { signal },
) =>
  new Promise((resolve) => {
    const finish = () => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);
      const keyword = query.toLowerCase();
      resolve(
        people.filter(
          (person) =>
            person.value.includes(keyword) || person.label.includes(query),
        ),
      );
    };
    // 模拟不同网络耗时，方便快速改词时观察 loading 和最新结果。
    const timer = setTimeout(
      finish,
      query.toLowerCase().startsWith("x") ? 1400 : 450,
    );
    const cancel = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve([]);
    };
    if (signal.aborted) cancel();
    else signal.addEventListener("abort", cancel, { once: true });
  });
</script>

<template>
  <c-space
    direction="column"
    style="width: 100%"
    :size="12"
    data-demo="mention-search-options"
  >
    <p>
      本地候选按账号或姓名筛选；异步搜索时可快速从 @xi 改为
      @lisi，观察下拉加载和最新结果。
    </p>
    <p>
      Local options match ID or name. For remote search, quickly change @xi to
      @lisi to see loading and the latest results.
    </p>
    <c-mention
      v-model="localValue"
      atomic
      :options="people"
      :aria-label="inlineCopy.localPeopleSearch"
    />
    <c-mention
      v-model="remoteValue"
      atomic
      :options="searchPeople"
      :min-search-length="2"
      :aria-label="inlineCopy.remotePeopleSearch"
    />
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.automaticallyCommitTheOnlyMatching }}</p>
    <c-mention
      v-model="autoValue"
      atomic
      :options="searchPeople"
      :min-search-length="2"
      :search-delay="250"
      auto-commit-single
      :aria-label="inlineCopy.commitSingleResult"
    />
    <div>
      {{ inlineCopy.localValue }}<code data-local-value>{{ localValue }}</code>
    </div>
    <div>
      {{ inlineCopy.remoteValue
      }}<code data-remote-value>{{ remoteValue }}</code>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Async search and read-pretty display

Type `@xiaoming` and select the person, then search for `@lisi`. The selected name remains visible in read-pretty mode and when returning to the editor; the model retains its ID. This example uses a mock request for candidates and `fallback-option` for the initial ID.

Example source: src/mention/__demos__/async-read-pretty.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("mentionAsyncReadPrettyInline");

import { ref } from "vue";

const content = ref("请联系 @[shuai.meng]");
const readPretty = ref(false);
const people = [
  { value: "xiaoming", label: "小明" },
  { value: "lisi", label: "李四" },
];

// 初始化 ID 的名称由业务提供；搜索并选中的名称由组件在当前实例中缓存。
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number | boolean) =>
  value === "shuai.meng" ? { value, label: "孟帅" } : undefined;

const searchPeople = (query: string, { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }) =>
  new Promise<typeof people>((resolve) => {
    const finish = () => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);
      const keyword = query.toLowerCase();
      resolve(
        people.filter(
          (person) =>
            person.value.includes(keyword) || person.label.includes(query),
        ),
      );
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(finish, 500);
    const cancel = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve([]);
    };
    if (signal.aborted) cancel();
    else signal.addEventListener("abort", cancel, { once: true });
  });
</script>

<template>
  <c-space
    direction="column"
    style="width: 100%"
    :size="12"
    data-demo="async-read-pretty"
  >
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.selectXiaomingSearchLisiThen }}</p>
    <c-mention
      v-model="content"
      atomic
      type="textarea"
      :options="searchPeople"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      aria-label="异步人员提及"
    />
    <c-button @click="readPretty = !readPretty">{{
      readPretty ? inlineCopy.edit : inlineCopy.read
    }}</c-button>
    <div>
      {{ inlineCopy.model }}<code data-mention-model>{{ content }}</code>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Restore saved values asynchronously

This example simulates saving the model in memory, remounts the component, then loads names asynchronously. IDs appear while loading; the synchronous `fallback-option` resolves names when data arrives without changing the saved value. Applications own persistence and fetching display data by ID.

Example source: src/mention/__demos__/async-fallback-restore.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("mentionAsyncFallbackRestoreInline");

import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from "vue";

const content = ref("请联系 @[shuai.meng]、@[xiaoming]、@[lisi]");
const saved = ref(content.value);
const names = ref<Record<string, string>>({
  "shuai.meng": "孟帅",
  xiaoming: "小明",
  lisi: "李四",
});
const generation = ref(0);
const readPretty = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

// fallback 只同步读取业务数据，未找到时返回 undefined。
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number | boolean) => {
  const label = names.value[String(value)];
  return label === undefined ? undefined : { value, label };
};

function saveAndReload() {
  // 用内存模拟数据库保存；实际业务应保存 content.value，再按 ID 请求姓名。
  saved.value = content.value;
  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
  names.value = {};
  content.value = saved.value;
  generation.value++; // 重新挂载组件，模拟打开已保存的数据。
  loading.value = true;
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    names.value = { "shuai.meng": "孟帅", xiaoming: "小明", lisi: "李四" };
    loading.value = false;
  }, 1500);
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
});
</script>

<template>
  <c-space
    direction="column"
    style="width: 100%"
    :size="12"
    data-demo="mention-async-fallback-restore"
  >
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.saveAndReloadToResolve }}</p>
    <c-mention
      :key="generation"
      v-model="content"
      atomic
      type="textarea"
      :options="[]"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      aria-label="重新初始化的人员提及"
    />
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="saveAndReload">{{ inlineCopy.saveAndReload }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="readPretty = !readPretty">{{
        readPretty ? inlineCopy.edit : inlineCopy.read
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <div role="status">
      {{ loading ? inlineCopy.loadingNames : inlineCopy.namesLoaded }}
    </div>
    <div>
      {{ inlineCopy.savedValue }}<code data-saved-value>{{ saved }}</code>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Loading and waiting

### Controlled loading

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Explicit business loading state | `boolean` | `false` |


Set loading explicitly to display feedback. Ordinary event return values do not drive loading. Before hooks retain their documented pending behavior.

Example source: src/mention/__demos__/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("mentionLoadingInline");

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from "vue";
import type { OptionsLoader } from "../../_hooks/use-option-request";
const loading = ref(true);
const requests = new Set<(failed?: boolean) => void>();
const pending = ref(0);
const statusKey = ref<keyof typeof inlineCopy.value>("waitingForData");
const status = computed(() => inlineCopy.value[statusKey.value]);
const load: OptionsLoader<string> = (query, { signal }) =>
  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const finish = (failed = false) => {
      requests.delete(finish);
      pending.value = requests.size;
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);
      if (failed) reject(new Error("Candidate request failed"));
      else
        resolve(
          ["Alice", "Bob"].filter((name) =>
            name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()),
          ),
        );
    };
    const cancel = () => finish();
    requests.add(finish);
    pending.value = requests.size;
    signal.addEventListener("abort", cancel, { once: true });
  });
function settle(failed = false) {
  statusKey.value = failed ? "failedTypeToRetry" : "dataReceived";
  [...requests].forEach((finish) => finish(failed));
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => settle());
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="16">
    <h4>{{ inlineCopy.manualLoading }}</h4>
    <c-switch v-model="loading" :aria-label="inlineCopy.manualLoading2" />
    <c-mention
      edit-mode="direct"
      :loading="loading"
      :options="['Alice', 'Bob']"
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.singleLine"
    />
    <c-mention
      edit-mode="direct"
      type="textarea"
      :loading="loading"
      :options="['Alice', 'Bob']"
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.multipleLines"
    />
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.loadingDoesNotDisableEditing }}</p>
    <h4>{{ inlineCopy.remoteCandidates }}</h4>
    <c-mention
      edit-mode="direct"
      :options="load"
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.typeA"
      @load-error="() => {}"
    />
    <c-space>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending" @click="settle()">{{
        inlineCopy.resolve
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending" @click="settle(true)">{{
        inlineCopy.reject
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">
      {{ pending ? inlineCopy.pendingEditingRemainsAvailable : status }}
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Mention Props

`min-search-length` counts the query after the prefix; `auto-commit-single` automatically commits the sole enabled result.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value (v-model) | Controlled text; null displays as empty | string \| null | undefined |
| atomic | Enable encoded, indivisible mentions | boolean | false |
| fallback-option | Synchronously resolve an unmatched ID for display | `(value: string \| number \| boolean) => SelectOptionData \| null \| undefined` | undefined |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled text | string | '' |
| options | Candidate array or explicit loader, including nested groups | readonly (string \| number \| SelectOptionData \| SelectOptionGroup)[] \| ((query: string, context: { signal: AbortSignal }) => Array \| `Promise<Array>`) | undefined |
| min-search-length | Minimum number of characters required to start searching | number | 0 |
| search-delay | Remote search debounce delay in milliseconds | number | 0 |
| auto-commit-single | Automatically commit the sole enabled result | boolean | false |
| prefix | Trigger prefix; supports multiple characters and multiple prefixes | string \| string[] | '@' |
| split | Separator before and after a mention | string | ' ' |
| type | Input presentation | input \| textarea | input |
| disabled | Inherit Form when omitted; explicit false overrides it | boolean | undefined |
| readonly | Inherit Form when omitted; explicit false overrides it | boolean | undefined |
| clearable | Allow clearing text or the editor draft | boolean | false |
| loading | Manual waiting feedback; does not implicitly disable text editing | boolean | false |
| edit-mode | Editing mode, inherited from FormItem and Form | `'direct' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'` | `'direct'` |
| read-pretty | Independent read presentation; explicit false overrides the parent | `boolean` | `false` |
| empty-value | Clear output; explicit null is submitted unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `''` |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form | `readonly unknown[]` | `-` |
| empty-text | Read empty text; an explicit empty string is valid | `string` | `'-'` |
| before-commit | Guard before saving a deferred edit; return a boolean or Promise, or complete via done | `(payload: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown }, done: (allow?: boolean) => void, context: { signal: AbortSignal; event?: Event }) => void \| boolean \| Promise<void \| boolean>` | `-` |
| open | Controlled editor visibility, separate from native input focus | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Initial visibility of an uncontrolled editor | `boolean` | `false` |
| popup-container | Editor mount container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |

### Mention Events

| Event | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| change | value: string \| null; no native Event argument |
| search | query: string, prefix: string |
| select | value: SelectOptionValue \| undefined; from the actual leaf candidate |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| load-error | error: unknown; preserves the original loader error |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean; field editor only |

options is an explicit loader. search, change, select and load-error only notify; listener Promises are not collected. Direct input emits update:modelValue / change, and selection emits select / update:modelValue / change. Deferred editing updates a draft and submits the final model on confirmation.

### Mention Methods

| Method | Description | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | Focus the current target; deferred mode follows the field editing protocol | void |
| blur | Blur the current target without opening the editor | void |
| refresh | Retry the current options query with cancellation and failure handling, without opening the editor; static arrays issue no request | `Promise<void>` |

### Mention Slots

| Slot | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| option | Candidates in both input presentations; data: SelectOptionInfo, including key, raw, value and label |
| read | Reading content in both input presentations; value: string \| null, text: string |
| prefix / suffix | Input prefix and suffix for type=input only |
| clear-icon | Clear node in both input presentations; clear(event?: Event): void |

clear-icon replaces the entire clear node. A custom node must call clear and provide an accessible button. There is no default input replacement, empty or loader-error slot; option does not replace the field input.

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { MentionProps, MentionInstance, MentionEmits, MentionSlots, MentionExpose } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

Mention reuses Input/Textarea typography and spacing; its measurement mirror copies computed native input styles. Override the corresponding input variables. 

### Editing and confirmation

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

Both input and textarea show manual loading and waiting for the current explicit options loader. Displaying waiting does not disable editing. A search notification's returned Promise does not start a task. An old options request cannot clear a newer request's indicator, and load-error preserves the original error.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

### Mention ranges and grouped options

prefix accepts single characters, multiple characters and arrays of strings. Selection replaces only the matched prefix and query before the caret, preserving the trailing text; the textarea mirror uses the matched prefix. Nested option groups render nonselectable titles and only leaves may be selected; disabled leaves do not submit. The option slot receives normalized candidates, including the valid identities zero and empty string.

### Candidate feedback and instance boundaries

Explicit options loading appears in the current Input/Textarea field, whose native input announces aria-busy. Manual loading combines with request loading and text remains editable. With no available candidates the mention menu stays closed. Failure ends current waiting and emits the original load-error; business code chooses error presentation. Error strings are not inserted into candidates or text. refresh waits for one read attempt; failures notify through load-error without awaiting error-listener Promises.

disabled/readonly pause requests; deactivation, unmount and stale responses cannot update data. refresh may read while the field editor is closed without opening it. The candidate menu belongs to the internal input; public open/default-open controls only the deferred field editor. MentionProps, MentionEmits, MentionSlots and MentionExpose are exported consistently from root and mention subentries; MeasureInfo remains internal measurement state.

Mention is available in Cedar.

### Input and candidate relationships

input uses combobox, while textarea retains a multiline textbox. Both link to the actual listbox and active candidate with aria-autocomplete, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant. Closing suggestions or making the field readonly removes active references; arrow navigation keeps DOM focus in the native input.

Follow-up acceptance testing (not yet completed): use real screen readers, such as VoiceOver and NVDA, with supported browsers to verify spoken names when atomic mentions are initialized, suggestion navigation and selection, editing, and deletion of an entire mention.

```vue
  <p>当前值：{{ selectedValue }}。默认选中“账户”；父分支“设置”处于选中路径，但 active=false。</p>
  <c-space wrap>
    <c-menu v-model="selectedValue" :options="options" :hide-on-select="false" submenu-trigger="click">
      <c-button>渲染函数中的 active</c-button>
    </c-menu>
    <c-menu v-model="selectedValue" :options="options" :hide-on-select="false" submenu-trigger="click">
      <c-button>作用域插槽中的 active</c-button>
      <template #option-extra="{ active }">
        <c-tag :status="active ? 'primary' : 'default'">{{ active ? '当前项已选中' : '当前项未选中' }}</c-tag>
      </template>
    </c-menu>
    <c-menu v-model="selectedValue" :hide-on-select="false">
      <c-button>自定义子项与 highlight</c-button>
      <template #content>
        <c-menu-option value="account">
          <template #default="{ active }">账户：{{ active ? '已选中' : '未选中' }}</template>
        </c-menu-option>
        <c-menu-option value="help" :label="helpLabel" highlight />
      </template>
    </c-menu>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Option values

Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values.

### Switching triggers

Clicking another hover-open sibling trigger closes the previous menu. Clicking inside a submenu keeps its parent open.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Menus mounted externally inherit the source direction. Direction changes do not change selection.

## Size and elevation

`size` controls option line height and font `size`; `md` uses the default theme. `elevation=true` uses the default menu shadow, `false` removes it, and a number selects the corresponding global elevation level.

## Keyboard interaction

Enter, Space or an arrow key opens the menu from its trigger. Up/Down and Home/End move between enabled options; Enter or Space activates an option. The forward key enters a submenu and the backward key returns, following the reading direction. Escape requests closing the topmost menu; focus returns to its trigger after closing. Tab requests close and continues browser focus navigation. Editable inputs retain their text-editing keys.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected option value; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once, and later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence. Initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

### Menu Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: |
| options | Command tree | `MenuOptionData[]` | `[]` |
| field-names | `label/value/children/disabled` field mapping | `MenuFieldNames` | `-` |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Current active value for controlled highlighting | `MenuValue` | `-` |
| open **(v-model)** | Whether the popup is visible | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Uncontrolled default visibility | `boolean` | `false` |
| trigger | Root menu trigger | `'hover' \| 'click' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'` or an array | `'click'` |
| submenu-trigger | How every submenu level expands | `'hover' \| 'click'` | `'hover'` |
| placement | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `MenuPlacement`<br>`'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | `'bottom'` |
| `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | `'absolute' \| 'fixed'` | `'absolute'` |
| popup-container | Popup mount container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |
| popup-max-height | Default limit, pixel height, or unlimited | `boolean \| number` | `true` |
| hide-on-select | Close the popup after activating a command | `boolean` | `true` |
| auto-fit-popup-width | Match popup width to the trigger | `boolean` | `false` |
| disabled | Disable the menu | `boolean` | `false` |
| align-point | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | `boolean` | `false` |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled selected value | `MenuValue` | `-` |
| size | Menu item size | `MenuSize` | `md` |
| unmount-on-close | Unmount the panel after closing | `boolean` | `true` |
| reference | External trigger element or selector | `MenuReference` | `-` |
| popup-class | Positioning-layer class | `string / array / object` | `-` |
| offset-x | Horizontal offset relative to the trigger | `string / number` | `0` |
| offset-y | Vertical offset relative to the trigger | `string / number` | `0` |
| mouse-enter-delay | Hover-open delay in milliseconds | `number` | `100` |
| mouse-leave-delay | Hover-close delay in milliseconds | `number` | `100` |
| close-on-click-reference | Close when the trigger is clicked again | `boolean` | `true` |
| cover | Whether the popup covers its trigger | `boolean` | `false` |
| elevation | Default shadow, no shadow, or a specific elevation level | `boolean / number` | `true` |

### `MenuOptionData`

| Field | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| type | Plain command, group or divider | `'item' \| 'group' \| 'divider'` |
| label | Main content | `VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild` |
| icon | Leading icon | `VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild` |
| extra | Trailing content such as a shortcut | `VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild` |
| value | Value passed to events on activation | `any` |
| children | Child commands; a plain option with children becomes a submenu | `MenuOptionData[]` |
| disabled | Disable this item and its descendants | `boolean` |
| show | Whether to render | `boolean` |
| ripple | Ripple configuration (Cedar does not render ripples) | `boolean` |
| props | HTML attributes forwarded to the row element | `HTMLAttributes` |

The render context is `{ option, active, level }`. `type: 'group'` is visual only and does not add a level; `type: 'divider'` is neither focusable nor activatable.

### Menu Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Active value update request | `value: MenuValue` |
| open-change | Visibility update request | `open: boolean` |
| select | A menu item was activated | `value, option, event` |
| update:open | Open-state update request | `open: boolean` |
| key-escape | Root menu handles Escape | None |
| open / opened | Opening starts / completes | None |
| close / closed | Closing starts / completes | None |
| click-outside | Outside click on the topmost popup | `event: Event` |

### Menu Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Trigger element | - |
| content | Hand-written content, pairs with `MenuOption` | - |
| footer | Footer | - |
| option-label | Render every option's main content | `{ option, active, level }` |
| option-icon | Render every option's icon | `{ option, active, level }` |
| option-extra | Render every option's trailing content | `{ option, active, level }` |

### `<MenuOption>`

Use MenuOption for SplitButton actions or handwritten items in `content`. Configure `label`, `value`, `disabled`, `ripple` and `highlight`. Label renderers and the `default`, `icon` and `suffix` slots receive `{ option, active, level }`. Activating an item emits `click`. `highlight` changes appearance without selecting the value. Configure groups and submenus through `options`.



### Menu Methods

Use `open()` to open the menu, `close()` to close it, `resize()` to update positioning, and `setReference(reference?)` to change the trigger element.

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-menu-border-color: var(--c-color-fill-3);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

### Option state colors

Use `--c-menu-option-bg-selected` for selected rows and `--c-menu-option-bg-selected-hover` for their hover background. Disabled colors take precedence over selected, hover and focus styles.

# Message

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

```vue

  <c-button @click="handleClick">Info Message</c-button>

import { defineComponent } from "vue";
import { Message } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    return {
      handleClick() {
        Message.info("This is an info message");
      },
    };
  },
});
</script>
```

## Appearance and states

### Type

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Semantic status | Appearance Lab |
| `position` | Region of the message itself in the viewport: top/center/bottom, default top. Not positioned relative to a trigger | Appearance Lab |
| `closable` | Show the close button | Appearance Lab |
| `duration` | Auto-close duration in ms; `0` disables automatic closing | Appearance Lab |
| `variant` | Visual emphasis | Appearance Lab |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/message/__demos__/type.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div>
    <c-space>
      <c-button @click="() => Message.info('This is an info message!')"
        >Info Message</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        @click="() => Message.success('This is a success message!')"
        status="success"
        >Success Message
      </c-button>
      <c-button
        @click="() => Message.warning('This is a warning message!')"
        status="warning"
        >Warning Message
      </c-button>
      <c-button
        @click="() => Message.error('This is an error message!')"
        status="danger"
        >Error Message</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
  </div>
  <div style="margin-top: 20px">
    <c-space>
      <c-button @click="() => Message('This is a default message!')"
        >Default Message</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        @click="
          () =>
            Message({
              content: 'This is a default message!',
              icon: renderIcon,
            })
        "
        >Default Message With Icon
      </c-button>
      <c-button @click="handleLoading" status="primary"
        >Loading Message
      </c-button>
    </c-space>
  </div>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, h } from "vue";
import { IconExclamationCircleFill } from "@cedar-design/icons-vue";
import { Message } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const renderIcon = () => h(IconExclamationCircleFill);

    const handleLoading = () => {
      const message = Message.loading("This is a loading message!");
      setTimeout(() => {
        message.close();
        Message.success("Loaded");
      }, 2000);
    };

    return {
      renderIcon,
      handleLoading,
      Message,
    };
  },
});
</script>
```

```vue
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'neutral', value: 'neutral' },
            { label: 'tonal', value: 'tonal' },
            { label: 'solid', value: 'solid' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="status">
        <c-select
          v-model="__demoAppearance['status']"
          :clearable="false"
          :options="[
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
            { label: 'info', value: 'info' },
            { label: 'success', value: 'success' },
            { label: 'warning', value: 'warning' },
            { label: 'danger', value: 'danger' },
            { label: 'loading', value: 'loading' },
          ]"
          aria-label="status"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">{{ demoCopy.hint }}</p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      :aria-label="demoCopy.configuration"
      :options="
        demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({
          label: field.name,
          value: field.name,
        }))
      "
    />
    <c-space wrap
      ><c-button
        v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions"
        :key="String(sample)"
        @click="
          () => {
            __demoAppearance[demoCompareAxis] = sample;
            open = true;
          }
        "
        >{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</c-button
      ></c-space
    >
    <c-message
      v-model:open="open"
      position="center"
      closable
      :duration="0"
      v-bind="__demoAppearance"
    >
      Declarative message
      <template #action>
        <c-button size="sm" variant="text" @click="open = false"
          >Close</c-button
        >
      </template>
    </c-message>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo-config-comparison {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}

  min-width: 0;
}

  margin: 0 0 8px;
}
</style>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, icons and close-button spacing follow reading order. Direction changes do not alter message type, timers or closing. Programmatic calls use explicit configuration or document direction.

## Usage notes

### Component attribute forwarding

`Message.Component` forwards `id`, `class`, `style`, `aria-*` and native event listeners to its actual `role="alert"` region: the Cedar message root or the Maple inner visible panel. Each attribute is applied once. Required internal roles and classes remain; component lifecycle listeners such as `open` are not bound as DOM listeners. Native attributes update with the parent in both inline and Teleport modes. `dir` continues to determine reading direction. A function service `id` identifies the message for updates and is separate from a component native DOM `id`.
### Configuration

Visual variant is independent of status. neutral uses a neutral popup and status icon; tonal uses a low-emphasis status background with dark content; solid uses a high-emphasis fill and matching foreground. Cedar/Maple both default to neutral; explicit solid/tonal have matching visual semantics. default/loading solid retains a dark background, with the loading icon indicating progress. Both export MessageVariant; function calls, setDefaultOptions and same-id updates support variant.

Exceptions from close/closed notification callbacks do not retain closed entries or empty manager hosts. Resource cleanup is independent of callback execution.

## API

### Message Options

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------- |
| `open` | Controlled visibility Supports `v-model:open`. | `boolean` | `false` |
| id | Unique queue identifier; the same id updates the existing instance | `string \| number` | Automatically generated |
| status | Semantic status | `default \| info \| success \| warning \| danger \| loading` | `default` |
| variant | Visual emphasis | `neutral \| tonal \| solid` | `neutral` |
| position | Region of the message itself in the viewport: top/center/bottom, default top. Not positioned relative to a trigger | `top \| center \| bottom` | `top` |
| content | Content | `MessageContent` | - |
| icon | Custom icon | `MessageContent` | - |
| action | Action-area content | `MessageContent` | - |
| duration | Auto-close duration in ms; `0` disables automatic closing | `number` | `3000` |
| showIcon | Whether to show the status icon | `boolean` | `true` |
| closable | Show the close button | `boolean` | `false` |
| pauseOnHover | Pause while hovered | `boolean` | `false` |
| resetOnUpdate | Whether same-id updates reset the complete duration | `boolean` | `false` |
| closeButtonAriaLabel | Close button label | `string` | `Close message` |
| popupContainer | Mount container; function-call queues are isolated by container and position | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |

Function options additionally accept `onOpen / onOpened / onClose / onClosed`. Close callbacks receive the current `id`.

### Message Events

`update:open`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, and `closed`, emitted once per visibility cycle. When an initially open message hydrates, it skips the initial enter animation and emits `opened` after `open` on mount.

### Message Methods

| Method | Description |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `Message(options \| string)` | Open a default message |
| `Message.info/success/warning/error/loading(...)` | Open a message with the corresponding status |
| `Message.clear(position?)` | Clear all messages or a specified position |
| `Message.setDefaultOptions(options)` | Set defaults for subsequent calls |
| `Message.resetDefaultOptions()` | Restore defaults |

Returns `{ close() }`; repeated calls do not repeat closing. A handle owns a specific message item: it remains valid for same-id updates of that item, but cannot close a new item after the old item completed leaving and its id was reused.

The optional second appContext argument applies to each message: injections, registered components, global properties and error handling use that application context. It does not capture a local Provider at the call site. Applications still share one queue and chronological stack per target/position; Message.clear continues clearing across applications. Each call uses its explicit context, then the current install default. An update with no available context retains the existing item scope. Switching a same-id item to another available context remounts its presentation and restarts its duration while keeping its business handle valid; other items keep their presentation and timers.

`Message.Component` retains its real Props and instance types. Its `restartTimer()` instance method resets only while active, open and resetOnUpdate=true. It is not a service-handle method; while hover-paused, it resets only the saved remaining duration.

| Component instance method | Description |
| ---- | ---- |
| restartTimer() | Reset the current duration, subject to active, open, resetOnUpdate and hover-pause state |

`MessageContent` is `VNodeChild | (() => VNodeChild)`: text, numbers, empty boolean children, VNodes, nested child arrays and synchronous render functions. Arbitrary plain objects and asynchronous tasks are not renderable content. content, icon and action share this protocol; local slots take precedence.

duration must be finite and nonnegative. Negative values, NaN and Infinity do not schedule automatic closure and trigger development prop validation. Zero stays open; restartTimer follows the same rules.

### Message Slots

`default`、`icon`、`action`。


Messages automatically stay above active popups in the current document and track newly opened popups and explicit `zIndex` changes. They do not take over dialog focus or Esc handling. `--c-message-z-index` sets the minimum message stacking level. Custom mount containers must still avoid ancestor stacking contexts and clipping constraints.

## CSS Variables

Colors use `--c-message-{variant}-{status}-{bg|content-color|icon-color|border-color|close-color}`. bg sets the panel background; content-color sets body/action text unless separately styled; icon-color sets status icons; border-color sets borders; close-color sets close controls. With a custom background, verify all three foregrounds. Geometry retains platform density rather than forcing equal defaults. Variables must affect actual Teleport-container ancestors.

| `--c-message-tonal-success-icon-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-success)` | `color` |
| `--c-message-tonal-warning-bg` | `var(--c-color-warning-light-1)` | `background-color` |
| `--c-message-tonal-warning-border-color` | `transparent` | `border-color` |
| `--c-message-tonal-warning-close-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-primary)` | `color` |
| `--c-message-tonal-warning-content-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-primary)` | `color` |
| `--c-message-tonal-warning-icon-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-warning)` | `color` |
| `--c-message-transition-duration` | `var(--c-transition-duration-1)` | `animation`, `transition` |
| `--c-message-transition-duration-icon` | `var(--c-transition-duration-4)` | `animation` |
| `--c-message-transition-timing-function` | `var(--c-transition-timing-function-linear)` | `animation`, `transition` |
| `--c-message-transition-timing-function-icon` | `var(--c-transition-timing-function-overshoot)` | `animation` |
| `--c-message-wrapper-margin-bottom` | `var(--c-spacing-12)` | `bottom` |
| `--c-message-wrapper-margin-top` | `var(--c-spacing-12)` | `top` |
| `--c-message-wrapper-padding-horizontal` | `var(--c-spacing-5)` | `padding` |
| `--c-message-z-index` | `var(--c-z-index-message)` | `z-index` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-message-border-radius: var(--c-border-radius-sm);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

Example source: src/nav-menu/__demos__/items-horizontal.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import type { NavMenuKey, NavMenuOption } from '..'

const category = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null)
const region = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null)
const keyword = ref('')
const appliedKeyword = ref('')
const categories: NavMenuOption[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: '全部分类' },
  { key: 'design', label: '设计资源' },
  { key: 'development', label: '开发工具' },
]
const regions: NavMenuOption[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: '全部地区' },
  { key: 'east', label: '华东' },
  { key: 'south', label: '华南' },
  { key: 'north', label: '华北' },
]
const categoryLabel = computed(() => categories.find((item) => item.key === category.value)?.label ?? '未选择')
const regionLabel = computed(() => regions.find((item) => item.key === region.value)?.label ?? '未选择')
function resetFilters(close: () => void) {
  keyword.value = ''
  appliedKeyword.value = ''
  close()
}
function applyFilters(close: () => void) {
  appliedKeyword.value = keyword.value.trim()
  close()
}
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-nav-menu mode="horizontal">
      <c-nav-menu-item v-model="category" label="分类" :options="categories" />
      <c-nav-menu-item
        v-model="region"
        label="地区"
        :options="regions"
        options-mode="horizontal"
        popup-layout="full-width"
      />
      <c-nav-menu-item label="更多筛选" :highlight="!!appliedKeyword" popup-layout="full" :hide-on-select="false">
        <template #content="{ close }">
          <div style="height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px">
            <div style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto">
              <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
                <strong>按关键词筛选</strong>
                <c-input v-model="keyword" placeholder="输入资源名称" aria-label="资源名称" />
              </c-space>
            </div>
            <c-space>
              <c-button @click="resetFilters(close)">重置</c-button>
              <c-button @click="applyFilters(close)">应用</c-button>
            </c-space>
          </div>
        </template>
      </c-nav-menu-item>
    </c-nav-menu>
    <p aria-live="polite">分类：{{ categoryLabel }}；地区：{{ regionLabel }}；关键词：{{ appliedKeyword || '不限' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

Example source: src/nav-menu/__demos__/item-label.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import type { NavMenuKey } from "../types";

const options = [
  { key: 0, label: "全部分类" },
  { key: "design", label: "设计" },
  { key: "development", label: "开发" },
];
const activeItem = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null);
const automatic = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null);
const fixed = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null);
const manual = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null);
const manualLabel = ref("手动标题");
const appliedValue = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null);
const automaticLabel = computed(
  () =>
    options.find((option) => option.key === automatic.value)?.label ?? "未选择",
);
const fixedLabel = computed(
  () => options.find((option) => option.key === fixed.value)?.label ?? "未选择",
);
const selectedLabel = computed(
  () =>
    options.find((option) => option.key === manual.value)?.label ?? "未选择",
);
const pending = computed(() => manual.value !== appliedValue.value);

function applyLabel() {
  if (manual.value === null) return;
  manualLabel.value = `当前：${selectedLabel.value}`;
  appliedValue.value = manual.value;
}

function reset() {
  manual.value = appliedValue.value = null;
  manualLabel.value = "手动标题";
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="item-label-demo">
    <c-nav-menu v-model:active-item="activeItem" mode="horizontal">
      <c-nav-menu-item
        v-model="automatic"
        name="automatic"
        label="自动标题"
        :options="options"
      />
      <c-nav-menu-item v-model="fixed" name="fixed" :options="options">
        <template #label>固定标题</template>
      </c-nav-menu-item>
      <c-nav-menu-item v-model="manual" name="manual" :options="options">
        <template #label>{{ manualLabel }}</template>
      </c-nav-menu-item>
    </c-nav-menu>

    <div class="item-label-demo__status" aria-live="polite">
      <p>
        <strong>自动标题：</strong>选择后入口直接显示“{{ automaticLabel }}”。
      </p>
      <p>
        <strong>固定标题：</strong>入口始终显示“固定标题”，当前选择“{{
          fixedLabel
        }}”。
      </p>
      <p>
        <strong>手动标题：</strong>当前选择“{{ selectedLabel }}”，入口显示“{{
          manualLabel
        }}”。
        <span v-if="pending">选择尚未应用到标题。</span>
      </p>
    </div>

    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending || manual === null" @click="applyLabel">
        {{ pending ? `应用手动标题：${selectedLabel}` : "手动标题已同步" }}
      </c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置手动标题</c-button>
    </c-space>

    <p class="item-label-demo__tip">
      当前激活入口：{{ activeItem ?? "暂无" }}。打开入口不会激活，选择叶子节点后才会统一切换高亮；各面板内部数据仍各自保留。
    </p>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.item-label-demo {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-width: 0;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: 220px;
}

.item-label-demo__status {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.item-label-demo__status p,
.item-label-demo__tip {
  margin: 0;
}

.item-label-demo__tip {
  color: var(--c-color-text-3);
}
</style>
```

## Data and state control

### Controlled

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | Navigation tree | Controlled |
| `model-value` | Current selected key; supports v-model. null means no selection | Controlled |
| `expanded-keys` | Controlled expanded branches | Controlled |
| `field-names` | Field mapping for key/label/children/disabled | Controlled |
| `disabled` | Globally disable selection/user expansion | Controlled |
| `default-value` | Initial uncontrolled selected value | Controlled |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `options`: Supplies the available options.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.

Example source: src/nav-menu/__demos__/controlled.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { NavMenuKey } from '../types'
import { options } from './data'
const selected = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(0)
const expanded = ref<NavMenuKey[]>([])
const acceptUpdates = ref(true)
const lastRequest = ref('尚未操作')
function select(key: NavMenuKey | null) {
  lastRequest.value = `请求选择：${key}`
  if (acceptUpdates.value) selected.value = key
}
function expand(keys: NavMenuKey[]) {
  lastRequest.value = `请求展开：${keys.join('、') || '无'}`
  if (acceptUpdates.value) expanded.value = keys
}
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="acceptUpdates = !acceptUpdates">{{ acceptUpdates ? '当前接受更新，点击拒绝' : '当前拒绝更新，点击接受' }}</c-button>
    <c-nav-menu :options="options" :model-value="selected" :expanded-keys="expanded" @update:model-value="select" @update:expanded-keys="expand" />
    <p aria-live="polite">{{ lastRequest }}；实际选中：{{ selected }}；实际展开：{{ expanded.join('、') || '无' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

Example source: src/nav-menu/__demos__/item-controlled.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const accepted = ref(true)
const open = ref(false)
const value = ref<string | number | null>(null)
const options = [
  { key: 0, label: '不限' },
  { key: 'design', label: '设计' },
  { key: 'disabled', label: '禁用选项', disabled: true },
]
function updateOpen(next: boolean) {
  if (accepted.value) {
    open.value = next
  }
}
function updateValue(next: string | number | null) {
  if (accepted.value) {
    value.value = next
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-button @click="accepted = !accepted">{{
    accepted ? '当前接受更新，点击拒绝' : '当前拒绝更新，点击接受'
  }}</c-button>
  <c-nav-menu>
    <c-nav-menu-item
      :open="open"
      :model-value="value"
      :options="options"
      label="受控筛选"
      @update:open="updateOpen"
      @update:model-value="updateValue"
    />
    <c-nav-menu-item label="禁用入口" disabled :options="options" />
  </c-nav-menu>
  <p>选中：{{ value ?? '未选择' }}；展开：{{ open }}</p>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Configuration

`popup-layout="full"` starts at the bottom edge of the trigger, spans the viewport width and fills the remaining viewport height below it. On Maple, the same layout starts below the entire filter bar. Mobile defaults to full-width; desktop defaults to dropdown.

Set a local mode with an outer `<c-theme-provider theme="dark">`. This component has no theme prop. Nest theme="light" for a light region; library popups follow their owning provider.

## API

### NavMenu Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| options | Navigation tree | NavMenuOption[] | [] |
| model-value | Current selected key; supports v-model. null means no selection | string / number / null | undefined |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled selected value | string / number / null | null |
| active-item | Controlled named NavMenu.Item activation; supports v-model:active-item | string / number / null | undefined |
| default-active-item | Initial uncontrolled named NavMenu.Item activation | string / number / null | null |
| expanded-keys | Controlled expanded branches | (string / number)[] | undefined |
| default-expanded-keys | Initial uncontrolled expanded branches | (string / number)[] | [] |
| default-expand-all | Initially expand every branch | boolean | false |
| auto-expand-selected | Expand selected-item ancestors in vertical noncollapsed mode; controlled mode requests updates | boolean | true |
| accordion | Expand only one branch per level | boolean | false |
| mode | Navigation orientation | vertical / horizontal | vertical |
| collapsed | Collapsed state; supports v-model:collapsed | boolean | undefined |
| default-collapsed | Initial uncontrolled collapsed state | boolean | false |
| size | Size | xs / sm / md / lg / xl | md |
| disabled | Globally disable selection/user expansion | boolean | false |
| field-names | Field mapping for key/label/children/disabled | NavMenuFieldNames | Same-name fields by default |
| responsive | Enable horizontal overflow collection | boolean | true |
| indent | Indent per level in px | number | 24 |
| root-indent | Root indent in px | number | 12 |
| collapsed-width | Collapsed width in px | number | 56 |
| icon-size | Icon size in px | number | 20 |
| popup-container | Popup mount container; false renders locally | Matching Trigger type | Inherits Trigger definition |
| popup-class | Additional popup class | string / array / object | — |
| overflow-label | Overflow entry label; follows the current locale when omitted | string | Localized More |
| node-props | Node DOM attributes/events; internal selection, disabled and keyboard semantics remain | (context) => Record<string, unknown> | — |

Controlled props follow supplied values; update events are requests only. `default-*` initializes once, not on later changes. Selection and expansion are independent. `showOption` does not select.

### Platform correspondence

On both platforms, a panel is created on first opening and remains mounted after closing or switching entries by default. Internal drafts and expanded branches are preserved. With `unmount-on-close`, content unmounts after the closing transition and is recreated on reopening, without clearing the Item's own selection. Business code defines draft commit, reset and filter application timing.

Root `close()` only requests closing Item panels and restores entry focus. It does not change selected values, active-item or desktop navigation-tree expanded-keys. A controlled open that rejects updates stays open. An entry with neither options nor a content slot does not open; arriving async options render according to current open state. KeepAlive deactivation hides panels and requests closing; reactivation still follows the controlled value.

Item selection, open state, events, slot contexts and `select/close/setOpen` methods are consistent. Both roots expose `close/resize/setActiveItem`. `name` must be unique in the current menu; changing it releases the old `name`. Names may swap or be reused during reordering in one update, with duplicates checked after the update. Vertical options expand the current value's available ancestor path on initialization or controlled value/options updates, while users can still collapse branches manually.

| Capability | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Root menu | Options navigation tree or Item entries; vertical by default | Item filter bar only; horizontal by default |
| popup-layout | dropdown (default) / full-width / full-height / full | full-width (default) / full |
| Panel origin | Below the current entry | Below the entire filter bar; a standalone Item uses its own lower edge |
| Trigger and positioning | trigger / placement | Click to open downward |
| Overlay and scrolling | Nonmodal; does not lock background scrolling | Root overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| Code Theme | Controlled by the local ThemeProvider theme | Follows the global theme; no theme prop |
| Navigation-tree methods only | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

Each library exports `NavMenuPopupLayout` with its supported values. Maple's `NavMenuMode` is horizontal only; `options-mode` supports both orientations. The default entry slot replaces the entry's inner content. Maple renders it inside a native button: use non-interactive text/icons and place forms and action buttons in the content slot.

### Arrow direction

Horizontal dropdowns point down when closed/up when open. Vertical inline branches point right/down. Right-opening submenus point right/left. Independent Item arrows follow placement and reverse when open. Arrows follow actual open state, not unaccepted controlled proposals.

### Keyboard

Vertical Up/Down and horizontal Left/Right move focus; Home/End reach first/last. Right expands vertical branches, Down opens horizontal branches, Left returns to parents. Escape closes the current popup and restores reference focus. Enter/Space activates nodes. Disabled nodes are skipped; inputs retain native keys. If narrowing moves a focused item into overflow, focus moves to the overflow entry.

### NavMenuOption Events

| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| update:model-value | key / null |
| update:active-item | name / null |
| update:expanded-keys | keys |
| update:collapsed | collapsed |
| select | key, original option, original Event |

### NavMenuOption Slots

The default slot contains independent `CNavMenuItem` entries. When present, horizontal menus scroll rather than using `responsive` overflow collection.

label/icon/extra render functions, same-name slots and nodeProps receive `{ option, active, expanded, level }`. `active` means this node itself matches modelValue; ancestor-path emphasis is internal. `expanded` describes branch expansion; level starts at 0.

### NavMenuOption Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| close() | Request closing Item panels and restore focus without changing tree expansion |
| showOption(key?) | Expand ancestors of the specified item, defaulting to current selection; does not select |
| scrollTo(key?) | Expand then scroll to an item; controlled expansion requires parent acceptance |
| resize() | Manually remeasure horizontal overflow |
| setCollapsed(value) | Update uncontrolled collapse or request a controlled update |
| setActiveItem(value) | Update uncontrolled named-Item activation or request a controlled update |

### NavMenuItem Props

When using the content slot, the custom panel takes its accessible name from the entry. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby on the entry when needed. Ensure custom entries have a meaningful name.

Titles follow matching selected options by default. `label` slots take highest precedence: use `<template #label>Advanced filters</template>` for fixed titles or bind a separate reactive variable for manual titles.

`v-model` stores panel selection. Slot `active` indicates business entry state: named entries in a root menu compare root activeItem with name; independent entries match their main value against ordinary options, including 0/empty string. Unknown values/groups/dividers do not activate independent entries. `highlight` overrides emphasis only: true forces it, false removes it, omission follows `active`. It changes neither `active` nor value. Opening a panel does not activate the entry.

`CNavMenuItem` (also `NavMenu.Item`) is an independent top-level entry outside root navigation-tree `modelValue`. Without `name`, each Item highlights from its own value, allowing simultaneous category/region filters. With unique names, root `activeItem/defaultActiveItem` maintains one highlighted entry. Both modes allow only one open Item panel without clearing other panels’ values. Ordinary root navigation uses `options + v-model`. Entries define their own `options` or replace panels through `content`. default customizes the entry; `label`/`icon` customize parts; `option-label`/`option-icon`/`option-extra` customize `options`.

Horizontal menus with default slots scroll rather than collecting entries into overflow, avoiding cloned form content. Pure `options` menus retain automatic overflow collection.  Item panels within one NavMenu are mutually exclusive. Clicking another entry requests closing the previous one; controlled open requires parent acceptance.

| Item prop | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | Stable unique entry identifier; root activeItem makes named entries mutually exclusive. highlight separately overrides appearance | — |
| label | Entry title when unselected or selection does not match options; supports VNode/render functions | — |
| options | Menu options, using the same structure as NavMenu | `[]` |
| field-names | Option field mapping, consistent with NavMenu | `undefined` |
| model-value | Controlled selected key (string, number or null); supports v-model | `undefined` |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled selected key (string, number or null); read only at initialization | `null` |
| highlight | Visual emphasis override without changing active/selection; defaults to active | — |
| hide-on-select | Close the panel after select | `true` |
| unmount-on-close | Destroy panel content after the closing transition; retain it by default | false |
| open | Controlled open state; supports v-model:open | `undefined` |
| default-open | Initial uncontrolled open state; read only at initialization | `false` |
| disabled | Disable the entry, also respecting parent menu disabled | `undefined` |
| trigger | Trigger mode | `click` |
| placement | Ordinary dropdown placement; full-height right/left placements align to the corresponding entry edge | `bottom-start` |
| popup-layout | `dropdown`: standard `dropdown` / `full-width`: `full` width below the trigger / `full-height`: `full` height on the right / `full`: fills the available width and height below the trigger | `dropdown` |
| popup-style | Panel CSS; may override full-height width/direction/dimensions | — |
| popup-container | Popup mount container; inherits the parent menu when omitted | Follow parent menu |
| popup-class | Additional popup classes; inherits the parent menu when omitted | Follow parent menu |
| options-mode | Horizontal/vertical default options-panel layout | `vertical` |

Entry/`content` slots receive `{ modelValue, selectedOption, active, open, select, close }`. select(key,event?) emits `update:modelValue` and select(key,option,event). Custom panels may select outside options, making option undefined and independent active false; use highlight if emphasis is needed. `close()` closes/restores entry focus. Controlled values affect titles/active only after acceptance. Entry-slot active is entry state, while label-render active compares its context option with the Item value. `hideOnSelect` is independent of acceptance; set false for manual confirmation.

Item also emits `update:open`/entry `click` and exposes `select`/`close`/`setOpen`. Full-width/full-height popups are nonmodal without scroll locks/focus traps. They default to body; custom containers must avoid ancestor transforms changing the fixed-position reference.

## Types

### NavMenuOption

```ts
interface NavMenuOption {
  key?: string | number
  type?: 'item' | 'group' | 'divider'
  label?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  icon?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  extra?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  children?: NavMenuOption[]
  disabled?: boolean
  show?: boolean
  props?: HTMLAttributes
}
```

Ordinary options require unique stable keys, using mapped keys when fieldNames is supplied. Numeric 0 is valid. Groups/dividers may omit keys, though explicit keys are recommended for dynamic reordering. Duplicate keys/missing ordinary-item keys throw to prevent ambiguous selection paths. show=false hides nodes/subtrees. Disabled branches propagate downward. Ordinary branches expand; leaves select.

## Design reference

The workspace Naive UI 2.44.1 Menu informed option trees, ancestor paths and content rendering. No Naive UI/TreeMate runtime dependency is introduced. Local Trigger provides popups; public APIs follow Cedar names.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

NavMenu inherits the nearest native `dir` and supports runtime changes. Horizontal Left/Right navigation follows reading direction; vertical Up/Down does not reverse. In RTL, Left expands/enters a submenu and Right collapses/returns; LTR uses the opposite mapping. Escape closes the popover and returns focus to its trigger.

Nested data-menu popovers prefer inline end and adjust when space is limited, inheriting their source scope. Explicit `NavMenu.Item` physical `placement` keeps its meaning. Direction changes do not select a menu item or clear filter values.

## CSS Variables

The menu and its submenus share theme variables. `--c-nav-menu-light-bg` controls the background and `--c-nav-menu-light-item-bg-hover` controls hover backgrounds; use the corresponding variables below for selected and disabled states. Variables whose names contain `light` apply in both light and dark themes. Use ThemeProvider to theme a local menu and its popups.

# Notification

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/notification/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-button @click="handleNotification"> Open Notification </c-button>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { Notification } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'

const handleNotification = () => {
  Notification.info({
    title: 'Notification',
    content: 'This is a notification!',
    closable: true,
    closeButtonAriaLabel: 'Dismiss notification',
  })
}
</script>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Explicit left/right popup corners remain physical. Icons, content, close actions and footer actions follow reading direction. Programmatic calls use explicit or document direction without borrowing another application instance's context.

## Usage notes

### Configuration

After Teleport, theme variables follow actual DOM ancestors. Variables inside content do not propagate upward to service-created containers.

Exceptions from close/closed notification callbacks do not retain closed entries or empty manager hosts. Resource cleanup is independent of callback execution.

## API

clear removes entries and releases their IDs synchronously. Adding the same ID afterward creates a new entry with a full display duration. Ordinary updates keep active entries in place, and clear does not additionally invoke the business onClose callback. Reduced motion disables built-in enter/leave transitions and movement while retaining static layout, colors and display duration.

duration (default 3000ms; 0 stays open) is a business display timer, not CSS animation duration. close notifies once per mounted instance and immediately cancels timers. Updates/repeated closing during leave do not reschedule auto-close. reset-on-update restarts only active, unclosed instances. KeepAlive deactivation cancels timing; reactivation restarts the full configured duration. Unmounting/stale callbacks emit no delayed close. TransitionGroup unmounts after actual leave completion, independently of duration. Six transition-* tokens control opacity/left/right enter/leave without changing auto-close deadlines.

### Notification Methods

`Notification` global methods can be used in three ways:

1. Call `this.$notification`
2. In Composition API, call `getCurrentInstance().appContext.config.globalProperties.$notification`
3. Import `Notification` and call its methods directly

All these entry points support `remove` and `clear`. Without a DOM on the server, notification methods return a no-op handle whose `close()` is safe to call. No notification is created or automatically replayed on the client.

Import-based calls cannot obtain the current Vue Context. AppContext injections such as i18n or route
must be supplied manually in the call, or by configuring a global AppContext for the component.

```ts
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import { Notification } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'

const app = createApp(App)
Notification._context = app._context
```

## Types

### NotificationMethod

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :----: |
| info | Show an information notification | `(    config: string \| NotificationConfig,    appContext?: AppContext  ) => NotificationReturn` | `-` |
| success | Show a success notification | `(    config: string \| NotificationConfig,    appContext?: AppContext  ) => NotificationReturn` | `-` |
| warning | Show a warning notification | `(    config: string \| NotificationConfig,    appContext?: AppContext  ) => NotificationReturn` | `-` |
| error | Show an error notification | `(    config: string \| NotificationConfig,    appContext?: AppContext  ) => NotificationReturn` | `-` |
| remove | Clear the notification with the specified `id` | `(id: string) => void` | `-` |
| clear | Clear all notifications | `(position?: NotificationPosition) => void`<br>`NotificationPosition: 'top-right' \| 'top-left' \| 'bottom-right' \| 'bottom-left'` | `-` |

### NotificationConfig

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default | Version |
| ---------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | :-----: | :----- |
| content | Content | `RenderContent` | `-` |  |
| title | Title | `RenderContent` | `-` |  |
| icon | Icon | `RenderFunction` | `-` |  |
| id | Unique id | `string` | `-` |  |
| style | Style | `CSSProperties` | `-` |  |
| class | Class name | `ClassName` | `-` |  |
| position | Physical corner of the notification itself in the viewport, default top-right. Corner values use vertical-first kebab-case spelling | `'top-left'\|'top-right'\|'bottom-left'\|'bottom-right'` | `top-right` |  |
| showIcon | Whether to show the icon | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| closable | Whether closable | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| duration | Display duration in `ms` | `number` | `3000` |  |
| footer | Footer content | `RenderFunction` | `-` | 2.25.0 |
| closeIcon | Close-button icon | `RenderFunction` | `-` |  |
| closeIconElement | Close-button element | `RenderFunction` | `-` |  |
| closeButtonAriaLabel | Accessible name for the close button | `string` | `Close notification` |  |
| onClose | Close callback | `(id: number \| string) => void` | `-` |  |

`NotificationConfig` configures service calls; `NotificationProps` describes the underlying view fields `type`, `showIcon`, `closable`, `duration`, `resetOnUpdate`, and `closeButtonAriaLabel` and is not the service configuration. Updating an active ID resets its timer only when `duration` is explicitly supplied; otherwise the current timer continues.

### NotificationReturn

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------ | ------------------ | ------------ | :----: |
| close | Close the current notification | `() => void` | `-` |

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { NotificationInstance, NotificationConfig, NotificationReturn } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```

## CSS Variables

Panels use surface-overlay; body/title use content-primary; close buttons use content-secondary; borders use border-default. Status icons use readable status content colors; loading uses content-brand. Colors are grouped by status. Custom backgrounds require checking content/icon/close contrast. Plain-text actions/footers inherit panel content color; applications own independently styled slots.

wrapper-* controls list position/spacing; padding-*/margin-* control panel layout; icon-*/title-*/content-* control typography; close-* controls close buttons; border-*/box-shadow control borders/shadows; transition-* controls motion; z-index controls stacking. Existing geometry/motion defaults remain. The table lists actual declarations, not a claim that every historical geometry variable has verified consumers.
