## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

`directions` selects resize-handle edges. The default is the right edge; multiple edges can be enabled.

## API

### ResizeBox Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| width **(v-model)** | CSS width under the current box model; finite nonnegative pixels | `number` | `undefined` |
| height **(v-model)** | CSS height under the current box model; finite nonnegative pixels | `number` | `undefined` |
| component | Root HTML tag; supply a valid tag name | `string` | `'div'` |
| directions | Unique physical edges; an empty array removes all handles | `ResizeBoxDirection[]`<br>`ResizeBoxDirection: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `['right']` |

### ResizeBox Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| update:width | Width update request; controlled mode waits for parent writeback | width: `number` |
| update:height | Height update request; controlled mode waits for parent writeback | height: `number` |
| moving-start | Emitted when dragging starts | ev: `MouseEvent` |
| moving | Emitted during dragging | size: `{ width: number; height: number; }`<br>ev: `MouseEvent` |
| moving-end | Emitted when dragging ends | ev: `MouseEvent` |

### ResizeBox Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------------------- | :----------: | --------------------------------------------------- |
| default | Unscoped resizable-box content | - |
| resize-trigger | Resize-handle content | direction: `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` |
| resize-trigger-icon | Resize-handle icon | direction: `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` |

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { ResizeBoxInstance, ResizeBoxProps, ResizeBoxDirection } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```

## Reading direction and interaction

ResizeBox `directions` are physical edges: left stays left and right stays right in RTL. Handles and width/height meanings do not reverse. Moving the left handle left or the right handle right increases width; moving the top handle up or bottom handle down increases height. The minimum dimension is zero.

Focusable handles expose a spinbutton for finite nonnegative pixel dimensions without a fixed upper bound. aria-valuemin is 0; no fictitious aria-valuemax is supplied. Names and pixel value text follow Locale/ConfigProvider. Mouse and touch pointers retain physical-edge resizing.

Up increases and Down decreases the current width or height by 10px. Shift or PageUp/PageDown uses 50px; Home requests 0 and End does nothing. Left/right handles also retain physical-edge Left/Right shortcuts. Top/bottom handles interpret Up/Down as numeric changes, rather than edge movement. Text inherits native direction. Direction changes, removal of an active handle, deactivation and unmount release gesture listeners and the temporary cursor.

## Dimensions and box sizing

width, height and update events use CSS dimensions under the current box-sizing: border-box includes border and padding, while content-box means the content area. Measurement, keyboard/pointer deltas and writes share this dimension without deducting handle padding twice. Controlled mode only requests parent updates; without acceptance, both size and accessible value remain unchanged.

## Dragging and cancellation

An accepted mouse or pointer drag produces exactly one end notification on release, cancellation, configuration changes, KeepAlive deactivation or unmounting. Listeners and cursor ownership are released before notification. ResizeBox retains moving-start/moving-end; Split retains move-start/move-end. When no native terminal mouse event exists, the end argument is the original press event. Discrete keyboard adjustments emit value updates without creating drag start/end events. Ending stops the gesture without rolling back an applied dimension or awaiting a listener’s returned promise.

Zero width/height is valid. Invalid numbers are not written to CSS and behave as omitted dimensions. Invalid edge lists produce no handles; valid array edges are retained and deduplicated, with standard Vue development diagnostics. Public Props include model-update and drag-notification listeners; returned promises are not collected.

```ts
import type { ResizeBoxProps, ResizeBoxDirection } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
const edge: ResizeBoxDirection = 'right'
const props: ResizeBoxProps = { width: 200, directions: [edge], 'onUpdate:width': (width) => console.log(width) }
```

# Result

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

- `status`: Selects the semantic state.

```vue
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

  <c-result data-demo-result :status="status" :title="'Result: ' + status" subtitle="Local state preview">
    <template #extra>
      <c-space wrap>
        <c-button status="primary" @click="index = (index + 1) % statuses.length">Next status</c-button>
        <c-button @click="index = 0">Reset status</c-button>
      </c-space>
      <p aria-live="polite">Current status: {{ status }}</p>
    </template>
  </c-result>
</template>
```

# Ripple

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/ripple/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Ripple } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
import "@cedar-design/ui-vue/ripple/style";

const vRipple = Ripple;
const disabled = ref(false);
</script>

<template>
  <c-space wrap>
    <div role="button" tabindex="0" v-ripple="{ disabled }" class="ripple-demo"
      >Ripple</div
    >
    <div
      role="button" tabindex="0"
      v-ripple="{ disabled }"
      class="ripple-demo ripple-demo--long"
      >600ms 扩散／800ms 消退</div
    >
    <c-button @click="disabled = !disabled">{{
      disabled ? "启用水波" : "禁用水波"
    }}</c-button>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.ripple-demo--long {
  --c-ripple-expand-duration: 600ms;
  --c-ripple-fade-duration: 800ms;
}
.ripple-demo {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 8px 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-sys-color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--c-sys-radius-sm);
  color: var(--c-sys-color-action-primary);
  background: var(--c-sys-color-surface-overlay);
  cursor: pointer;
}
</style>
```

## Options

| Options | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| color | Ripple color | `string` | `currentColor` |
| disabled | Prevent ripples and cancel pending animation | `boolean` | `false` |

Use `v-ripple="{ color, disabled }"`. Unmount cancels animations/timers and removes listeners; each element maintains independent keyboard state.

## Styles

For direct directive registration, import `@cedar-design/ui-vue/ripple/style`. Runtime imports no CSS, supporting SSR package imports. Variables use `--c-ripple-*` and are declared in `style/token.less`. Theme defaults may differ from mobile while motion/consumption protocols stay aligned.

| Variable | Default | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| --c-ripple-color | currentColor | Ripple background; color option takes precedence |
| --c-ripple-cubic-bezier | cubic-bezier(0.68, 0.01, 0.62, 0.6) | Transform expansion easing |
| --c-ripple-expand-duration | 200ms | Transform expansion duration |
| --c-ripple-fade-duration | 140ms | Linear opacity appear/fade duration |

Variables belong on the actual directive host and inherit into ripples. Defaults currently match across platforms. 250ms is the minimum postcreation display/postfade removal wait, not visual duration or the entire lifecycle. Runtime reads computed transition duration/delay. Fade waits until the later of creation+250ms or activation+expansion duration; removal waits max(250ms, fade duration). Long overrides are not truncated. 0ms/unstyled retain cleanup floors. Reduced motion hides decoration. Expansion samples on creation/activation, fade on fade start; arbitrary midphase CSS changes/animations are not guaranteed.

Repeated release queues once. Disabling/unmounting cleans owned timers/direct ripples without deleting nested instances. Document listeners bind/remove against mount-time ownerDocument, without automatic cross-document rebinding. Only host Enter/Space and matching keyup/blur participate. The directive does not supply button semantics, accessible names or business clicking to plain divs.

The binding type `RippleDirectiveValue` is exported from the package root and Ripple entry, with optional `color` and `disabled` fields. Color changes affect subsequently created waves. `disabled` controls decoration only; it does not disable the host. Global `Context.enableRipple` prevents new waves while existing waves finish normally. During animation the directive temporarily sets clipping and, when needed, positioning and stacking styles. When the final wave ends, or on disable or unmount, it restores styles it still owns and preserves values changed by application code. Coordinates account for axis-aligned scaling; rotation and skew are not guaranteed.

# Row

24-column Flex layout. Row manages gutters and alignment; Col manages spans, offsets, ordering and breakpoints. Use Grid for CSS Grid collapse and suffix items.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.


Horizontal and vertical gutters both default to 16px (`gutter=[16, 16]`). An explicit number or responsive object sets only the horizontal gutter. Use a tuple for both axes, or `gutter=0` to remove spacing.

## Basic examples

### 24-column layout

Example source: src/row/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template><div class="row-demo">
  <c-row><c-col :span="12"><div class="cell">12</div></c-col><c-col :span="12"><div class="cell soft">12</div></c-col></c-row>
  <c-row><c-col v-for="i in 3" :key="i" :span="8"><div class="cell">8</div></c-col></c-row>
</div></template>

<style scoped>
.row-demo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cell { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c-color-primary); color: var(--c-color-white); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.soft { opacity: .7; }
</style>
```

| --- | --- |
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

Wrapping examples compare wrapped and ordinary `div` modes. Ordinary mode removes Row layout and child Col spacing. Gap examples distinguish horizontal/vertical spacing. Row uses Flex, not CSS Grid.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Row resolves responsive gutter with JavaScript matchMedia, using xs for SSR and synchronizing the viewport after mounting. Col uses CSS media queries: SSR already emits all configured classes without waiting for measurement. Breakpoints use viewport width: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Only configured fields override earlier values. Offset starts at the logical inline edge and mirrors in RTL. Order affects visual positioning while preserving DOM, keyboard and assistive technology reading order.

Span, offset and their breakpoint fields accept integers from 0 through 24. A zero span hides the column; offset 24 shifts it by a full row width. Order accepts finite integers, including negative values and values above 24, subject to browser CSS order computation. Gutter accepts finite nonnegative numbers, six-breakpoint objects or exactly two entries [horizontal, vertical]. Development diagnostics report unknown breakpoints, invalid numbers and enum values. Invalid span falls back to 24; invalid offset/order is ignored; breakpoint objects retain valid fields; invalid gutter components fall back to zero.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Import the independent Row and Col components from the library root or their row/col subpaths; installing Grid does not register them.

# Scheduler

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Reading direction

Scheduler inherits `dir` from the page, a local container, or ConfigProvider. Use the documentation navigation switch to change LTR/RTL at runtime. Month/week/resource columns and horizontal time follow inline start; vertical time continues downwards. Switching direction preserves dates, event data, selection and the horizontal reading offset, and cancels active drag or resize gestures.

Hourly resource timelines support moving events and resizing both start and end, respecting `snapDuration`, readonly state, milestones and event `resizable`. Zoom preserves the date at the center of the visible time area. Resource labels stick to inline start; virtual rows and their heading scroll together.

Default overlap layouts use inline start. A custom `eventLayout` return value keeps the physical meaning of `left`; callers control that geometry. RTL does not reverse dates, time zones, dependencies or source resource order.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-09"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { SchedulerEvent } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  { id: 'meeting', title: '项目同步', start: '2026-09-09T09:00:00', end: '2026-09-09T10:00:00' },
])
</script>
<template>
  <c-scheduler v-model="events" default-date="2026-09-09" />
</template>
```

## Views and layout

### Layout Groups

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Layout Groups, Without Resources, Resource Week |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Layout Groups, Timeline, Hidden Days |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Resource Week, Timeline, Now Indicator |
| `start-hour` | Time-grid start hour, 0–23 | Layout Groups, Now Indicator, Stacked Events |
| `end-hour` | Time-grid end hour; greater than start and at most 24 | Layout Groups, Now Indicator, Stacked Events |
| `modes` | Views available for switching | Without Resources, Hidden Days, Now Indicator |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Preview configuration: `:default-date="today"`, `default-mode="day"`, `:event-layout="custom ? layout : 'stack'"`, `:show-sidebar="false"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/layout-groups.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >分组仅共享布局位置。业务关联保存在
      metadata，修改单块不会自动修改整组。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space>
      <c-checkbox v-model="grouped">连续日程组成布局组</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="custom">自定义横向留白</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="displayEvents"
      :default-date="today"
      default-mode="day"
      :event-layout="custom ? layout : 'stack'"
      :show-sidebar="false"
      :start-hour="8"
      :end-hour="17"
    >
      <template #event="{ event }">
        <strong>{{ event.title }}</strong>
        <div v-if="event.metadata?.reference">
          关联：{{ event.metadata.reference }}
        </div>
      </template>
    </c-scheduler>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerEventLayout } from "../core";
const today = new Date();
const grouped = ref(true);
const custom = ref(false);
const at = (hour: number) => {
  const date = new Date(today);
  date.setHours(hour, 0, 0, 0);
  return date;
};
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "a",
    title: "阶段一",
    start: at(9),
    end: at(11),
    metadata: { reference: "A" },
  },
  {
    id: "b",
    title: "阶段二",
    start: at(11),
    end: at(13),
    metadata: { reference: "A" },
  },
  { id: "c", title: "独立日程", start: at(10), end: at(12) },
  {
    id: "d",
    title: "间隔后的阶段",
    start: at(15),
    end: at(16),
    metadata: { reference: "A" },
  },
]);
// Only the application interprets metadata and chooses which blocks share layout.
const displayEvents = computed({
  get: () =>
    events.value.map((event) => ({
      ...event,
      layoutGroupId:
        grouped.value && typeof event.metadata?.reference === "string"
          ? event.metadata.reference
          : undefined,
    })),
  set: (value: SchedulerEvent[]) => {
    events.value = value;
  },
});
// Product-specific percentages stay in the demo. Fractions are relative to one date/resource column.
const layout: SchedulerEventLayout = ({ column, columns }) => {
  const left = (column * 0.9) / columns;
  return {
    left,
    width: Math.min(Math.max(0.45, 1 - 0.1 * columns), 0.9 - left),
  };
};
</script>
```

### Without Resources

Preview configuration: `:modes="['day', 'week', 'month', 'agenda']"`, `default-date="2026-09-09"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/without-resources.vue

```vue
<template>
  <p>仅管理发布时间与工作计划，不传人员或设备列表。编辑器不显示资源字段。</p>
  <c-scheduler
    v-model="events"
    :modes="['day', 'week', 'month', 'agenda']"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
  />
</template>
```

## Resources and assignments

### Resources

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Resources, Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Resources, Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Resources, Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions |
| `resource-dimensions` | Dimension definitions: `{ id, label }[]` | Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions, Independent Assignments |
| `resource-filters` | Combined resource-dimension filters; supports v-model:resource-filters | Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions, Virtual Resources |
| `show-assignment-details` | Edit resource occupancy and roles | Independent Assignments, Assignment Load |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Resource Cross Groups

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/resource-cross-groups.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >按站展开人员，也可切换为按人展开站。联合验收在两个人员行显示，但数据只有一条；拖动会修改整条任务的时间和对应资源。点击空白行可创建同时关联站与人的任务。</c-alert
    >

      <c-button
        @click="
          filters = { station: ['station:north'], person: ['person:lin'] }
        "

        @click="
          filters = {
            station: ['station:north', 'station:south'],
            person: ['person:chen'],
          }
        "
        >两站 + 小陈</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="filters = {}">清空维度筛选</c-button>
      <c-button @click="groupDimensions = ['station', 'person']"
        >站 → 人</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="groupDimensions = ['person', 'station']"
        >人 → 站</c-button
      >
      <c-tag>匹配 {{ matching.length }} / {{ events.length }} 条任务</c-tag>
    </c-space>

      data-cross-groups-demo

      :resource-dimensions="dimensions"
      history
    />
  </c-space>

import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import { filterSchedulerEventsByResources } from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerResource,
  SchedulerResourceFilters,
} from "../core";
const dimensions = [
  { id: "station", label: "站" },
  { id: "person", label: "人" },
];
const resources: SchedulerResource[] = [
  { id: "station:north", label: "北站", dimensionId: "station", capacity: 2 },
  { id: "station:south", label: "南站", dimensionId: "station", capacity: 2 },
  { id: "person:lin", label: "小林", dimensionId: "person", capacity: 1 },
  { id: "person:chen", label: "小陈", dimensionId: "person", capacity: 1 },
];
const filters = ref<SchedulerResourceFilters>({});
const groupDimensions = ref(["station", "person"]);
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "north-lin",
    title: "北站巡检",
    start: "2026-09-22T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["station:north", "person:lin"],
  },
  {
    id: "north-chen",
    title: "北站检修",
    start: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T11:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["station:north", "person:chen"],
  },
  {
    id: "south-lin",
    title: "南站巡检",
    start: "2026-09-22T11:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T12:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["station:south", "person:lin"],
  },
  {
    id: "south-chen",
    title: "南站检修",

    id: "joint",
    title: "北站联合验收",
    start: "2026-09-22T14:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T15:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["station:north", "person:lin", "person:chen"],
  },
]);
const matching = computed(() =>
  filterSchedulerEventsByResources(events.value, resources, filters.value),
);
</script>
```

### Assignment Load

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-22"`, `default-mode="resource-timeline"`, `default-scale="hour"`, `:resources="resources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/assignment-load.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >每条日程可配置资源占用量和角色。两条各占 0.5 的日程恰好占满容量
      1；尝试新增一条可验证阻止或提醒策略。详情中可直接修改分配信息，资源表头显示本日峰值负载。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space
      ><c-button @click="policy = {}">超载时阻止</c-button
      ><c-button @click="policy = { capacity: 'warn' }">超载时提醒</c-button
      ><c-button @click="add">新增 0.5 占用</c-button></c-space
    >
    <c-scheduler
      ref="scheduler"
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-22"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      default-scale="hour"
      :resources="resources"
      :rule-policy="policy"
      show-assignment-details
      show-resource-load
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerInstance } from "../index";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerRulePolicy } from "../core";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const resources = [{ id: "device", label: "实验设备", capacity: 1 }];
const policy = ref<SchedulerRulePolicy>({});
let sequence = 2;
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>(
  [0, 1].map((i) => ({
    id: `load${i}`,
    title: `任务 ${i + 1}`,
    start: "2026-09-22T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["device"],
    resourceDetails: { device: { units: 0.5, role: i ? "协作" : "负责" } },
  })),
);
function add() {
  const id = sequence++;
  return scheduler.value?.change({
    type: "create",
    event: { ...events.value[0], id: `load${id}`, title: `任务 ${id + 1}` },
  });
}
</script>
```

```vue
<template>

    <c-alert
      >100 个站 × 20 位人员，共 2000
      个组合行。滚动时只挂载附近的行；点击空白格新建，或在当前可见行之间拖动任务。编辑后保留滚动位置；拖到边缘可自动滚动到其他组合行。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="filters = {}">全部 2000 行</c-button>

    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      key="virtual-resources"
      data-virtual-resources-demo
      v-model="events"
      v-model:resource-filters="filters"
      :resources="resources"
      :resource-dimensions="dimensions"
      :resource-group-dimensions="['station', 'person']"
      :virtual-list-props="{ height: 480, buffer: 10, estimatedSize: 80 }"
      default-date="2026-09-22"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      default-scale="hour"
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type {
  SchedulerResource,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerResourceFilters,
} from "../core";
const dimensions = [
  { id: "station", label: "站" },
  { id: "person", label: "人" },
```

### Resource Capacity

Preview configuration: `:status="span.exceeded ? 'danger' : 'success'"`, `default-date="2026-09-15"`, `default-mode="resource-timeline"`, `default-scale="hour"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/resource-capacity.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >检测设备默认可并行处理 2 个任务。09:00–11:00 与 10:00–12:00 的两单已占满
      10:00–11:00；尝试追加第三单，或提高容量后重试。降低容量保留已有日程，并在下方标出超额时段。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="capacity = 1">容量设为 1</c-button>
      <c-button @click="capacity = 2">容量设为 2</c-button>
      <c-button @click="capacity = 3">容量设为 3</c-button>
      <c-button status="primary" @click="addThird">尝试追加第三单</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置容量示例</c-button>
      <c-tag>当前容量：{{ capacity }}</c-tag>
      <c-tag v-if="result">{{ result }}</c-tag>
    </c-space>
    <c-space direction="column" block>
      <c-tag
        v-for="span in load"
        :key="+span.start"
        :status="span.exceeded ? 'danger' : 'success'"
      >
        {{ format(span.start) }}–{{ format(span.end) }}：{{ span.load }}/{{
          span.capacity
        }}
        {{ span.exceeded ? "超出容量" : "容量内" }}
      </c-tag>
      <c-tag v-if="!load.length">当前可见范围没有占用</c-tag>
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      key="resource-capacity"
      ref="scheduler"
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-15"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      default-scale="hour"
      :resources="resources"
      history
      @range-change="range = $event"
    >
      <template #resource-header="{ resource }">
        <c-space
          ><span>{{ resource?.label }}</span
          ><c-tag>容量 {{ resource?.capacity }}</c-tag></c-space
        >
      </template>
    </c-scheduler>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerInstance } from "../index";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import {
  getSchedulerResourceLoad,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDateKey,
} from "../core";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const capacity = ref(2);
const resources = computed(() => [
  { id: "lab", label: "检测设备", capacity: capacity.value },
]);
const initial: SchedulerEvent[] = [
  {
    id: "sample-a",
    title: "样品甲",
    start: "2026-09-15T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-15T11:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["lab"],
  },
  {
    id: "sample-b",
    title: "样品乙",
    start: "2026-09-15T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-15T12:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["lab"],
  },
];
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([...initial]);
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-09-15", "day"));
const load = computed(() =>
  getSchedulerResourceLoad(events.value, resources.value[0], range.value),
);
const result = ref("");
const format = (date: Date) =>
  `${schedulerDateKey(date)} ${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
async function addThird() {
  if (events.value.some((event) => event.id === "sample-c")) {
    result.value = "第三单已存在，可撤销或重置后重试";
    return;
  }
  const saved = await scheduler.value?.change({
    type: "create",
    event: {
      id: "sample-c",
      title: "样品丙",
      start: "2026-09-15T10:30:00",
      end: "2026-09-15T11:00:00",
      resourceIds: ["lab"],
    },
  });
  result.value = saved ? "第三单已保存" : "第三单未保存：超出容量";
}
function reset() {
  events.value = [...initial];
  capacity.value = 2;
  result.value = "";
  scheduler.value?.goToDate(new Date(2026, 8, 15));
}
</script>
```

## Recurrence and calendars

### Recurring Events

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Recurring Events, Calendar Recurrence, Business Calendar |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Recurring Events, Business Calendar, Recurrence Following |
| `model-value` | Schedule data; supports v-model and becomes controlled when provided | Calendar Recurrence, Recurrence Following, Zoned Recurrence |
| `readonly` | Viewing/navigation allowed, editing blocked | Calendar Recurrence, Recurrence Following, Zoned Recurrence |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Recurring Events |
| `date` | Navigation date; supports v-model:date | Calendar Recurrence |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Preview configuration: `:options="frequencies"`, `aria-label="重复频率"`, `:min="1"`, `:max="12"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/recurring-events.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >重复会议按可见范围展开。编辑、拖动或删除卡片只影响这一次；新建日程是独立安排。修改上方规则会重建系列并清除本例中的例外。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-select
        v-model="frequency"
        :options="frequencies"
        aria-label="重复频率"
      />
      <c-input-number
        v-model="interval"
        :min="1"
        :max="12"
        aria-label="重复间隔"
      />
      <c-tag>{{
        frequency === "daily" ? "天一次" : "周一次（周一、三、五）"
      }}</c-tag>
      <c-input-number
        v-model="count"
        :min="1"
        :max="60"
        aria-label="重复次数"
      />
      <c-tag>次后结束</c-tag>
      <c-button :disabled="!exceptions.length" @click="exceptions = []"
        >恢复全部例外</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-tag
      >{{ exceptions.length }} 条本次例外 ·
      {{ standalone.length }} 条独立安排</c-tag
    >
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="week"
      :resources="resources"
      :before-transaction="validateChange"
      @range-change="range = $event"
    >
      <template #event="{ event }">
        {{ event.title }}
        <c-tag v-if="occurrenceIds.has(event.id)" size="small"
          >重复 · 仅本次</c-tag
        >
      </template>
    </c-scheduler>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import {
  SchedulerError,
  applySchedulerChange,
  diffSchedulerEvents,
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerRange,
  setSchedulerRecurrenceException,
} from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerRecurrenceException,
  SchedulerRecurrenceRule,
  SchedulerRecurringEvent,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const validateChange: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = ({ changes }) => {
  if (
    changes.some(
      (change) =>
        occurrenceIds.value.has(change.event.id) &&
        change.type !== "remove" &&
        change.event.start == null,
    )
  ) {
    throw new SchedulerError(
      "invalid-event",
      "重复实例必须保留排期；取消本次请使用删除",
    );
  }
};
const frequencies = [
  { label: "每天", value: "daily" },
  { label: "每周", value: "weekly" },
];
const frequency = ref<SchedulerRecurrenceRule["frequency"]>("weekly");
const interval = ref(1);
const count = ref(12);
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-09-09", "week"));
const resources = [
  { id: "design", label: "林夏 · 设计" },
  { id: "dev", label: "陈舟 · 前端" },
];
const exceptions = ref<SchedulerRecurrenceException[]>([]);
const standalone = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const series = computed<SchedulerRecurringEvent[]>(() => [
  {
    event: {
      id: "weekly-review",
      title: "项目同步会",
      start: "2026-09-07T09:00:00",
      end: "2026-09-07T10:00:00",
      resourceIds: ["design", "dev"],
    },
    rule: {
      frequency: frequency.value,
      interval: interval.value || 1,
      count: count.value || 1,
      daysOfWeek: frequency.value === "weekly" ? [1, 3, 5] : undefined,
    },
  },
]);
watch([frequency, interval, count], () => {
  exceptions.value = [];
});
const occurrences = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(series.value, range.value, {
    exceptions: exceptions.value,
  }),
);
const occurrenceIds = computed(
  () => new Set(occurrences.value.map((event) => event.id)),
);
const events = computed<SchedulerEvent[]>({
  get: () => [...occurrences.value, ...standalone.value],
  set: (next) => {
    const previous = [...occurrences.value, ...standalone.value];
    const originals = new Map(
      occurrences.value.map((event) => [event.id, event]),
    );
    let nextExceptions = exceptions.value;
    let nextStandalone = standalone.value;
    for (const change of diffSchedulerEvents(previous, next)) {
      const original = originals.get(change.event.id);
      if (original)
        nextExceptions = setSchedulerRecurrenceException(
          nextExceptions,
          original,
          change.type === "remove" ? undefined : change.event,
        );
      else nextStandalone = applySchedulerChange(nextStandalone, change);
    }
    // A real backend saves these series/exception records atomically, not expanded instances.
    exceptions.value = nextExceptions;
    standalone.value = nextStandalone;
  },
});
</script>
```

### Calendar Recurrence

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/calendar-recurrence.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >按月、按年安排任务。无效日期可选择跳过或落到月底；“最后一个工作日”仅按周一至周五计算，不包含节假日调休。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" wrap>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="月年重复规则">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="preset"
          aria-label="月年重复规则"
          :options="presets"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-input-number
        v-model="interval"
        :min="1"
        :max="12"
        aria-label="月年重复间隔"
      />
      <c-tag>{{ preset === "leap" ? "年一次" : "个月一次" }}</c-tag>
      <c-input-number
        v-model="count"
        :min="1"
        :max="10"
        aria-label="月年重复次数"
      />
      <c-tag>次后结束</c-tag>
      <c-checkbox
        v-if="preset === 'day31' || preset === 'leap'"
        v-model="lastDay"
        >缺少该日期时落到月底</c-checkbox
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-tag>未来 40 年内的前 {{ preview.length }} 次安排（点日期定位）</c-tag>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button
        v-for="item in preview"
        :key="item.id"
        @click="date = schedulerDate(item.start!)"
        >{{ schedulerDateKey(item.start!) }}</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      key="calendar-recurrence-preview"
      v-model:date="date"
      :model-value="events"
      default-mode="month"
      readonly
      @range-change="range = $event"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import {
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDate,
  schedulerDateKey,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerDate, SchedulerRecurringEvent } from "../core";
const preset = ref("day31");
const interval = ref(1);
const count = ref(6);
const lastDay = ref(false);
const presets = [
  { label: "每月 31 日", value: "day31" },
  { label: "每月最后一个工作日", value: "weekday" },
  { label: "每月第二个星期一", value: "monday" },
  { label: "每年 2 月 29 日", value: "leap" },
];
const date = ref<SchedulerDate>("2026-01-31");
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange(date.value, "month"));
watch(preset, () => {
  date.value = preset.value === "leap" ? "2024-02-29" : "2026-01-01";
});
const series = computed<SchedulerRecurringEvent[]>(() => {
  const start =
    preset.value === "leap"
      ? "2024-02-29"
      : preset.value === "day31"
        ? "2026-01-31"
        : "2026-01-01";
  return [
    {
      event: {
        id: "calendar-plan",
        title: presets.find((item) => item.value === preset.value)!.label,
        start: `${start}T09:00:00`,
        end: `${start}T10:00:00`,
      },
      rule: {
        frequency: preset.value === "leap" ? "yearly" : "monthly",
        interval: interval.value || 1,
        count: count.value || 1,
        ...(preset.value === "weekday"
          ? { weekOfMonth: -1, daysOfWeek: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] }
          : preset.value === "monday"
            ? { weekOfMonth: 2, daysOfWeek: [1] }
            : {
                overflow: lastDay.value
                  ? ("last-day" as const)
                  : ("skip" as const),
              }),
      },
    },
  ];
});
const events = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(series.value, range.value),
);
const preview = computed(() => {
  const start = schedulerDate(series.value[0].event.start!);
  const end = new Date(start);
  end.setFullYear(end.getFullYear() + 40);
  return expandSchedulerRecurrences(series.value, { start, end }).slice(0, 10);
});
</script>
```

### Business Calendar

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-02-26"`, `default-mode="week"`, `:working-hours="hours"`, `:disabled-ranges="blocked"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/business-calendar.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >以下日期均为模拟企业日历，不是官方放假通知。示例包含模拟春节休假、周末补班和月末企业休假；同一配置用于月末工作日计算和预约校验。</c-alert
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="enabled">启用模拟休假与补班</c-checkbox>
    <c-space wrap
      ><c-tag v-for="item in settlements" :key="item.id"
        >结算日：{{ schedulerDateKey(item.start!) }}</c-tag
      ></c-space
    >
    <c-tag
      >2 月 27 日企业休假、28
      日周六补班。可尝试新增或移动任务，对比开关前后的保存结果。</c-tag
    >
    <c-scheduler
      key="business-calendar-bookings"
      v-model="bookings"
      default-date="2026-02-26"
      default-mode="week"
      :working-hours="hours"
      :disabled-ranges="blocked"
      :before-transaction="validateCalendar"
      @range-change="range = $event"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import {
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerAvailabilityIssues,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDate,
  schedulerDateKey,
  SchedulerError,
} from "../core";
import { getSchedulerCalendarDisabledRanges } from "../core/business-calendar";
import type { SchedulerBusinessCalendar, SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const enabled = ref(true);
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-02-26", "week"));
const overrides: NonNullable<SchedulerBusinessCalendar["overrides"]> = [
  ...[16, 17, 18, 19, 20].map((day) => ({
    date: `2026-02-${day}`,
    working: false,
    label: "模拟春节休假",
  })),
  { date: "2026-02-14", working: true, label: "模拟补班" },
  { date: "2026-02-27", working: false, label: "企业休假" },
  { date: "2026-02-28", working: true, label: "模拟补班" },
];
const calendar = computed<SchedulerBusinessCalendar>(() => ({
  overrides: enabled.value ? overrides : [],
}));
// Calendar decides which dates work; hours separately decide when those dates work.
const hours = [
  { daysOfWeek: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], startMinute: 540, endMinute: 1080 },
];
const blocked = computed(() =>
  getSchedulerCalendarDisabledRanges(calendar.value, range.value),
);
const bookings = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "regular-job",
    title: "常规工作日任务",
    start: "2026-02-26T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-02-26T11:00:00",
  },
]);
const settlements = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(
    [
      {
        event: {
          id: "settlement",
          title: "月末结算",
          start: "2026-02-01T09:00:00",
          end: "2026-02-01T10:00:00",
        },
        rule: {
          frequency: "monthly",
          weekOfMonth: -1,
          businessCalendar: calendar.value,
          count: 3,
        },
      },
    ],
    { start: new Date(2026, 1, 1), end: new Date(2026, 4, 1) },
  ),
);
const validateCalendar: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = ({ changes }) => {
  for (const change of changes) {
    if (
      change.type === "remove" ||
      change.event.start == null ||
      change.event.end == null
    )
      continue;
    // Editor changes can extend outside the visible window: validate the full proposal.
    const disabledRanges = getSchedulerCalendarDisabledRanges(calendar.value, {
      start: schedulerDate(change.event.start),
      end: schedulerDate(change.event.end),
    });
    const issues = getSchedulerAvailabilityIssues(change.event, {
      disabledRanges,
    });
    if (issues.length)
      throw new SchedulerError("unavailable", "日程包含非工作日", issues);
  }
};
</script>
```

### Recurrence Following

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/recurrence-following.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >点击会议选择“仅本次”或“本次及以后”。周五预设了一条“客户参会”例外：默认保护它，明确选择清除后才允许拆分。修改日期时需保留原规则的星期。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置示例</c-button>
      <c-checkbox v-model="reject">模拟保存失败</c-checkbox>
      <c-tag
        >{{ state.series.length }} 个系列 ·
        {{ state.exceptions.length }} 条例外</c-tag
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-tag v-for="item in state.series" :key="item.event.id"
        >{{ item.event.title }} · {{ item.rule.count ?? "不限" }} 次</c-tag
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-tag>{{ status }}</c-tag>
    <c-scheduler
      key="recurrence-following-calendar"
      :model-value="events"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="week"
      readonly
      :editable="false"
      @range-change="range = $event"
      @event-click="openEditor"
    />
    <c-dialog v-model:open="open" title="调整重复安排" :footer="false">
      <c-form
        v-if="draft"
        :model="draft"
        layout="vertical"
        @submit="save(false)"
      >
        <c-form-item label="修改范围">
          <c-select v-model="scope" :options="scopes" aria-label="修改范围" />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item v-if="scope === 'following'" label="后续例外">
          <c-select
            v-model="policy"
            :options="policies"
            aria-label="后续例外处理"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="会议标题"
          ><c-input v-model="draft.title" aria-label="会议标题"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始时间"
          ><c-date
            v-model="draft.start"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            aria-label="会议开始"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束时间"
          ><c-date
            v-model="draft.end"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            aria-label="会议结束"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-alert v-if="error" status="danger">{{ error }}</c-alert>
        <c-space wrap>
          <c-button status="primary" @click="save(false)">保存修改</c-button>
          <c-button @click="save(true)">取消所选安排</c-button>
          <c-button @click="open = false">返回</c-button>
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </c-dialog>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";
import {
  cloneSchedulerEvent,
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDate,
  setSchedulerRecurrenceException,
  splitSchedulerRecurrence,
} from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerOccurrence,
  SchedulerRecurringEvent,
  SchedulerRecurrenceException,
} from "../core";
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-09-09", "week"));
function initialState(): {
  series: SchedulerRecurringEvent[];
  exceptions: SchedulerRecurrenceException[];
} {
  const series: SchedulerRecurringEvent[] = [
    {
      event: {
        id: "team-sync",
        title: "团队同步会",
        start: "2026-09-07T09:00:00",
        end: "2026-09-07T10:00:00",
      },
      rule: { frequency: "weekly", daysOfWeek: [1, 3, 5], count: 9 },
    },
  ];
  const friday = expandSchedulerRecurrences(
    series,
    getSchedulerRange("2026-09-09", "week"),
  )[2];
  return {
    series,
    exceptions: setSchedulerRecurrenceException([], friday, {
      ...friday,
      title: "客户参会",
    }),
  };
}
const state = shallowRef(initialState());
const events = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(state.value.series, range.value, {
    exceptions: state.value.exceptions,
  }),
);
const open = ref(false);
const reject = ref(false);
const scope = ref<"single" | "following">("single");
const policy = ref<"reject" | "discard">("reject");
const scopes = [
  { label: "仅本次", value: "single" },
  { label: "本次及以后", value: "following" },
];
const policies = [
  { label: "保护已有例外", value: "reject" },
  { label: "清除后续例外", value: "discard" },
];
const selected = shallowRef<SchedulerOccurrence>();
const draft = ref<{ title: string; start: Date; end: Date }>();
const error = ref("");
const status = ref("点击日程调整安排");
let baseline = state.value;
let nextId = 0;
function openEditor(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  const occurrence = events.value.find((item) => item.id === event.id);
  if (!occurrence) return;
  selected.value = { ...occurrence };
  draft.value = {
    title: occurrence.title,
    start: schedulerDate(occurrence.start!),
    end: schedulerDate(occurrence.end!),
  };
  scope.value = "single";
  policy.value = "reject";
  error.value = "";
  baseline = state.value;
  open.value = true;
}
function save(remove: boolean) {
  if (!selected.value || !draft.value) return;
  error.value = "";
  try {
    if (state.value !== baseline)
      throw new Error("安排已变化，请关闭后重新打开。");
    const replacement = {
      ...cloneSchedulerEvent(selected.value),
      ...draft.value,
    };
    let proposal: typeof state.value;
    let discarded = 0;
    if (scope.value === "following") {
      const affected = state.value.exceptions.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.seriesId === selected.value!.seriesId &&
          +schedulerDate(item.originalStart) >=
            +schedulerDate(selected.value!.originalStart),
      );
      if (affected.length && policy.value === "reject")
        throw new Error(
          `后续有 ${affected.length} 条例外，请选择清除后续例外或仅修改本次。`,
        );
      const result = splitSchedulerRecurrence(
        state.value.series,
        state.value.exceptions,
        selected.value,
        {
          nextEvent: remove
            ? undefined
            : { ...replacement, id: `team-sync-part-${nextId + 1}` },
          exceptionPolicy: policy.value,
        },
      );
      proposal = { series: result.series, exceptions: result.exceptions };
      discarded = result.removedExceptions.length;
    } else
      proposal = {
        series: state.value.series,
        exceptions: setSchedulerRecurrenceException(
          state.value.exceptions,
          selected.value,
          remove ? undefined : replacement,
        ),
      };
    // Save this complete canonical proposal atomically before publishing the projection.
    if (reject.value) throw new Error("模拟保存失败，原系列和例外均保留。");
    state.value = proposal;
    nextId++;
    status.value = `${remove ? "已取消" : "已修改"}${scope.value === "following" ? "本次及以后" : "本次"}；清除 ${discarded} 条后续例外`;
    open.value = false;
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "保存失败";
  }
}
function reset() {
  state.value = initialState();
  open.value = false;
  status.value = "点击日程调整安排";
  reject.value = false;
}
</script>
```

## Editing and interaction

### Drag Feedback

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Drag Feedback, Duplicate Events, Custom Cards |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Drag Feedback, Duplicate Events, Custom Event |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Drag Feedback, Duplicate Events, Custom Cards |
| `before-change` | Return false to cancel; supports asynchronous interception and save APIs | Custom Event, Custom Editor, External Editor |
| `resource-label` | Resource field name, such as equipment or meeting room | Drag Feedback |
| `start-hour` | Time-grid start hour, 0–23 | Drag Feedback |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Custom Event

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="week"`, `:resources="resources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/custom-event.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-alert>
    这里的工作、会议、休息和不可用时段都是 Demo 自己定义的业务类型，并非
    Scheduler
    内置枚举。新增时可选择类型，由业务配置映射标题建议、外观和默认权限。
  </c-alert>
  <c-space>
    <c-checkbox v-model="rejectSave">模拟后端保存失败</c-checkbox>
    <span>{{ requestStatus }}</span>
  </c-space>
  <c-loading :loading="loading" style="display: block">
  <c-scheduler
    :readonly="loading"
    v-model="events"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    default-mode="week"
    :resources="resources"
    :before-change="saveToMockServer"
  >
    <template #event="{ event }">
      <span>{{ event.title }}</span>
      <c-tag size="sm" :status="event.readonly ? 'neutral' : 'info'">
        {{ typeOf(event).label }} · {{ event.readonly ? "只读" : "可编辑" }}
      </c-tag>
    </template>

    <template
      #editor="{
        action,
        event,
        save,
        remove,
        close,
        readonly,
        pending,
        errorMessage,
      }"
    >
      <h3>{{ action === "create" ? "新增日程" : "编辑日程" }}</h3>
      <c-alert v-if="errorMessage" status="danger">
        {{ errorMessage }}
      </c-alert>
      <c-form
        :model="event"
        layout="vertical"
        @submit="prepareAndSave(event, save)"
      >
        <c-form-item label="日程类型">
          <c-select
            :model-value="typeOf(event).id"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            @update:model-value="applyType(event, $event)"
          >
            <c-option
              v-for="type in eventTypes"
              :key="type.id"
              :value="type.id"
            >
              {{ type.label }} · {{ type.readonly ? "默认只读" : "默认可编辑" }}
            </c-option>
          </c-select>
        </c-form-item>

        <div class="scheduler-type-preview" :style="previewStyle(event)">
          <strong>{{ typeOf(event).label }}</strong>
          <span>{{ typeOf(event).description }}</span>
        </div>

        <c-form-item label="标题">
          <c-input
            v-model="event.title"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            placeholder="请输入日程标题"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始时间">
          <c-date
            :model-value="
              event.start == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.start)
            "
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            @update:model-value="event.start = $event"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束时间">
          <c-date
            :model-value="
              event.end == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.end)
            "
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            @update:model-value="event.end = $event"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item>
          <c-checkbox
            :model-value="!event.readonly"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            @update:model-value="event.readonly = !$event"
          >
            创建后允许修改和拖拽
          </c-checkbox>
        </c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button :disabled="pending" @click="close">取消</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="action === 'edit' && !readonly"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="pending"
            @click="remove"
            >删除</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!readonly"
            html-type="submit"
            status="primary"
            :loading="pending"
            >保存日程</c-button
          >
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>
  </c-loading>
  <c-collapse class="scheduler-mock-log">
    <c-collapse-item name="request" title="查看最近一次 Mock API 请求">
      <pre>{{ lastRequest || "尚未提交" }}</pre>
    </c-collapse-item>
  </c-collapse>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from "vue";
import { resources } from "./data";
import { cloneSchedulerEvent, schedulerDate } from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern,
} from "../index";

type EventType = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  backgroundColor: string;
  backgroundPattern: SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern;
  readonly: boolean;
};

const eventTypes: EventType[] = [
  {
    id: "work",
    label: "工作安排",
    description: "普通任务，可继续编辑和拖拽调整时间。",
    title: "工作安排",
    color: "#1677ff",
    backgroundColor: "#e6f4ff",
    backgroundPattern: "solid",
    readonly: false,
  },
  {
    id: "meeting",
    label: "会议",
    description: "用圆点背景区分协作和沟通类日程。",
    title: "会议",
    color: "#d48806",
    backgroundColor: "#fffbe6",
    backgroundPattern: "dots",
    readonly: false,
  },
  {
    id: "rest",
    label: "休息",
    description: "休息时段默认锁定，保存后不允许修改或拖拽。",
    title: "休息",
    color: "#00a854",
    backgroundColor: "#f0fff4",
    backgroundPattern: "diagonal-stripes",
    readonly: true,
  },
  {
    id: "blocked",
    label: "不可用时段",
    description: "用于停机、封场等占用，默认只读。",
    title: "不可用时段",
    color: "#722ed1",
    backgroundColor: "#f9f0ff",
    backgroundPattern: "crosshatch",
    readonly: true,
  },
];

const seedEvents: SchedulerEvent[] = [
  createEvent("work", "work-1", "需求评审", "09:00", "10:30"),
  createEvent("meeting", "meeting-1", "项目周会", "10:00", "11:30"),
  createEvent("rest", "rest-1", "张志强 休息", "13:00", "15:00"),
  createEvent("blocked", "blocked-1", "会议室维护", "15:30", "17:30"),
];
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const loading = ref(true);
const rejectSave = ref(false);
const requestStatus = ref("正在从 Mock API 加载…");
const lastRequest = ref("");
let mockDatabase = seedEvents.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);

const wait = (milliseconds: number) =>
  new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
const mockApi = {
  async list() {
    await wait(300);
    return mockDatabase.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
  },
  async save(next: SchedulerEvent[]) {
    await wait(500);
    if (rejectSave.value) throw new Error("Mock API：保存被拒绝");
    mockDatabase = next.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
    return {
      revision: Date.now(),
      events: mockDatabase.map(cloneSchedulerEvent),
    };
  },
};

onMounted(async () => {
  events.value = await mockApi.list();
  loading.value = false;
  requestStatus.value = `已加载 ${events.value.length} 条日程`;
});

const saveToMockServer: SchedulerBeforeChange = async (context) => {
  lastRequest.value = JSON.stringify(
    {
      method: "PUT",
      url: "/api/scheduler/events",
      change: context.type,
      event: context.event,
      events: context.value,
    },
    null,
    2,
  );
  requestStatus.value = "正在提交 metadata 和日程数据…";
  try {
    const response = await mockApi.save(context.value);
    requestStatus.value = `保存成功 · revision ${response.revision}`;
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    requestStatus.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
    throw error;
  }
};

function createEvent(
  typeId: string,
  id: string,
  title: string,
  start: string,
  end: string,
): SchedulerEvent {
  const event: SchedulerEvent = {
    id,
    title,
    start: `2026-09-09T${start}:00`,
    end: `2026-09-09T${end}:00`,
    resourceIds: [],
  };
  applyType(event, typeId, false);
  return event;
}

function typeOf(event: SchedulerEvent): EventType {
  return (
    eventTypes.find((type) => type.id === event.metadata?.typeId) ??
    eventTypes[0]
  );
}

function applyType(event: SchedulerEvent, value: unknown, suggestTitle = true) {
  const previous = typeOf(event);
  const type = eventTypes.find((item) => item.id === value) ?? eventTypes[0];
  const replaceTitle =
    suggestTitle && (!event.title.trim() || event.title === previous.title);
  event.color = type.color;
  event.backgroundColor = type.backgroundColor;
  event.backgroundPattern = type.backgroundPattern;
  event.metadata = { ...event.metadata, typeId: type.id };
  event.readonly = type.readonly;
  if (replaceTitle) event.title = type.title;
}

function prepareAndSave(
  event: SchedulerEvent,
  save: (event?: SchedulerEvent) => void,
) {
  const type = typeOf(event);
  event.color ??= type.color;
  event.backgroundColor ??= type.backgroundColor;
  event.backgroundPattern ??= type.backgroundPattern;
  event.metadata = {
    ...event.metadata,
    typeId: type.id,
    clientRequestId: `demo-${Date.now()}`,
  };
  save(event);
}

function previewStyle(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  const color = event.color ?? "#1677ff";
  const background = event.backgroundColor ?? "#e6f4ff";
  const pattern = event.backgroundPattern;
  const images: Record<SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern, string> = {
    solid: `linear-gradient(${background}, ${background})`,
    "diagonal-stripes": `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 8px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 18%, transparent) 8px 16px)`,
    dots: `radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 28%, transparent) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px)`,
    crosshatch: `repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 9px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 14%, transparent) 9px 11px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 9px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 14%, transparent) 9px 11px)`,
  };
  return {
    color,
    backgroundColor: background,
    backgroundImage: images[pattern ?? "solid"],
    backgroundSize: pattern === "dots" ? "10px 10px" : undefined,
    borderColor: color,
  };
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.scheduler-type-preview {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.scheduler-type-preview span {
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.scheduler-mock-log {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.scheduler-mock-log pre {
  max-height: 260px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--c-color-fill-1);
  font-size: 12px;
}
</style>
```

### External Editor

Preview configuration: `:editable="false"`, `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="day"`, `:before-change="beforeChange"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/external-editor.vue

```vue
<template>
  <p>
    关闭内置编辑器，统一接收工具栏、日期格、卡片拖入及已有日程请求，使用独立
    Dialog。取消不写入，保存失败保留表单。
  </p>
  <c-checkbox v-model="reject">下一次模拟接口提交失败</c-checkbox>
  <c-scheduler
    ref="scheduler"
    v-model="events"
    :editable="false"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    default-mode="day"
    :before-change="beforeChange"
    @editor-request="openEditor"
    @change-error="showError"
  >
    <template #sidebar-extra="{ startDrag, cancelDrag, disabled }">
      <c-button
        :draggable="!disabled"
        :disabled="disabled"
        @dragstart="startDrag(card, $event)"
        @dragend="cancelDrag"
        >拖入：现场检查 · 60 分钟</c-button
      >
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>
  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="open"
    :title="request?.action === 'create' ? '业务新增窗口' : '业务详情窗口'"
    :footer="false"
    :closable="!saving"
    :overlay-closable="!saving"
    :esc-to-close="!saving"
  >
    <template v-if="draft">
      <p>请求来源：{{ request?.source }}；业务页面也可接收相同请求。</p>
      <c-alert v-if="errorMessage" status="danger">{{ errorMessage }}</c-alert>
      <c-form :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="submit()">
        <c-form-item label="任务名称"
          ><c-input
            v-model="draft.title"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="draft.start == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(draft.start)"
            @update:model-value="draft.start = $event"
            :show-time="!draft.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束（不含）"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="draft.end == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(draft.end)"
            @update:model-value="draft.end = $event"
            :show-time="!draft.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="工作说明"
          ><c-textarea
            v-model="draft.description"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button :disabled="saving" @click="open = false">取消</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="request?.action === 'edit' && !request.readonly"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="saving"
            @click="submit(true)"
            >删除</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!request?.readonly"
            status="primary"
            html-type="submit"
            :loading="saving"
            >确认保存</c-button
          >
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-dialog>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { cloneSchedulerEvent, schedulerDate } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue/scheduler/core";
import type {
  SchedulerInstance,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerEventTemplate,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "inspection",
    title: "设备例行检查",
    start: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
  },
]);
const card: SchedulerEventTemplate = {
  title: "现场检查",
  duration: 60,
  description: "核对运行参数",
};
const request = ref<SchedulerEditorRequest>();
const draft = ref<SchedulerEvent>();
const open = ref(false);
const saving = ref(false);
const reject = ref(false);
const errorMessage = ref("");
let snapshot: string | undefined;
function openEditor(value: SchedulerEditorRequest) {
  if (open.value || saving.value) return;
  request.value = value;
  draft.value = cloneSchedulerEvent(value.event);
  snapshot = JSON.stringify(
    events.value.find((item) => item.id === value.event.id),
  );
  errorMessage.value = "";
  open.value = true;
}
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = async () => {
  if (reject.value) {
    reject.value = false;
    throw new Error("模拟接口提交失败，请保留草稿直接重试");
  }
  return true;
};
function showError(error: unknown) {
  errorMessage.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
}
async function submit(remove = false) {
  if (
    !draft.value ||
    !request.value ||
    request.value.readonly ||
    saving.value ||
    !scheduler.value
  )
    return;
  if (
    draft.value.id !== request.value.event.id ||
    JSON.stringify(events.value.find((item) => item.id === draft.value!.id)) !==
      snapshot
  ) {
    errorMessage.value = "原日程已变化，请关闭并重新打开。";
    return;
  }
  saving.value = true;
  errorMessage.value = "";
  try {
    const success = await scheduler.value.change({
      type: remove
        ? "remove"
        : request.value.action === "create"
          ? "create"
          : "update",
      event: cloneSchedulerEvent(draft.value),
    });
    if (success) open.value = false;
    else if (!errorMessage.value)
      errorMessage.value = "保存被取消或当前不可提交，请重试。";
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}
</script>
```

### Batch History

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >开启“多选”后点击日程卡片，可整批后移一天、添加资源或删除。共享日程在多个资源列中只计为一项；撤销和重做同样经过保存接口。</c-alert
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="reject">模拟整批保存失败</c-checkbox>
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      v-model:selected-keys="selected"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      :resources="resources"
      selectable
      history
      :before-transaction="persist"
    />
    <c-tag>{{ status }}</c-tag>
  </c-space>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
import { createEvents, resources } from "./data";
const events = ref(createEvents());
const selected = ref<string[]>([]);
const reject = ref(false);
const status = ref("尚未提交");
const persist: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = async (context) => {
  status.value = `正在提交 ${context.changes.length} 项变更…`;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 350));
  if (reject.value) {
    status.value = "整批保存失败，日程和历史均保留";
    throw new Error("Demo rejected");
  }
  status.value = `已提交 ${context.changes.length} 项变更（${context.action === "undo" ? "撤销" : context.action === "redo" ? "重做" : "修改"}）`;
};
```

### Atomic Swap

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="resource-day"`, `:resources="[{ id: 'room', label: '会议室 A' }]"`, `:allow-overlap="false"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/atomic-swap.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >会议室禁止重叠。两条日程可以通过一次事务交换时间；整体校验最终结果，任一项失败都不会改变另一项。</c-alert
    >
    <c-button @click="swap">交换两个会议的时间</c-button>
    <c-scheduler
      ref="scheduler"
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="resource-day"
      :resources="[{ id: 'room', label: '会议室 A' }]"
      :allow-overlap="false"
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerInstance } from "../index";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "a",
    title: "产品评审",
    start: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["room"],
  },
  {
    id: "b",
    title: "技术评审",
    start: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["room"],
  },
]);
async function swap() {
  const [a, b] = events.value;
  await scheduler.value?.transaction([
    { type: "move", event: { ...a, start: b.start, end: b.end } },
    { type: "move", event: { ...b, start: a.start, end: a.end } },
  ]);
}
</script>
```

## Async loading and saving

### Async Resources

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Async Resources, Remote Events, Async Change |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Async Resources, Async Change |
| `before-change` | Return false to cancel; supports asynchronous interception and save APIs | Async Resources, Async Change |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Async Resources, Async Change |
| `resource-label` | Resource field name, such as equipment or meeting room | Async Resources |
| `request-resources` | Query resource candidates by keyword and cursor | Async Resources |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Preview configuration: `options`, `:resources="visibleResources"`, `:resource-label="kind === 'device' ? '设备' : '人员'"`, `:request-resources="requestResources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/async-resources.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" wrap>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
      <c-select
        v-model="kind"
        :options="[
          { value: 'device', label: '设备接口' },
          { value: 'person', label: '人员接口' },
        ]"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="failNextSearch = true">下次搜索模拟失败</c-button>
    <c-button @click="retryHydration">模拟回显失败并重新加载</c-button>
    <c-button @click="useNextPage">切换可见资源页</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <p>
    当前仅提供 {{ visibleResources.length }} 条可见资源。已有日程关联第 12
    条，不在本页，仍通过 ID 接口回显名称。进入编辑器，搜索“12”或滚动加载更多。
  </p>
  <p role="status">{{ feedback }}</p>
  <c-scheduler
    :key="`${kind}-${revision}`"
    v-model="events"
    :resources="visibleResources"
    :resource-label="kind === 'device' ? '设备' : '人员'"
    :request-resources="requestResources"
    :resolve-resources="resolveResources"
    :before-change="beforeChange"
    default-mode="agenda"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    @resource-error="resourceError"
  />
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, ref, watch } from "vue";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerRequestResources,
  SchedulerResolveResources,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const kind = ref<"device" | "person">("device");
// 业务接口字段在接入层适配，Scheduler 始终只认识 id / label。
const devices = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, index) => ({
  deviceId: `device-${index + 1}`,
  deviceName: `实验设备 ${index + 1}`,
}));
const people = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, index) => ({
  userId: `person-${index + 1}`,
  displayName: `工程师 ${index + 1}`,
}));
const directory = computed(() =>
  kind.value === "device"
    ? devices.map((item) => ({ id: item.deviceId, label: item.deviceName }))
    : people.map((item) => ({ id: item.userId, label: item.displayName })),
);
const page = ref(0);
const revision = ref(0);
const visibleResources = computed(() =>
  directory.value.slice(page.value * 4, page.value * 4 + 4),
);
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const feedback = ref("打开详情查看名称回显，或在资源下拉框搜索。");
const failNextSearch = ref(false);
const failNextResolve = ref(false);
const failedOperation = ref<"search" | "resolve">();
watch(
  kind,
  () => {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "打开详情查看名称回显，或在资源下拉框搜索。";
    page.value = 0;
    events.value = [
      {
        id: `${kind.value}-job`,
        title: "已有排期：关联不在本页的资源",
        start: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
        end: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
        resourceIds: [`${kind.value}-12`],
      },
    ];
  },
  { immediate: true, flush: "sync" },
);

const lifetime = new AbortController();
onScopeDispose(() => lifetime.abort());
// 模拟接口延时；真实接入时直接 fetch(url, { signal })。
function delay(signal: AbortSignal) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      reject(new Error("Aborted"));
      return;
    }
    const abort = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      reject(new Error("Aborted"));
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      resolve();
    }, 500);
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
  });
}
const requestResources: SchedulerRequestResources = async ({
  query,
  cursor,
  signal,
}) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  const fail = failNextSearch.value;
  failNextSearch.value = false;
  await delay(signal);
  if (fail) throw new Error("模拟搜索网络错误");
  const matches = data.filter(
    (item) => item.label.includes(query) || item.id.includes(query),
  );
  const offset = Number(cursor ?? 0);
  if (failedOperation.value === "search") {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "搜索重试成功，可继续选择资源。";
  }
  return {
    items: matches.slice(offset, offset + 4),
    nextCursor: offset + 4 < matches.length ? String(offset + 4) : undefined,
  };
};
const resolveResources: SchedulerResolveResources = async (ids, { signal }) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  const fail = failNextResolve.value;
  failNextResolve.value = false;
  await delay(signal);
  if (fail) throw new Error("模拟回显网络错误");
  if (failedOperation.value === "resolve") {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "资源名称回显成功，关联 ID 保持不变。";
  }
  return data.filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id));
};
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = async ({ event, type }) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  await delay(lifetime.signal);
  // 演示服务端校验；生产环境还应验证权限、版本和全量时段冲突。
  if (
    type !== "remove" &&
    event.resourceIds?.some((id) => !data.some((item) => item.id === id))
  )
    throw new Error("资源不存在");
  feedback.value = "模拟接口保存成功，日程只保存 resourceIds，不保存显示名称。";
};
function resourceError(
  _error: unknown,
  context: SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
) {
  failedOperation.value = context.type;
  feedback.value =
    context.type === "resolve"
      ? "回显失败：ID 仍保留，点击日程内的重试按钮。"
      : "搜索失败：可在下拉框内重试。";
}
function retryHydration() {
  failNextResolve.value = true;
  revision.value++;
}
function useNextPage() {
  page.value = (page.value + 1) % 6;
}
</script>
```

### Remote Events

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/remote-events.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >翻页按可见范围请求；返回已访问日期命中 30
      秒缓存。可模拟失败后重试，也可连续切换日期，验证慢响应不会覆盖最新页面。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="refresh()">刷新 / 重试</c-button>
      <c-button @click="jump(1)">下一天</c-button>
      <c-button @click="jump(-1)">上一天</c-button>
      <c-checkbox v-model="fail">模拟加载失败</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="outOfOrder">模拟乱序响应</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-tag>请求 {{ requests }} 次</c-tag>
      <c-tag>{{
        loading
          ? "加载中"
          : error
            ? "加载失败，请重试"
            : `已加载 ${events.length} 项`
      }}</c-tag>
      <c-tag>{{ status }}</c-tag>
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      v-model:date="date"
      default-mode="day"
      :readonly="loading || !!error"
      :before-transaction="persist"
      @range-change="range = $event"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { useSchedulerDataSource } from "../use-data-source";
import {
  applySchedulerTransaction,
  cloneSchedulerEvent,
  isSchedulerEventInRange,
  schedulerDate,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerDate, SchedulerEvent, SchedulerRange } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const date = ref<SchedulerDate>("2026-09-09");
const range = ref<SchedulerRange>();
const fail = ref(false);
const outOfOrder = ref(false);
const requests = ref(0);
const status = ref("编辑日程会保存到模拟服务端");
let database: SchedulerEvent[] = Array.from({ length: 90 }, (_, index) => ({
  id: `remote-${index}`,
  title: `远程计划 ${index + 1}`,
  start: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 9),
  end: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 10),
}));
const { events, loading, error, refresh } = useSchedulerDataSource({
  range,
  requestEvents: async (query) => {
    const sequence = ++requests.value;
    const shouldFail = fail.value;
    const ignoreAbort = outOfOrder.value;
    const result = database
      .filter((event) => isSchedulerEventInRange(event, query))
      .map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(new Error("Aborted"));
      };
      const timer = setTimeout(
        () => {
          query.signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
          resolve();
        },
        ignoreAbort ? (sequence % 2 ? 1800 : 200) : 450,
      );
      if (!ignoreAbort)
        query.signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    });
    if (shouldFail) throw new Error("模拟接口失败");
    return result;
  },
});
function jump(offset: number) {
  const next = schedulerDate(date.value);
  next.setDate(next.getDate() + offset);
  date.value = next;
}
const persist: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = async (context) => {
  // Send the delta to the backend, never replace the full database with a loaded window.
  database = applySchedulerTransaction(database, context.changes);
  status.value = `已保存 ${context.changes.length} 项变更；查询缓存随 v-model 更新失效`;
};
</script>
```

### Async Change

Preview configuration: `:model-value="events"`, `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="resource-day"`, `:resources="resources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/async-change.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="scheduler-async-demo">
    <c-space direction="column" block>
      <c-space>
        <c-checkbox v-model="reject">下一次模拟保存失败</c-checkbox>
        <c-checkbox v-model="accept">父组件接受更新</c-checkbox>
        <c-button @click="reset">重置日程</c-button>
      </c-space>
      <p>
        本地模拟 600ms
        保存；失败开关在一次失败后自动复位，可直接重试。取消或父组件拒绝提案不改变已保存值。
      </p>
      <c-scheduler
        :model-value="events"
        default-date="2026-09-09"
        default-mode="resource-day"
        :resources="resources"
        :before-change="beforeChange"
        @update:model-value="update"
        @change="outcome = accept ? '父组件已接受' : '父组件未接受提案'"
        @change-error="outcome = '保存失败，原值不变'"
      />
      <p role="status">{{ outcome }}；活动请求：{{ pendingCount }}</p>
      <ul aria-label="异步已提交日程">
        <li v-for="event in events" :key="event.id" :data-demo-event="event.id">
          {{ event.title }}：{{ event.start ?? "未排期" }} →
          {{ event.end ?? "未排期" }}；资源：{{ event.resourceIds?.join(",") }}
        </li>
      </ul>
    </c-space>
  </section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerBeforeChange } from "../props";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import { createEvents, resources } from "./data";
const events = ref(createEvents());
const reject = ref(false);
const accept = ref(true);
const outcome = ref("尚未操作");
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const pending = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = () =>
  new Promise<boolean>((resolve, rejectRequest) => {
    const fail = reject.value;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      pending.delete(timer);
      pendingCount.value = pending.size;
      if (fail) {
        reject.value = false;
        rejectRequest(new Error("模拟接口失败"));
      } else resolve(true);
    }, 600);
    pending.set(timer, () => resolve(false));
    pendingCount.value = pending.size;
  });
function update(value: SchedulerEvent[]) {
  if (accept.value) events.value = value;
}
function cancelPending() {
  pending.forEach((cancel, timer) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    cancel();
  });
  pending.clear();
  pendingCount.value = 0;
}
function reset() {
  cancelPending();
  events.value = createEvents();
  outcome.value = "已重置";
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
</script>
```
