Document: llms/en-US/components/select.md

<!-- Source: src/select/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/select/ -->

# Select

Single or multiple selection with array options, controlled values and shared field presentation.

## Reading direction

Select inherits source `dir`. Standalone fields align to inline start; FormItem content-align still takes precedence when inherited. Explicit left/right alignment remains physical. Tags keep their array order and empty-search Backspace removes the last closable value. Dropdowns and picker panels retain source direction, including in a custom popup-container.

## Async arrays and clearing

useAsyncData is a public composable exported by @cedar-design/use-vue. Pass a loader to that composable and bind its data/loading to Select. Options remain arrays. An initialization call is per owner; share a parent result to avoid duplicate loading.

empty-value sets the single-selection clear result. Omitted preserves the existing behavior: empty string unless an empty-string option exists, in which case clearing may produce undefined. The event types include undefined. Multiple selection keeps its array semantics and cannot clear disabled selected options.

case-sensitive defaults to false. search-fields defaults to ['label']; ['value', 'label'] matches either field. Custom filters retain priority.

| Variable | Default |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `--c-select-popup-option-check-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-action-primary)` |
| `--c-select-popup-option-check-size` | `var(--c-sys-font-size-md)` |
| `--c-select-popup-option-check-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-4)` |

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `options` | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation | Appearance configuration comparison, Control Sizes |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections | Appearance configuration comparison, Control Sizes |
| `size` | Supports all five sizes; inherits group/form settings | Control Sizes |
| `variant` | filled, outline, standard; inherits InputGroup | Control Sizes |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Control Sizes |
| `multiple` | Multiple selection; enables search by default | Control Sizes |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

Example source: src/select/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("comparison");
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("design");
const options = [
  { label: "研发", value: "dev" },
  { label: "设计", value: "design" },
  { label: "运营", value: "ops", disabled: true },
];
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "filled", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from "vue";
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: "variant", values: ["filled", "outline", "standard"] },
  { name: "size", values: ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] },
];
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant");
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () =>
    demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)
      ?.values ?? [],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'filled', value: 'filled' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">{{ demoCopy.hint }}</p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      :aria-label="demoCopy.configuration"
      :options="
        demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({
          label: field.name,
          value: field.name,
        }))
      "
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <c-select
          v-model="value"
          :options="options"
          clearable
          v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
        ></c-select>
      </section>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo-config-comparison {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.demo-config-comparison > section {
  min-width: 0;
}
.demo-config-comparison p {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}
</style>
```

## Selection modes and options

### Multiple

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Multiple, Same Label, Optgroup |
| `multiple` | Multiple selection; enables search by default | Multiple, Same Label, Optgroup |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections | Multiple, Same Label, Options Review |
| `filterable` | Enable search; optionally retainInputValue | Same Label, Options Review |
| `options` | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation | Same Label, Group Spacing |
| `scrollbar` | Whether to enable virtual scroll bar | Multiple |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Single-selection confirmation

Applies only to overlay editing. Single selection commits and closes on choice by default; true keeps a draft until confirmation. Multiple selection defaults to confirmation. Submission still runs form validation and before-commit; rejection keeps the editor open.

Example source: src/select/__demos__/en-US/confirmation.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const immediate = ref('a')
const confirmed = ref('a')
const options = [{ value: 'a', label: 'Alpha' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Beta' }]
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>Choose and apply: {{ immediate }}</p>
    <c-select v-model="immediate" :options="options" edit-mode="click" />
    <p>Confirm before applying: {{ confirmed }}</p>
    <c-select v-model="confirmed" :options="options" edit-mode="click" need-confirm />
  </c-space>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
const multiple = ref(true)
const filterable = ref(true)
const disabled = ref(false)
const value = ref<string | string[] | undefined>([])
watch(multiple, (next) => { value.value = next ? [] : undefined })
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">

          <template #default="{ selected }"><c-tag>{{ selected ? '已选研发' : '选择研发' }}</c-tag></template>
          <template #icon><c-tag>图标</c-tag></template>
          <template #suffix><c-tag>后缀</c-tag></template>
        </c-option>
      </c-optgroup>
```

```vue
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const fallback = (value: any) => {
      return {
        value,
        label: `++${value}++`,
      }
    }
    return {
      fallback,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Filterable, Search Matching, Dropdown Scroll |
| `options` | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation | Filterable, Search Matching, Virtual List |
| `filterable` | Enable search; optionally retainInputValue | Filterable, Search Matching |
| `loading` | Loading state; blocks selection and confirmation | Filterable |
| `multiple` | Multiple selection; enables search by default | Filterable |

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-select :style="{ width: '320px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." filterable>
      <c-option>Beijing</c-option>
      <c-option>Shanghai</c-option>
      <c-option>Guangzhou</c-option>
      <c-option disabled>Disabled</c-option>
      <c-option>Shenzhen</c-option>
      <c-option>Chengdu</c-option>
      <c-option>Wuhan</c-option>
    </c-select>
    <c-select :style="{ width: '320px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." :filterable="{ retainInputValue: true }">
      <c-option>Beijing</c-option>
      <c-option>Shanghai</c-option>
      <c-option>Guangzhou</c-option>
      <c-option disabled>Disabled</c-option>
      <c-option>Shenzhen</c-option>
      <c-option>Chengdu</c-option>
      <c-option>Wuhan</c-option>
    </c-select>
    <c-select
      :options="options"
      :style="{ width: '320px' }"
      :loading="loading"
      placeholder="Please select ..."
      multiple
      @search="handleSearch" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const options = ref(['Option1', 'Option2', 'Option3'])
    const loading = ref(false)

    const handleSearch = (value: any) => {
      if (value) {
        loading.value = true
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          options.value = [`${value}-Option1`, `${value}-Option2`, `${value}-Option3`]
          loading.value = false
        }, 2000)
      } else {
        options.value = []
      }
    }

    return {
      options,
      loading,
      handleSearch,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Search Matching

Example source: src/select/__demos__/search-matching.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("");
const mode = ref("label");
const caseSensitive = ref(false);
const modes = [
  { value: "label", label: "默认：只匹配 label" },
  { value: "both", label: "配置：value 或 label" },
];
const options = [
  { value: "USER_A", label: "Apple" },
  { value: "USER_B", label: "Banana" },
];
const searchFields = computed<("label" | "value")[]>(() =>
  mode.value === "both" ? ["value", "label"] : ["label"],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" fill>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="匹配字段">
      <c-radio-group
        v-model="mode"
        aria-label="匹配字段"
        :options="modes"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-space
      ><c-switch v-model="caseSensitive" /><span>区分大小写</span></c-space
    >
    <c-select
      v-model="value"
      :options="options"
      :case-sensitive="caseSensitive"
      :search-fields="searchFields"
      :search-delay="0"
      filterable
      placeholder="输入 Apple、apple 或 USER_A"
    />
    <p>
      默认搜索 label，不区分大小写；配置两字段后，USER_A 和 Apple
      都能找到同一个选项。
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Slots Review

Example source: src/select/__demos__/slots-review.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref<string[]>(['dev'])
const selectedSlot = ref(false)
const triggerSlot = ref(false)
const clears = ref(0)
const options = [{ value: 'dev', label: '研发' }, { value: 'design', label: '设计' }, { value: 'ops', label: '运营', disabled: true }]
function onClear(clear: (event: MouseEvent) => void, event: MouseEvent) {
  clears.value++
  clear(event)
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-space>
      <c-checkbox v-model="selectedSlot">自定义已选区</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="triggerSlot">自定义触发器</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <c-select v-model="value" :options="options" multiple filterable clearable placeholder="复杂插槽审查" :style="{ width: '320px' }">
      <template #prefix><c-tag>前缀</c-tag></template>
      <template #suffix><c-tag>后缀</c-tag></template>
      <template #header><c-tag>菜单页头</c-tag></template>
      <template #footer><c-tag>菜单页脚</c-tag></template>
      <template #option="{ data }"><c-tag>选项：{{ data.label }}</c-tag></template>
      <template #label="{ data }"><c-tag>已选：{{ data.label }}</c-tag></template>
      <template #clear-icon="{ clear }"><c-button size="xs" @mousedown.prevent @click.stop="onClear(clear, $event)">插槽清空</c-button></template>
      <template #arrow-icon><c-tag>展开</c-tag></template>
      <template #search-icon><c-tag>搜索</c-tag></template>
      <template #loading-icon><c-tag>加载</c-tag></template>
      <template #empty><c-tag>无匹配选项</c-tag></template>
      <template #read="{ text }"><c-tag>阅读：{{ text }}</c-tag></template>
      <template v-if="selectedSlot" #selected><c-tag>已选区域：{{ value.join(' / ') }}</c-tag></template>
      <template v-if="triggerSlot" #trigger><c-button>插槽打开选择器</c-button></template>
    </c-select>
    <p role="status">当前值：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}；插槽清空：{{ clears }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Value model and linked fields

### Selection Data Flow

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `options` | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation | Selection Data Flow, Linkage, Empty recognition and clear output |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections | Empty recognition and clear output, Interaction state comparison |
| `edit-mode` | Field presentation; inherits FormItem/Form when omitted | Selection Data Flow |
| `default-active-first-option` | On opening, activate the first enabled candidate if no valid selected option exists. Highlighting does not update modelValue or emit change; an existing valid selection takes priority | Selection Data Flow |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Selection Data Flow |
| `empty-value` | Clear output override; return an array for multiple selection and preserve protected items | Empty recognition and clear output |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/select/__demos__/selection-data-flow.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";

const copy = useDemoLocale("selectionDataFlow");
const autoFirst = ref(true);
const generation = ref(0);
const form = reactive<{ city?: string; panelCity?: string }>({
  city: undefined,
  panelCity: undefined,
});
const logs = reactive<{ inline: string[]; panel: string[] }>({
  inline: [],
  panel: [],
});
const counts = reactive({ inline: 0, panel: 0 });
const options = computed(() => [
  { label: copy.value.hangzhou, value: "hangzhou" },
  { label: copy.value.shanghai, value: "shanghai" },
  {
    label: copy.value.beijing,
    value: "beijing",
    disabled: true,
  },
]);
function show(value: unknown) {
  return value === undefined ? "undefined" : JSON.stringify(value);
}
function record(kind: "inline" | "panel", event: string, value: unknown) {
  if (event === "update:modelValue") {
    counts[kind]++;
  }
  logs[kind].unshift(`${event}(${show(value)})`);
  logs[kind].splice(8);
}
function reset() {
  generation.value++;
  form.city = undefined;
  form.panelCity = undefined;
  counts.inline = counts.panel = 0;
  logs.inline = [];
  logs.panel = [];
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="selection-data-flow">
    <c-checkbox v-model="autoFirst" @change="reset"
      >defaultActiveFirstOption = {{ autoFirst }}</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-button @click="reset">{{ copy.reset }}</c-button>
    <p>
      {{ copy.hint }}
    </p>

    <section>
      <h4>inline · {{ copy.inlineTitle }}</h4>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
        <c-select
          :key="`inline-${generation}`"
          v-model="form.city"
          edit-mode="direct"
          :options="options"
          :default-active-first-option="autoFirst"
          :placeholder="copy.cityPlaceholder"
          @update:model-value="record('inline', 'update:modelValue', $event)"
          @change="record('inline', 'change', $event)"
          @open-change="record('inline', 'open-change', $event)"
        >
          <template #footer>
            <p class="panel-value">
              form.city = {{ show(form.city) }} · update:modelValue ×
              {{ counts.inline }}
            </p>
          </template>
        </c-select>
      </c-form-item>
      <p>
        {{ copy.inlineHint }}
      </p>
      <p role="status">
        form.city = <code>{{ show(form.city) }}</code> · update:modelValue ×
        {{ counts.inline }}
      </p>
      <ol v-if="logs.inline.length" aria-live="polite">
        <li v-for="(entry, index) in logs.inline" :key="index">
          <code>{{ entry }}</code>
        </li>
      </ol>
      <p v-else>
        {{ copy.noEvents }}
      </p>
    </section>

    <section>
      <h4>click · {{ copy.panelTitle }}</h4>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
        <c-select
          :key="`panel-${generation}`"
          v-model="form.panelCity"
          edit-mode="click"
          need-confirm
          :options="options"
          :default-active-first-option="autoFirst"
          :placeholder="copy.panelPlaceholder"
          @update:model-value="record('panel', 'update:modelValue', $event)"
          @change="record('panel', 'change', $event)"
          @open-change="record('panel', 'open-change', $event)"
        >
          <template #footer>
            <p class="panel-value">
              {{ copy.committedValue }}：{{ show(form.panelCity) }} ·
              update:modelValue × {{ counts.panel }}
            </p>
          </template>
        </c-select>
      </c-form-item>
      <p>
        {{ copy.panelHint }}
      </p>
      <p role="status">
        form.panelCity = <code>{{ show(form.panelCity) }}</code> ·
        update:modelValue × {{ counts.panel }}
      </p>
      <ol v-if="logs.panel.length" aria-live="polite">
        <li v-for="(entry, index) in logs.panel" :key="index">
          <code>{{ entry }}</code>
        </li>
      </ol>
      <p v-else>
        {{ copy.noEvents }}
      </p>
    </section>
    <p>
      {{ copy.logsHint }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.selection-data-flow {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.selection-data-flow section {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.selection-data-flow p,
.selection-data-flow h4 {
  margin: 0;
}
.selection-data-flow code {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.panel-value {
  padding: 8px;
}
</style>
```

### Linkage

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-select :style="{ width: '200px' }" v-model="province">
      <c-option v-for="value of Object.keys(data)" :key="value">{{ value }}</c-option>
    </c-select>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref, watch } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const province = ref('Sichuan')
    const city = ref('Chengdu')
    const data = {
      Beijing: ['Haidian', 'Chaoyang', 'Changping'],
      Sichuan: ['Chengdu', 'Mianyang', 'Aba'],
      Guangdong: ['Guangzhou', 'Shenzhen', 'Shantou'],
    }

    watch(province, () => {
      city.value = ''
    })

    return {
      province,
      city,
      data,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Empty recognition and clear output

This example keeps an empty string as the valid All option and clears to null. Compare the selected All option with the cleared state in the model output. Deleting the search query does not remove the selected value. The additional fields show multiple selection clearing to [] and a factory explicitly producing undefined, each with its own model output.

Example source: src/select/__demos__/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ status: "" as string | null });
const multiple = ref(["active"]);
const optional = ref<string | undefined>("active");
const options = [
  { value: "", label: "All" },
  { value: "active", label: "Active" },
];
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      All uses an empty string as a valid option value. Clearing produces null.
    </p>
    <c-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item field="status" label="Status">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.status"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-values="[null, undefined]"
          :empty-value="null"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="model.status = ''">Choose All</c-button>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model.status) }}</output>
    </p>
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item label="Multiple: clear to []">
        <c-select
          v-model="multiple"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          multiple
          clearable
          :empty-value="() => []"
        />
        <output>{{ JSON.stringify(multiple) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="Single: clear to undefined">
        <c-select
          v-model="optional"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="() => undefined"
        />
        <output>{{ String(optional) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Async data and search

### Loading

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `loading` | Loading state; blocks selection and confirmation | Loading, Search, Async Devices |
| `options` | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation | Search, Async Devices, Async Source |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Loading, Search, Async Devices |
| `filterable` | Enable search; optionally retainInputValue | Async Devices, Async Source, Async Data |

Example source: src/select/__demos__/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("selectLoadingInline");

import { ref } from "vue";

const busy = ref(true);
const value = ref("beijing");
const selected = ref(["beijing"]);
const options = [
  {
    get label() {
```

### Search

Example source: src/select/__demos__/search.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <div>Show selections after search options</div>
    <c-select
      :style="{ width: '320px' }"
      :loading="loading"
      placeholder="Please select ..."
      multiple
      :filter-option="false"
      @search="handleSearch"
    >
      <c-option v-for="item of options" :key="item" :value="item">{{ item }}</c-option>
    </c-select>
    <div>Hide selections after search options</div>
    <c-select
      :options="options"
      :style="{ width: '320px' }"
      :loading="loading"
      placeholder="Please select ..."
      multiple
      :filter-option="false"
      :show-extr-options="false"
      @search="handleSearch" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const options = ref(['Option1', 'Option2', 'Option3'])
    const loading = ref(false)

    const handleSearch = (value: any) => {
      if (value) {
        loading.value = true
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          options.value = [`${value}-Option1`, `${value}-Option2`, `${value}-Option3`]
          loading.value = false
        }, 2000)
      } else {
        options.value = []
      }
    }

    return {
      options,
      loading,
      handleSearch,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Async Data

Example source: src/select/__demos__/en-US/async-data.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref('')
// Replace this loader body with your API and response mapping.
async function request(query: string, { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }) {
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const abort = () => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(new Error('Cancelled')) }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort); resolve() }, 300)
    if (signal.aborted) { abort(); return }
    signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true })
  })
  return [{ value: 'a', label: 'Alice' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Bob' }].filter(option => option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
}
const error = ref('')
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-select v-model="value" :options="request" filterable @load-error="error = 'Load failed'" />
    <p role="alert">{{ error }}</p>
    <p>Selected: {{ value }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Selected rows show a primary-colored right-side checkmark in both single/multiple modes; candidate highlighting alone does not. In confirmation editors, checkmarks reflect draft selection, committed to Form on confirmation. Disabled selected items retain disabled appearance.

### Clear values

`SelectValue` includes `undefined`. By default, single-select clear emits `''`; if the current options contain a `value: ''` option, it emits `undefined` to distinguish clearing from selecting that option. This published behavior is preserved. Both `change` and `update:modelValue` use `SelectValue`.

`empty-value` defines clear output; omission preserves the existing fallback. Single selection can use `() => undefined` to explicitly return undefined; multiple selection should return an array matching its model shape. Protected disabled selections take priority and prevent the clear override from running. Controlled mode still requires parent acceptance.

Root and component entries export `SelectValue` and `SelectEmptyValue`.

### Select Props

Use `v-model`, `v-model:open` and `v-model:input-value` for controlled state. Clear values are `''` for single selection and `[]` for multiple selection. Select uses `undefined` when an actual empty-string option exists.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| need-confirm | Applies only to overlay editing. Single selection commits and closes on choice by default; true keeps a draft until confirmation. Multiple selection defaults to confirmation. Submission still runs form validation and before-commit; rejection keeps the editor open. | `boolean` | Single `false`; multiple `true` |
| `open-trigger-target` | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | `'field' \| 'icon'` | `'field'` |

### Select Events / Methods

- `update:modelValue`, `change(value)`: emitted on commit, not while editing a draft.
- `update:open`, `open-change(open)`: request an expanded-state change.
- `update:inputValue`, `input-value-change(text)`, `search(text)`: search state.
- `focus(event)`, `blur(event)`, `clear(event)`: native field events; only the field owner notifies Form.
- Methods: `focus()`, `blur()`.

Select also emits `remove(value)`, `exceed-limit(value, event)`, `dropdown-scroll(event)`, and `dropdown-reach-bottom(event)`.

### Slots and option data

Use `label({ data })` for custom `selected` labels; `selected` replaces the whole selection area. Also supports `prefix`, `suffix`, `clear-icon({ clear })`, `arrow-icon`, `loading-icon`, `search-icon`, `empty`, and `option({ data })`.

An option’s `label` is plain text used for search. Use `render` or the `option` slot for custom option content, and `format-label` or the `label` slot for custom selected-value rendering. Options are identified by value rather than label. An option’s `disabled` prevents selection and removal, while `tagProps` customizes its selected tag. It supports attributes such as `style` and listeners such as `onClose`; Select controls tag visibility and removability according to its current state, and close events also participate in Select’s removal flow.

Select additionally supports `header`, `footer`, `trigger`, and default `Option / Optgroup` children. Option props: `value`, `label`, `disabled`, `tagProps`, `index`; its default slot receives `selected`. Group data uses `{ isGroup: true, label, options }`. List and Picker also accept slot options; Picker displays their text labels.

Single/multiple options both use popup-option-padding-horizontal. There is no implicit search-highlight DOM; custom option slots style their own highlighted fragments. 

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Type imports

Root and component entries export `SelectEmits`、`SelectSlots`、`SelectExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

### Search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

filterable enables entering a search query. filterOption controls only local matching and never sends requests. With an options loader, remote results are not filtered again by default; with only an array, local matching is enabled by default. Most callers do not need filter-option.

```vue
<c-select v-model="value" :options="loadOptions" filterable />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omission preserves the existing default. The UI displays null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In confirmation mode, clearing changes the draft and confirm commits it; without confirmation, clearing commits directly.

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

In direct mode, focus() targets the native input. In closed deferred mode it focuses the reference without opening; when open it targets the current editor. blur() blurs the current input or editor without reopening or simulating selection. Cached and remounted editors both resolve the current target.

Public SelectInstance/SelectExpose and PeopleSelectInstance/PeopleSelectExpose reflect the existing methods. PeopleSelectExpose is available from the root and component subentry. refresh() returns `Promise<void>` and reloads function-based options through the existing protocol; it does not represent completion of saving or business actions.

SelectEditMode is exported consistently from root and select subentries, retaining each platform public edit-mode values.

### Selection actions during loading

While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching.

Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing.

Pass business data through object `value` or `options`.

Multiple empty-value supports arrays, null/undefined and empty values recognized by empty-values; other scalars are rejected. Factories run only for a real clear with no disabled retained selections; invalid results produce a development diagnostic and fall back to [], without publishing an invalid scalar.

Follow-up acceptance testing (not yet completed): use real screen readers, such as VoiceOver and NVDA, with supported browsers to verify spoken field names, single and multiple selection, groups and virtual lists, keyboard navigation, loading, and form errors.

```vue
  loading.value = true;
  clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = setTimeout(() => {

  }, 2000);
}
```

## API

### Skeleton Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------- | ------------------------- | :-----: |
| loading | Whether to display the loading skeleton | `boolean` | `true` |
| animation | Whether skeleton animation is enabled | `boolean` | `true` |
| title | Whether to show a title placeholder | `boolean` | `false` |
| avatar | Whether to show an avatar placeholder | `boolean` | `false` |
| card | Whether to show a card placeholder | `boolean` | `false` |
| rows | The paragraph number of rows | `number \| string` | `3` |
| rows-width | Width of each row | `Array<number \| string>` | `[]` |
| title-width | Title placeholder width; falls back to the theme variable, `50%` by default | `number \| string` | `-` |
| avatar-size | Avatar placeholder size; falls back to the theme variable, `34px` by default | `number \| string` | `-` |
| card-height | Card placeholder height; falls back to the theme variable, `160px` by default | `number \| string` | `-` |
| fullscreen | Whether to use a fullscreen placeholder | `boolean` | `false` |
| fullscreen-z-index | Fullscreen placeholder stacking level | `number \| string` | `100` |

### Skeleton Slots

| Slot | Description |
| -------- | -------------------- |
| default | Actual content after loading |
| template | Custom loading placeholder |

### SkeletonLine Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------- | :----: |
| rows | Row count; non-finite and negative values become zero, fractions are rounded down | `number` | `1` |
| widths | Line skeleton width | `Array<number \| string>` | `[]` |
| line-height | Line skeleton height | `number` | `20` |
| line-spacing | Line skeleton row spacing | `number` | `15` |

### SkeletonShape Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------ | -------------- | ---------------------- | :--------: |
| shape | Graphic skeleton shape | `'square' \| 'circle'` | `'square'` |
| size | Graphic skeleton size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |

## Usage notes





### Fullscreen coverage

`fullscreen` renders an inline `position: fixed` placeholder without automatically teleporting to body. It covers the viewport when no ancestor establishes a fixed positioning containing block. An ancestor with `transform`, a relevant `will-change`, or `contain` may limit coverage to that ancestor. To cover the viewport, place Skeleton outside those ancestors or arrange its position with Vue Teleport in the application. This loading placeholder does not manage modal focus. See [CSS Positioned Layout fixed containing blocks](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-position-3/#fixed-cb).

Omitted size props use their theme tokens. A `-` in the table means there is no Prop default, rather than no placeholder size. Both Line and the main component normalize non-finite and negative row counts to zero and round fractions down.

### Motion

Built-in Skeleton placeholders and standalone Line/Shape primitives default to `aria-hidden="true"`. The root exposes waiting through `aria-busy`. Custom `template` content and the loaded default content remain accessible and can supply business status messages.

### Controlled Range

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.

Example source: src/slider/__demos__/controlled-range.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const accepted = ref([30, 70]);
const proposed = ref(50);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="28px" style="padding: 24px 12px">
    <c-slider
      v-model="accepted"
      range
      show-tooltip="always"
      :aria-label="['Minimum', 'Maximum']"
    />
    <c-slider
      :model-value="50"
      aria-label="Controlled rejection"
      @update:model-value="proposed = $event"
    />
    <output>{{ proposed }}</output>
    <c-slider :default-value="40" readonly aria-label="Read only" />
    <c-slider :default-value="40" disabled aria-label="Disabled" />
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Canceled pointer interactions

Every accepted pointer `start` has one `end`, including cancellation by disabling/readonly, bounds/step/orientation/range changes, capture loss, owner-window blur, KeepAlive deactivation, or unmount. `end` carries the last proposal from that gesture, or its initial value if it never proposed a change; changing range mode does not convert the old gesture's payload shape. Cancellation ends interaction, does not roll back earlier `change` proposals, and does not manufacture another model update. The parent still controls whether to accept proposals. A late pointerup/move cannot end the same gesture twice. Notification return Promises are not awaited.

Example source: src/slider/__demos__/interaction-session.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("sliderInteractionSessionInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SliderValue } from "..";
const value = ref(20);
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const max = ref(100);
const starts = ref(0);
const ends = ref<SliderValue[]>([]);
function recordEnd(next: SliderValue) {
  ends.value.push(next);
}
function keyboard(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
  if (!["d", "r", "m"].includes(key)) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  if (key === "d") disabled.value = !disabled.value;
  if (key === "r") readonly.value = !readonly.value;
  if (key === "m") max.value = max.value === 100 ? 80 : 100;
}
function restore() {
  disabled.value = false;
  readonly.value = false;
  max.value = 100;
}
</script>
<template>
  <div style="width: 100%; padding: 24px 0" @keydown="keyboard">
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.whileDraggingPressDR }}</p>
    <c-slider
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :max="max"
      :aria-label="inlineCopy.sessionEnd"
      @start="starts++"
      @end="recordEnd"
    />
    <p role="status">
      start: {{ starts }}；end: {{ ends.length }}{{ inlineCopy.lastProposal }}
      {{ JSON.stringify(ends.at(-1)) ?? "—" }}
    </p>
    <p>
      value: {{ value }}；disabled: {{ disabled }}；readonly:
      {{ readonly }}；max: {{ max }}
    </p>
    <c-button @click="restore">{{ inlineCopy.restoreControls }}</c-button>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Steps align to a decimal grid anchored at min, retaining exact endpoints and range constraints; representable decimal and exponential steps are supported. The public model remains Number; increments below its representable spacing cannot be expressed. format-tooltip only changes display. Numeric inputs follow their normal blur commit and validation flow; Slider does not add another value publication.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Slider Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value | SliderValue / null | undefined | Controlled number or range pair; null is explicitly empty. |
| default-value | SliderValue | 0 | Uncontrolled initial value; ranges normalize to an ascending pair. |
| min | number / string | 0 | Finite minimum, accepting decimal and exponential numeric strings. |
| max | number / string | 100 | Finite maximum; interaction is blocked when it does not exceed min. |
| step | number / string | 1 | Positive finite step anchored at min; invalid values fall back to 1. |
| range | boolean | false | Two-thumb range with ordered, noncrossing endpoints. |
| orientation | 'horizontal' / 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | Track orientation; invalid values produce a development diagnostic. |
| disabled | boolean | undefined | Disable interaction; inherited from the form when omitted. |
| readonly | boolean | undefined | Readonly retains focus and tooltips while blocking value changes. |
| error | boolean | undefined | Error appearance, inherited from the form when omitted. |
| marks | Record<number, string> | undefined | Text marks at positions within the range. |
| show-ticks | boolean | false | Display step ticks, capped at 1000. |
| show-input | boolean | false | Show an accompanying InputNumber, or two in range mode. The slider’s aria-describedby also applies to the number inputs and is combined with form error descriptions. An explicit aria-description is forwarded to both the slider and number inputs. Browsers prioritize a resolvable aria-describedby, so the two descriptions are not necessarily combined. |
| show-tooltip | boolean / 'always' | true | True shows on hover, focus or drag; false hides; always remains visible. |
| format-tooltip | SliderTooltipFormatter | undefined | Format tooltips and aria-valuetext without changing the model. |
| aria-label | string / [string, string] | undefined | Single-thumb name or names for the two range thumbs. |
| active-color | string | undefined | Selected track color. |
| track-color | string | undefined | Background track color. |
| thumb-color | string | undefined | Thumb color. |
| label-color | string | undefined | Tooltip background color. |
| label-text-color | string | undefined | Tooltip text color. |
| track-height | number / string | undefined | Track thickness, with numeric values in px; invalid lengths preserve theme defaults. |
| thumb-size | number / string | undefined | Thumb diameter, with numeric values in px; invalid lengths preserve theme defaults. |
| edit-mode | FieldEditMode<br>`'direct' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'` | undefined | Field editing entry, inherited from the form when omitted, otherwise direct. |
| read-pretty | boolean | undefined | Common pure-reading state, independent of readonly and disabled. |
| before-commit | BeforeFieldCommit | undefined | Deferred confirmation protocol ({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal }); complete with a boolean, Promise or done; synchronous undefined waits for done. |
| open | boolean | undefined | Controlled deferred editor state. |
| default-open | boolean | false | Initial uncontrolled deferred editor state. |
| popup-container | PopupContainer | undefined | Deferred editor mount target: selector, HTMLElement or false. |
| clearable | boolean | false | Provide clearing in the deferred editor; does not add a clear button to the inline slider. |
| empty-value | SliderProps['emptyValue'] | undefined | Published clear override, including explicit null. |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | undefined | Empty-value recognition inherited through field, FormItem and Form. |
| empty-text | string | undefined | Default empty reading text; defaults to a dash after inheritance. |

In range mode, `aria-labelledby` names the range group; an `aria-label` array still names the two thumbs. An explicit `role` takes precedence.

### Behavior and keyboard

Arrows adjust by step, PageUp/PageDown by 10 steps, Home/End reach available endpoints. Range-thumb ARIA min/max follow the other thumb. When overlapping, clicks left/down separate the lower thumb, right/up the upper thumb. Keyboard events inside interactive thumb content are not intercepted. Readonly retains focus/tooltips; disabled leaves the Tab sequence.

Pointer Events unify mouse, touch and pen. pointerup commits final coordinates; pointercancel/lost capture ends the latest proposal. Disabling, unmounting or KeepAlive deactivation cleans listeners/capture and stops value events. Horizontal sliders allow vertical page scrolling; vertical sliders allow horizontal scrolling.

Controlled display changes only after parent updates; normalization does not emit automatically. change/update:model-value report distinct proposals; end includes the final proposal without guaranteeing acceptance. Each keyboard/numeric-input operation has start/end; a drag has one pair. Internal InputNumber does not duplicate Form validation.

### Slider Events

| Event | Arguments | Meaning |
| ------------------ | ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| update:model-value | `SliderValue` | Request an update |
| change | `SliderValue` | Distinct numeric proposal paired with the model event |
| start | — | Interaction starts |
| end | `SliderValue` | Final proposal when interaction ends |

### Slider Slots / Methods

The button slot receives { currentValue, index }; custom content retains keyboard behavior, ARIA and tooltips. The read slot receives { value, text }, retaining null/undefined and range models; text is the formatted value. focus(index=0) focuses the displayed thumb; blur() blurs the currently focused owned element, including show-input numeric controls, without affecting outside controls.

Exports SliderProps, SliderValue, SliderOrientation, SliderTooltipFormatter, SliderTooltipVisibility, SliderEmits, SliderSlots, SliderExpose, SliderInstance and runtime sliderProps.

## Separators and wrapping

### Split wrapping and content state

Change wrapping, direction and order after typing a draft. A separator stays with its preceding item and may appear at a line end.

Example source: src/space/__demos__/split-wrapping.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("spaceSplitWrappingInline");

import { ref } from "vue";

const wrap = ref(true);
const direction = ref<"row" | "column">("row");
const items = ref(["A", "B", "C"]);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space wrap :size="8">
    <c-button data-space-toggle-wrap @click="wrap = !wrap">{{
      inlineCopy.wrap
    }}</c-button>
    <c-button
      data-space-toggle-direction
      @click="direction = direction === 'row' ? 'column' : 'row'"
      >{{ inlineCopy.direction }}</c-button
    >
    <c-button data-space-reorder @click="items = [...items].reverse()">{{
      inlineCopy.reorder
    }}</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <p>{{ inlineCopy.draftsStayWithTheirItems }}</p>
  <div style="max-width: 100%; overflow: auto">

      data-space-split-demo
      :size="12"
      :wrap="wrap"
      :direction="direction"
      style="width: 260px; max-width: 100%"

          <span>Item {{ item }}</span>
          <c-input
            edit-mode="direct"
            :aria-label="'Draft ' + item"
            :placeholder="inlineCopy.draft"
          />
        </label>
      </template>
      <template #split><span aria-hidden="true">/</span></template>

  flex-direction: column;

  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest native `dir`. `direction="row"` follows reading order; `column` remains top to bottom. justify/align flex-start and flex-end follow their respective flex axes. `size=[rowGap,columnGap]` always describes row and `column` gaps without swapping in RTL. Wrapping and split slots follow content order. Direction changes do not reverse data or recreate children with stable keys.

## API

### Children and size boundaries

Reordering keyed Fragment groups preserves local child identity. Whitespace, empty text, comments and empty Fragments do not generate spacing items. Meaningful text, numeric zero and empty elements are retained. Empty split content does not produce separators.

With wrap and split, a separator follows the previous item and may appear at a line end; hiding separators at every line boundary is not guaranteed. An item wider than its available line may still overflow. Without wrap, existing Flex gap and justify allocation remain. Layout switches do not recreate content nodes.

block switches the container between flex and inline-flex. align=stretch stretches the internal item wrapper without guaranteeing that its control fills it. Use the child control's block or width:100% when needed.

Invalid size shapes, negative/nonfinite numbers and arrays other than pairs fall back to md with development diagnostics. Array entries are lengths and do not accept preset names. CSS var/calc expressions remain supported; the browser handles syntax and resolved lengths.

### Space Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| direction | Row/column order of children, default row; column stacks them vertically. Does not use horizontal/vertical values | _string_ | `row` |
| justify | Main axis arrangement, Can be set to `flex-start` `flex-end` `center` `space-around` `space-between` `space-evenly` | _string_ | `flex-start` |
| align | Cross-axis alignment: `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `stretch` or `baseline`. When omitted, inferred from `direction`: `row` → `center`, `column` → `stretch` | _string_ | `-` |
| size | Gap: `xs`/`sm`/`md`/`lg`/`xl` or `[rowGap, columnGap]`, supporting CSS lengths and shorthand | _string \| number \| [string \| number, string \| number]_ | `md` |
| wrap | Whether to exceed the line break | _boolean_ | `false` |
| block | Uses a flex container; false uses inline-flex | _boolean_ | `true` |

### Space Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ---------- | ---- |
| `default` | Content of space | `-` |
| `split` | Range separator | `-` |

## Types

```ts
import type { SpaceProps, SpaceSize, SpaceDirection, SpaceAlign, SpaceJustify, SpaceInternalSize, SpaceInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```

## Usage notes



Both default to `size="md"`, `wrap=false`, `block=true` and `direction="row"`. Omitted align means center for row and stretch for column. Maple callers previously relying on default wrapping must add `wrap` explicitly.

`size` supports all five presets, numbers/numeric strings in px, CSS lengths/expressions such as 1rem or var(--gap), and `[rowGap, columnGap]`. Arrays are always row then column; direction does not swap them. Array entries are lengths, not preset names. Shared [row,column] presets: xs=[4,4], sm=[8,6], md=[12,8], lg=[16,12], xl=[24,16] px, overridable through CSS variables.

## CSS Variables

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |

Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

## Async and dynamic data

### Async Action

`click` is a notification event. The component does not process listener return values or automatically change its loading state. Business code controls `button-props.loading`; for asynchronous operations, reset it in `finally`. Disabled or loading links have no effective `href`.

Example source: src/split-button/__demos__/async-action.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("splitButtonAsyncActionInline");

import { ref } from "vue";
import { Message } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const completed = ref(0);
const publishing = ref(false);
const publish = async () => {
  if (publishing.value) return;
  publishing.value = true;
  try {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800));
    completed.value += 1;
    Message.info(inlineCopy.value.published);
  } finally {
    publishing.value = false;
  }
};
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label));
};
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="flex-start">
    <c-split-button
      :button-props="{ loading: publishing }"
      @click="publish"
      @select="handleSelect"
    >
      发布

      <template #content>
        <c-menu-option label="保存草稿" value="draft" />
        <c-menu-option label="保存并发布" value="publish" />
        <c-menu-option label="暂无权限" value="restricted" disabled />
      </template>
    </c-split-button>
    <span aria-live="polite">完成次数: {{ completed }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

The main button sits at inline start and the menu button at inline end. LTR/RTL changes do not swap business actions or emit extra selections. Enter/Space retain native button behavior. The menu button opens via Up/Down and skips disabled options; Home/End reaches boundaries, Enter selects, and Escape closes and restores focus. Popovers inherit trigger direction; start/end alignment follows direction while explicit left/right stays physical. Custom downward icons are not mirrored automatically.

## Menu button name

The menu trigger defaults to a localized “More actions” name. Override it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` through `trigger-button-props`.

## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

Use `placement` to position the extra-actions menu. See `MenuPlacement` for the available values.

| color | Background color | `string` | `undefined` |

With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `MenuPlacement`<br>`'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | `bottom` |
| popup-container | Menu mount container | `PopupContainer` | `-` |
| popup-max-height | Maximum menu height | `boolean \| number` | `true` |
| popup-class | Menu popup class | `string \| array \| object` | `-` |

| hide-on-select | Close the menu after selection | `boolean` | `true` |

### SplitButton Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | -------------------------- | -------------------- |
| update:open | Emitted when an open-state update is requested | open: `boolean` |
| open-change | Emitted when an open-state update is requested | open: `boolean` |
| click | Emitted when the primary button is clicked | event: `MouseEvent` |
| select | Emitted when a menu option is selected | value, option, event |

### SplitButton Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------- | ---------------- | --------------- |
| default | Primary button content | - |
| icon | Menu trigger button icon | open: `boolean` |
| content | Menu content | - |

### SplitButton Methods

| Method | Description |
| -------- | -------------------------- |
| open() | Request menu opening; disabled prevents it |
| close() | Request menu closing |
| resize() | Recalculate menu position |

Controlled `open` emits update requests only; callers must update it. Main-button clicks bubble normally without opening the menu.

`click`, like Button's event, is a notification and does not await its listener result. Business code controls main-button loading through `button-props.loading`.

# Split

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

- `size`: The size of the segmentation, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px
- `min`: Minimum threshold, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px

## Sizes and bounds

`size/default-size/min/max` accept finite nonnegative numbers, numeric strings, and `px` or `%` strings. Unitless values from 0 to 1 are ratios; values greater than 1 are pixels. `50%` and `0.5` mean the same ratio; `1px` explicitly means one pixel. `rem`, `calc()`, negative values and nonfinite numbers are unsupported. Vue prop validation warns in development. Invalid size/default-size falls back to `0.5`, min to 0, and max to 100`%`.

Sizes use the container length along the current layout axis and stay inside the container. If min exceeds max, min wins within the container. Ratios follow container changes; pixel sizes stay unchanged while they fit. Each pane contributes half of the default 6px handle, with this adjustment clipped at the edges to prevent container overflow. Disabling removes the handle and its entire adjustment while preserving both panes and their input drafts.

Panes, ARIA, dragging and keyboard input share one effective size. When bounds or container changes make a size illegal, the component requests `update:size` once. If a controlled parent rejects it, presentation still respects the bounds and later input starts from that effective size. Controlled input within the legal range remains subject to parent acceptance. Updates are numeric ratios or px strings matching the input unit category. Ordinary notification events do not await Promises.

## API

### Split Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | :------------: |
| aria-label | Accessible name of the separator handle; blank values use the current locale default | `string` | Current locale |
| component | The html tag of the split box | `string` | `'div'` |
| orientation | Arrangement axis of the two panels: horizontal by default means left/right panels, whose divider handle is vertical | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |
| size **(v-model)** | The size of the segmentation, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `-` |
| default-size | Default split size, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `0.5` |
| min | Minimum threshold, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `-` |
| max | Maximum threshold, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `-` |
| disabled | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `false` |

### Split Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:size | Drag, keyboard or legal-bound normalization request for v-model:size | `size: number\|string` |
| move-start | Start notification for an accepted drag; not emitted without measurable container size | `event: MouseEvent` |
| moving | Notification of an active drag movement | `event: MouseEvent` |
| move-end | End notification after release or cancellation, once per accepted drag | `event: MouseEvent` |

Pointer drags may supply a PointerEvent, which extends MouseEvent. Without a native terminal event, the end payload is the press event. Keyboard input emits only update:size. Ordinary events do not collect or await listener Promises.

### Split Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------------------- | :--------------: | ---- |
| first | First panel content | - |
| resize-trigger | Resize-handle content | - |
| resize-trigger-icon | Resize-handle icon | - |
| second | Second panel content | - |

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { SplitInstance, SplitProps } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
import type { SplitProps as SubSplitProps } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue/split'
```

`--c-split-trigger-size-icon-wrapper` (default 6px) controls handle thickness: width for vertical handles, height for horizontal handles. It does not change their 100% length along the panel.

## Reading direction and interaction

Split inherits the nearest native `dir`; its first horizontal panel sits at inline start. `size/defaultSize/min/max` always describe the first panel. RTL does not convert size to `1-size`; numeric ratios and px strings retain their original units.

In horizontal RTL dragging, moving left enlarges the first panel; vertical dragging still enlarges downward. The separator is focusable. Left/Right moves it visually, or Up/Down vertically, in 10px steps or 50px with Shift. Home/End reaches min/max. Mouse and touch pointers share sizing logic. Direction/orientation changes, disabling and unmount cancel an active drag and restore the previous cursor. Legal sizes remain unchanged when orientation changes; if the new axis makes the size illegal, the component requests the effective size.

## Dragging and cancellation

An accepted mouse or pointer drag produces exactly one end notification on release, cancellation, configuration changes, KeepAlive deactivation or unmounting. Listeners and cursor ownership are released before notification. ResizeBox retains moving-start/moving-end; Split retains move-start/move-end. When no native terminal mouse event exists, the end argument is the original press event. Discrete keyboard adjustments emit value updates without creating drag start/end events. Ending stops the gesture without rolling back an applied dimension or awaiting a listener’s returned promise.

## Handle names and instances

The existing global locale or ConfigProvider supplies the default handle name. Use `aria-label` to identify a business pane, for example `aria-label="Resize navigation pane"`; it names the focusable separator handle. Custom resize-trigger or resize-trigger-icon slots retain the supplied role, range, name and keyboard behavior.

All four named slots have no scope parameters; the component does not consume a default slot. SplitInstance is the standard Vue instance type with no extra resize command methods. Drive dimensions through props and v-model:size. SplitProps includes actual props and typed model/drag listeners, consistently exported from the root and subentry.

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--c-split-trigger-bg` | `var(--c-color-neutral-3)` | `background-color` |
| `--c-split-trigger-font-size-icon` | `12px` | `font-size`, `margin` |
| `--c-split-trigger-icon-color` | `var(--c-color-text-1)` | `color` |
| `--c-split-trigger-size-icon-wrapper` | `6px` | `height`, `width` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css

}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

```vue
<template>
```

```vue
    <c-statistic
      title="比例数字（右侧标记会跳动）"
      :value="count"
      suffix="|"
      :value-style="{ fontVariantNumeric: 'proportional-nums' }"

import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'

const values = [1111, 8888, 1010, 9090]
const index = ref(0)
const count = ref(values[0])
let timer = 0

onMounted(() => {
  timer = window.setInterval(() => {
    index.value = (index.value + 1) % values.length
    count.value = values[index.value]
  }, 800)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  window.clearInterval(timer)
})
</script>
```

## Animation duration boundaries

Duration is finite nonnegative milliseconds. Zero reaches the target on the next frame. Negative, NaN and infinite values produce development prop diagnostics and safely behave as zero without continuing to request frames. Pausing or unmounting before that frame cancels completion. Changing animation-duration replays enabled numeric animation according to the existing rules.

## API

`precision` accepts integers from 0 to 100; invalid values fall back to 0. Numeric formatting uses JavaScript binary numbers and rounding and is not exact financial arithmetic. Very large values may use exponential notation; when the difference between animation endpoints overflows, the final value is shown directly. Numeric grouping follows en-US rules, `separator` replaces grouping commas, and the decimal point remains a dot; dates use local time. Non-finite numeric values produce a warning, display literally, and do not animate. An invalid animation start falls back to 0 and an invalid duration to 0 with completion on the next frame.

## Usage notes



Placeholder text updates when the default slot appears/disappears. Animation pauses on unmount/KeepAlive deactivation.

### Animation configuration and lifecycle

With `start=true`, dynamically enabling `animation` or changing the numeric target, `valueFrom` or `animationDuration` replays from the currently configured start. Formatting-only changes, such as precision or separators, do not replay. Disabling `animation` or switching to string/date immediately shows the target and stops frames. `start=false` pauses the current number; explicitly returning to `true` replays. Configuration changes while paused prepare a new start without scheduling frames. KeepAlive deactivation pauses; activation resumes unchanged configuration or resynchronizes changed configuration. Unmount releases frames.

```vue
        <c-step
          >{{ demoCopy.done
          }}<template #description>{{ demoCopy.complete }}</template></c-step
        >
      </c-steps>
    </section>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped></style>
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="frame-bg">
    <c-radio-group v-model="currentStatus" variant="button" style="margin-bottom: 16px">
      <c-radio v-for="status in statuses" :key="status" :value="status">{{ status }}</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <div class="frame-body">
      <div class="frame-aside">
        <c-steps :model-value="current" :status="currentStatus" orientation="vertical">
          <c-step>Succeeded</c-step>
          <c-step>Processing</c-step>
          <c-step>Pending</c-step>
        </c-steps>
      </div>
      <div class="frame-main">
        <div class="main-content">The content of this step.</div>
        <div class="main-bottom">
          <c-button :disabled="current === 1" @click="onPrev">
            <c-icon-left />
            Back
          </c-button>
          <c-button :disabled="current === 3" @click="onNext">
            Next
            <c-icon-right />
          </c-button>

  </div>

import { ref } from 'vue'

export default {
  setup() {
    const current = ref(1)
    const statuses = ['wait', 'process', 'finish', 'error'] as const
    const currentStatus = ref<(typeof statuses)[number]>('process')

    const onPrev = () => {
      current.value = Math.max(1, current.value - 1)
    }

    const onNext = () => {
      current.value = Math.min(3, current.value + 1)
    }

    return {
      current,
      statuses,
      currentStatus,
      onPrev,
      onNext,
    }
  },
}
</script>
```

## Interaction and control

### Changeable

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changeable` | Whether clicking can change steps | Changeable |
| `status` | Current step status | Changeable |

Example source: src/steps/__demos__/changeable.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div>
    <c-radio-group v-model="currentStatus" variant="button" style="margin-bottom: 16px">
      <c-radio v-for="status in statuses" :key="status" :value="status">{{ status }}</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-steps changeable :model-value="current" :status="currentStatus" @change="setCurrent">
      <c-step description="This is a description">Succeeded</c-step>
      <c-step description="This is a description">Processing</c-step>
      <c-step description="This is a description">Pending</c-step>
    </c-steps>
    <div
      :style="{
        width: '100%',
        height: '200px',
        textAlign: 'center',
        background: 'var(--color-bg-2)',
        color: '#C2C7CC',
      }"
    >
      <div style="line-height: 160px">Step{{ current }} Content</div>
      <c-space size="lg">
        <c-button status="secondary" :disabled="current <= 1" @click="onPrev">
          <c-icon-left />
          Back
        </c-button>
        <c-button status="primary" :disabled="current >= 3" @click="onNext">
          Next
          <c-icon-right />
        </c-button>
      </c-space>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

export default {
  setup() {
    const current = ref(1)
    const statuses = ['wait', 'process', 'finish', 'error'] as const
    const currentStatus = ref<(typeof statuses)[number]>('process')
    const onPrev = () => {
      current.value = Math.max(1, current.value - 1)
    }
    const onNext = () => {
      current.value = Math.min(3, current.value + 1)
    }

    const setCurrent = (step: number) => {
      current.value = step
    }

    return {
      current,
      statuses,
      currentStatus,
      onPrev,
      onNext,
      setCurrent,
    }
  },
}
</script>
```

## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

content-placement shares side vocabulary and spelling, not an identical set across all components. Steps implements only right/bottom; dot and navigation variants have derived rules. Unsupported sides are not added for naming uniformity.

## API

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the current step, starting at 1. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Initialization emits no `update:modelValue`. When supplied, `modelValue` is controlled by the parent.

### Steps Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| type | Steps appearance type | `'default'` \| `'arrow'` \| `'dot'` \| `'navigation'` | `'default'` |
| orientation | Horizontal/vertical axis of the step flow, default horizontal; arrow and navigation variants remain horizontal | `'horizontal'` \| `'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |
| content-placement | Content side relative to the step node: right or bottom, default right. Dot steps derive it from orientation; navigation steps always use right | `'right'` \| `'bottom'` | `'right'` |
| model-value(**v-model**) | Current step number | `number` | `-` |
| default-value | Default uncontrolled step number | `number` | `1` |
| status | Current step status | `'wait'` \| `'process'` \| `'finish'` \| `'error'` | `'process'` |
| show-line | Whether to show connectors | `boolean` | `true` |
| size | Steps size | `'sm'` \| `'md'` | `'md'` |
| changeable | Whether clicking can change steps | `boolean` | `false` |

Step values are nonnegative safe integers: 0 gives every step an automatic waiting status, and values beyond the step count give every step an automatic finished status; an individual status can override it. Invalid values warn in development and render as 1. The node slot is not rendered for arrow type, and the icon slot is not rendered for dot type. Text and native decorations in the default slot do not consume step indices.

### Steps Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------- |
| change | Emitted when the step number changes; requires `changeable` | current:`number`<br/>previous:`number`<br/>ev:`Event` |
| update:modelValue | `v-model` sync | step:`number` |

### Steps Slots

| Slot | Description |
| ----------- | ------------ |
| default | Step content |
| finish-icon | Finished status icon |
| error-icon | Error status icon |

### Step Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| title | Step title | `string` | `-` |
| description | Step description | `string` | `-` |
| status | Step status | `'wait'` \| `'process'` \| `'finish'` \| `'error'` | `-` |
| disabled | Whether the step is disabled | `boolean` | `false` |

### Step Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ----------- | ---- | --------------------------------- |
| default | Title | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| title | Title | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| node | Node | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| icon | Icon | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| description | Description | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |

## Usage notes





`active` indicates only whether the current one-based step index matches modelValue, independently of wait/process/finish/error status. A current error step remains `active`. Focus/hover do not change `active`.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Steps inherits the nearest `dir="ltr"` or `dir="rtl"`, including runtime changes. Horizontal steps, connectors and arrows follow reading direction; vertical steps remain top to bottom. Step numbers, progress values and custom icon content keep their meaning.

With `changeable`, Left/Right moves focus according to reading direction, or Up/Down vertically. Home/End focuses the first/last available step, skipping disabled items. Enter/Space confirms. Moving focus or changing reading direction does not update progress.
