### Column Manager Async

- `columns`: Column info of the table
- `data`: Table data
- `pagination`: Pagination properties configuration
- `size`: The size of the table

Example source: src/table/__demos__/column-manager-async.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space wrap justify="flex-end" style="margin-bottom: 8px">
    <c-link @click="visible = true">列管理</c-link>
  </c-space>

  <c-table
    v-model:columns="columns"
    :data="data"
    :pagination="false"
    size="xs"
  />

  <c-drawer
    v-model:open="visible"
    title="列管理"
    :width="720"
    unmount-on-close
    @confirm="handleConfirm"
  >
    <div style="height: calc(100vh - 120px)">
      <c-table-column-manager
        ref="mgrRef"
        v-model="items"
        :columns="columns"
        :load-options="loadOptions"
      />
    </div>
  </c-drawer>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from "vue";
import { stateFromColumns } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
import type {
  ColumnDefinitions,
  TableColumnData,
  TableColumnManagerInstance,
} from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";

const visible = ref(false);
const mgrRef = ref<TableColumnManagerInstance>();
const items = ref([]);

const columns = ref<TableColumnData[]>([
  { dataIndex: "name", title: "姓名", width: 120 },
  { dataIndex: "salary", title: "薪资", width: 100 },
]);

const loadOptions = async (): Promise<ColumnDefinitions> => {
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
  return [
    {
      title: "基础",
      key: "basic",
      children: [
        { dataIndex: "name", title: "姓名", required: true },
        { dataIndex: "salary", title: "薪资" },
        { dataIndex: "email", title: "邮箱" },
        { dataIndex: "address", title: "地址" },
      ],
    },
  ];
};

watch(visible, async (val) => {
  if (!val) return;
  const columnDefinitions = await loadOptions();
  const state = stateFromColumns(columns.value, columnDefinitions);
  items.value = state.items;
});

const handleConfirm = () => {
  const result = mgrRef.value?.getResult?.();
  if (result) columns.value = result.columns;
  visible.value = false;
};

const data = ref([
  { name: "Jane", salary: 23000, address: "London", email: "jane@example.com" },
]);
</script>
```

## Business workflows

### Typed Config

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | Column info of the table | Task Workbench, Form Attribute |
| `data` | Table data | Task Workbench, Form Attribute |
| `pagination` | Pagination properties configuration | Task Workbench |
| `bordered` | Whether to show border | Form Attribute |
| `hoverable` | Whether to show the hover effect | Form Attribute |
| `stripe` | Whether to enable the stripe effect | Form Attribute |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/table/__demos__/typed-config.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { defineTableConfig } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
interface User {
  id: string
  name: string
  age: number
  profile: { city: string }
}
const rows = ref<User[]>([
  { id: 'alice', name: 'Alice', age: 28, profile: { city: '杭州' } },
  { id: 'bob', name: 'Bob', age: 16, profile: { city: '宁波' } },
])
const config = computed(() => defineTableConfig<User>({
  rowKey: 'id',
  data: rows.value,
  pagination: false,
  columns: [
    { title: '姓名', dataIndex: 'name', render: ({ record }) => record.name.toUpperCase() },
    { title: '城市', dataIndex: 'profile.city' },
    { title: '年龄', dataIndex: 'age',
      sortable: { sortDirections: ['ascend', 'descend'], sorter: (a, b, { direction }) => (a.age - b.age) * (direction === 'descend' ? -1 : 1) },
      filterable: { filters: [{ text: '仅成年人', value: 'adult' }], filter: (values, record) => !values.length || !values.includes('adult') || record.age >= 18 },
    },
  ],
}))
function addRow() {
  if (rows.value.length < 3) rows.value = [...rows.value, { id: 'carol', name: 'Carol', age: 35, profile: { city: '上海' } }]
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" fill>
    <c-button :disabled="rows.length >= 3" @click="addRow">增加一行</c-button>
    <c-table v-bind="config" />
    <p role="status">业务数据：{{ rows.length }} 行；年龄列支持排序和筛选。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Task Workbench

- `columns`: Column info of the table
- `data`: Table data
- `pagination`: Pagination properties configuration

Example source: src/table/__demos__/task-workbench.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const original = () => [
  { key: "01", name: "展厅设备巡检", department: "运营部", status: "待处理" },
  { key: "02", name: "网站交互验收", department: "研发部", status: "进行中" },
  { key: "03", name: "品牌物料审核", department: "设计部", status: "待处理" },
  { key: "04", name: "移动端体验走查", department: "研发部", status: "已完成" },
  { key: "05", name: "会议室设备维护", department: "运营部", status: "进行中" },
];
const rows = ref(original());
const keyword = ref("");
const status = ref("全部");
const applied = ref({ keyword: "", status: "全部" });
const message = ref("显示全部任务。输入条件后点击查询。");
const options = ["全部", "待处理", "进行中", "已完成"].map((value) => ({
  value,
  label: value,
}));
const filtered = computed(() =>
  rows.value.filter(
    (row) =>
      (!applied.value.keyword ||
        `${row.name} ${row.department}`.includes(applied.value.keyword)) &&
      (applied.value.status === "全部" || row.status === applied.value.status),
  ),
);
const completed = computed(
  () => rows.value.filter((row) => row.status === "已完成").length,
);
const columns = [
  { title: "任务", dataIndex: "name" },
  { title: "部门", dataIndex: "department" },
  { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status" },
  { title: "操作", slotName: "action" },
];
function search() {
  applied.value = { keyword: keyword.value.trim(), status: status.value };
  message.value = `查询完成，找到 ${filtered.value.length} 条任务。`;
}
function clear() {
  keyword.value = "";
  status.value = "全部";
  applied.value = { keyword: "", status: "全部" };
  message.value = "已清空筛选条件。";
}
function finish(row) {
  row.status = "已完成";
  message.value = `已完成“${row.name}”，统计与列表已同步。`;
}
function reset() {
  rows.value = original();
  clear();
  message.value = "任务和筛选已恢复，可以重新演示。";
}
</script>
<template>
  <section class="task-workbench" aria-label="巡检任务数据联动">
    <div class="task-workbench__metrics">
      <span
        >全部 <strong>{{ rows.length }}</strong></span
      ><span
        >已完成 <strong>{{ completed }}</strong></span
      ><span
        >当前结果 <strong>{{ filtered.length }}</strong></span
      >
    </div>
    <c-form :model="applied" layout="vertical" @submit="search">
      <c-form-item label="搜索任务或部门"
        ><c-input
          v-model="keyword"
          edit-mode="direct"
          placeholder="搜索任务或部门"
          clearable
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="任务状态"
        ><c-select v-model="status" :options="options" edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button html-type="submit" status="primary">查询任务</c-button
        ><c-button @click="clear">清空筛选</c-button
        ><c-button @click="reset">恢复全部任务</c-button></c-space
      >
    </c-form>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
    <c-table :columns="columns" :data="filtered" :pagination="false"
      ><template #action="{ record }"
        ><c-button
          :disabled="record.status === '已完成'"
          :aria-label="`完成${record.name}`"
          @click="finish(record)"
          >完成</c-button
        ></template
      ></c-table
    >
    <p v-if="!filtered.length">
      没有匹配任务。修改关键词或点击“清空筛选”恢复结果。
    </p>
    <small
      >先查询“运营部”，完成一条任务，再用状态过滤；统计与结果来自同一份本地任务数据。</small
    >
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.task-workbench {
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.task-workbench__metrics {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.task-workbench__metrics > span {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--c-color-fill-1);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.task-workbench__metrics strong {
  margin-left: 8px;
  color: var(--c-color-primary);
}
.task-workbench small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
  color: var(--c-color-text-2);
}
</style>
```

## Loading and waiting

### Manual loading

Boolean/object loading applies to both data and native-slot modes. Object options require `loading: true`. Rows and drafts remain mounted; notifications do not manage loading.

With the default slot, Table renders the supplied native table content and `footer`; it does not generate headers, rows, or built-in pagination from `data` / `columns`. Data-mode features such as sorting, filtering, and selection do not manage that native content. Use data mode when those features are needed.

Example source: src/table/__demos__/loading.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <c-space
      ><c-switch v-model="loading" edit-mode="direct" /><span
        >手动控制两种表格的加载状态</span
      ></c-space
    >
    <c-table
      :columns="columns"
      :data="data"
      :loading="loading"
      :pagination="false"
    />
    <c-table :loading="loading" :pagination="false">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>原生插槽</th>
          <th>保留编辑内容</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>切换加载不会重建行</td>
          <td><c-input v-model="draft" edit-mode="direct" aria-label="表格草稿" /></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </c-table>
    <small>loading 仅由业务状态控制。输入草稿后切换加载，内容继续保留。</small>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const loading = ref(false);
const draft = ref("可编辑草稿");
const columns = [{ title: "数据模式", dataIndex: "name" }];
const data = [{ key: "row", name: "与原生插槽使用相同的 loading 合同" }];
</script>
```

### Table Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| ------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------ |
| selectAll | Set select-all state | checked: `boolean` | - |
| select | Set row-selection state | rowKey: `string \| number \| (string \| number)[]`<br>checked: `boolean` | - |
| expandAll | Set all rows’ expansion state | checked: `boolean` | - |
| expand | Set expansion state | rowKey: `string \| number \| (string \| number)[]`<br>checked: `boolean` | - |
| resetFilters | Reset column filters | dataIndex: `string \| string[]` | - |
| clearFilters | Clear column filters | dataIndex: `string \| string[]` | - |
| resetSorters | Reset column sorting | - | - |
| clearSorters | Clear column sorting | - | - |

When columns are specified, `clearFilters` and `resetFilters` preserve other columns' filter state. Omitting the argument or passing an empty array applies to all filterable columns. The parent continues to own controlled filter values.

In radio mode, `select(keys, true)` selects only the first supplied key; an empty array does nothing. `select(keys, false)` removes the specified keys. `selectAll(true)` does nothing; `selectAll(false)` removes the keys of enabled rows on the current page. For controlled selection, the parent must receive and update `selectedKeys`.

The state argument of `select`, `selectAll`, `expand`, and `expandAll` defaults to `true`. `expand` accepts one or more keys and does not add duplicates when called repeatedly; `expandAll` applies to all data rows. `resetSorters` restores column defaults and `clearSorters` clears sorting; the parent continues to own controlled sorting.

### Table structure components

`Thead` and `Tbody` render the header and body, respectively, with content from the default slot; their named slots customize the corresponding elements. `Tr`, `Th`, and `Td` are low-level renderers that depend on Table context, not standalone data tables. Usually, customize elements through the Table `tr`, `th`, and `td` slots.

Title and cell named slots, column `title`, `cell`, `filter-icon` and `filter-content`, `empty`, `footer`, `expand-row`, `expand-icon`, pagination slots, `summary-cell`, `drag-handle-icon`, extra-column header/cell slots, and `header-cell-actions` support `v-for` with `v-memo` in their content.

During server-side rendering, combining `v-for` and `v-memo` inside custom `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, or `td` structural slots currently causes a rendering error, even when the array is empty. In the tested Vue versions from 3.2.47 through 3.5.45, directly invoking a compiled slot and rendering it with `h()` also reproduces the error; a minimal template `<slot>` forwarding case works. For SSR, temporarily remove `v-memo` from these structural slots.

`TableColumn` entries declared in `#columns`, including grouped and dynamic columns, render their headers and data cells on the server. Columns can also be defined with the `columns` prop.

For `Tr`, `expand`, `empty`, and `checked` describe row state; `rowIndex` and `record` provide row context. `Th` accepts `column`, `operations`, `dataColumns`, and `resizable`. `Td` accepts `rowIndex`, `record`, `column`, `type`, `operations`, `dataColumns`, `colSpan`, `rowSpan`, `isFixedExpand`, `containerWidth`, `showExpandBtn`, `indentSize`, `renderExpandBtn`, and `summary`; these fields support Table layout and rendering.

### TableComponents

`components.operations` receives the current `dragHandle`, `expand`, and `selection` operation columns (undefined when disabled) and returns the operation columns to render. It configures operation columns rather than replacing arbitrary table elements.

### TableOperationColumn Props

| Field | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | Operation column identifier | `string` |
| title | Column title | `string \| RenderFunction` |
| width | Column width | `number` |
| fixed | Whether fixed | `boolean` |
| render | Custom operation cell content | `(record: TableData) => VNodeChild` |

`isLastLeftFixed` and `_realWidth` are used for table layout and normally need not be set by application code. Import `TableComponents` and `TableOperationColumn` from the root or table entry.

### Pagination configuration type

`TablePaginationConfig = Omit<PaginationProps, 'total'> & { total?: number }`. When `pagination.total` is omitted, Table derives it from the effective data count. Remote pagination can still provide `total` explicitly. Existing `PaginationProps` objects remain accepted by Table; standalone `Pagination` still requires `total`. `TablePaginationConfig` is exported from root/table entries.

### Forwarded configuration precedence

Nested fields such as open in column filterable.triggerProps can override the filter popup state. Manage both popup visibility and filter conditions when controlling it from the application.

### TableSortable

A custom `sorter(a, b, { direction })` must return ascending or descending results according to `direction`; Table does not reverse the result again. `sorter: true` disables internal sorting. Without a function, the built-in comparison preserves the original order of equal values.

| sortOrder | Sort direction | `'ascend' \| 'descend' \| ''` | `-` |
| defaultSortOrder | Default sort direction in uncontrolled mode | `'ascend' \| 'descend' \| ''` | `-` |

## Optional business-row type configuration

```ts
import { defineTableConfig } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
import type { TypedTableConfig, TypedTableColumn, TableDataPath } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue/table'

interface User { id: string; name: string; age: number }
const users: User[] = [{ id: 'a', name: 'Alice', age: 20 }]
const config = defineTableConfig<User>({
  rowKey: 'id', data: users,
  columns: [{ dataIndex: 'age', render: ({ record }) => record.age.toFixed(0) }],
})
```

Use the config with `<c-table v-bind="config" />` or TSX `<Table {...config} />`. Business-side as any is unnecessary. Existing TableData, TableColumnData, TableProps and component props remain. The new entry validates inputs and returns existing TableProps for old components. Runtime returns the same object without copying rows/columns, changing sorting/filtering or wrapping components.

| Associated scope | New type rules |
| --- | --- |
| data / columns | The same Row type recursively applies to tree children |
| dataIndex | Validates fields/nested paths such as profile.city, tags[0].label and tags.0.label, up to five business-structure levels. Dynamic strings/deeper paths retain the old entry |
| render / sortable / filterable | record, comparators and filters receive Row, including grouped child columns |
| Row callbacks | Cell styles/classes, rowClass, expandable, loadMore, spanMethod and custom summaries associate with Row |
| rowKey | Explicitly provide a Row field whose value is string/number; this is a field name, not a nested path |
| summary | May be omitted, false or a custom function returning complete Row. Automatic summary=true is not guaranteed to be a business row, so the new entry rejects it; existing Table configuration still supports it |

Business interfaces normally need not extend TableData explicitly; its any index broadens keyof and weakens spelling checks. Use ordinary business interfaces and generic constraints to validate reserved Table metadata compatibility. Business code still validates backend contents; types do not ensure unique IDs.

Type association covers only this configuration. Component template slots/events and custom components extensions do not automatically become Row-generic. Returned TableProps remains the old broad type; arbitrary later mutations are not Row-validated. If reactive sources replace arrays, use `computed(() => defineTableConfig<Row>(...))`; passing rows.value once is not an ongoing ref subscription.

Automatic summary rows may contain text, totals and missing fields; render(record: User) must not assume a complete User. Keep the old broad configuration for automatic summaries or heterogeneous tree rows. The new custom-summary entry requires a complete business row. Neither entry changes Table runtime behavior.

Maple Table is a native-table presentation container without data / columns configuration.

## Reading direction and scrolling

Table inherits the nearest native `dir`. An explicitly supplied `dir` applies during the initial server render. Changing direction preserves the nodes and input state of cells that remain present. Ordinary columns follow reading order; explicit `fixed: left/right` stays physical. Internal stable partitioning into frozen regions does not mutate supplied columns, data or business indices. Group headers crossing frozen regions split into aligned segments. Omitted align uses inline start; explicit left/right remains physical.

Header, body, summary and sticky scrollbar synchronize using a nonnegative distance from inline start, adapting native negative RTL scrollLeft. Direction changes preserve that distance and clamp it to the new viewport range. Vertical virtual-row positioning does not change horizontal distance. Teleported pagination and sticky areas inherit the source table direction.

Column handles support direction-aware mouse/touch dragging and Left/Right keyboard resizing in 10px steps, or 50px with Shift. Home reaches the 40px minimum. The existing fixed-layout requirement remains. The sticky scrollbar supports Left/Right and Home/End; measurements are batched by frame and cleaned up on deactivation/unmount. Direction changes do not modify selection, sorting, filters or pagination or emit width events.

Lazy child caches belong to the source node object and row key; reusing a key does not transfer an old node's cache. Replacing nodes, row keys or loaders invalidates old tasks/caches. Deactivation/unmount invalidates pending cell callbacks. done() ends waiting without children and allows retry; done([]) accepts an empty result. Only the first completion per task is accepted. Synchronous loader errors release waiting and still reach Vue's error channel. load-more keeps its done callback contract; notification return Promises are not task inputs.

If a callback loader returns a Promise, rejection releases waiting and reaches Vue's error channel. Fulfillment values are ignored and cannot replace done. This handles errors from an explicit loader prop; it does not collect Promises returned by notifications such as expand.

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-table-body-cell-text-color: rgb(var(--c-gray-10));
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

# Tabs

## Appearance and states

### Appearance Lab

Preview configuration: `layout="vertical"`, `:clearable="false"`, `options`, `aria-label="variant"`.

Example source: src/tabs/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("comparison");
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "line", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from "vue";
const demoCompareFields = [
  {
    name: "variant",
    values: ["line", "card", "outline", "plain", "capsule", "enclosed"],
  },
  { name: "size", values: ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] },
];
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant");
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () =>
    demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)
      ?.values ?? [],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-select
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          :clearable="false"
          :options="[
            { label: 'line', value: 'line' },
            { label: 'card', value: 'card' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'plain', value: 'plain' },
            { label: 'capsule', value: 'capsule' },
            { label: 'enclosed', value: 'enclosed' },
          ]"
          aria-label="variant"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">{{ demoCopy.hint }}</p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      :aria-label="demoCopy.configuration"
      :options="
        demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({
          label: field.name,
          value: field.name,
        }))
      "
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <c-tabs
          default-value="overview"
          v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
        >
          <c-tab-pane name="overview" title="概览">概览内容</c-tab-pane>
          <c-tab-pane name="details" title="详情">详情内容</c-tab-pane>
          <c-tab-pane name="settings" title="设置">设置内容</c-tab-pane>
        </c-tabs>
      </section>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
```

## Appearance and direction

### Type

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical axis of tab navigation, default horizontal; affects navigation layout and arrow-key behavior | Type, Position |
| `item-style` | `StyleValue` | No Padding, Custom Style |
| `default-value` | `string / number` | No Padding, Custom Style |
| `variant` | `line / card / outline / plain / capsule / enclosed` | Type |
| `size` | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl` | Type |
| `editable` | `boolean` | Type |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `variant`: Selects the visual variant.
- `size`: Controls the component size.

Example source: src/tabs/__demos__/type.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-radio-group v-model="isVertical" type="button">
      <c-radio value="horizontal">Horizontal</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="vertical">Vertical</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-radio-group v-model="variant" type="button">
      <c-radio value="line">Line</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="card">Card</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="outline">Outline</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="plain">Plain</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="capsule">Capsule</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="enclosed">Enclosed</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-radio-group v-model="size" type="button">
      <c-radio value="xs">Xs</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="sm">Sm</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="md">Md</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="lg">Lg</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="xl">Xl</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
  </c-space>
  <c-tabs
    :variant="variant"
    :size="size"
    :orientation="isVertical"
    :editable="true"
    @add="handleAdd"
    @delete="handleDelete"
    show-add-button
    auto-switch
    :style="isVertical !== 'vertical' ? { height: '240px' } : undefined"
  >
    <c-tabs-navs>
      <c-tab-nav v-for="(item, index) of data" :key="item.key" :name="item.key" :title="item.title" :closable="index !== 2" />
      <template #prefix><c-button size="xs">Action</c-button></template>
      <template #suffix>suffix</template>
    </c-tabs-navs>
    <c-tabs-items>
      <c-tab-item v-for="(item, index) of data" :key="item.key" :name="item.key">{{ item?.content }}</c-tab-item>
    </c-tabs-items>
  </c-tabs>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const variant = ref('line')
const size = ref('md')
const isVertical = ref('horizontal')
const data = ref([
  {
    key: '1',
    title: 'Tab 1',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 1',
  },
  {
    key: '2',
    title: 'Tab 2',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 2',
  },
  {
    key: '3',
    title: 'Tab 3',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 3',
  },
  {
    key: '4',
    title: 'Tab 4',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 4',
  },
])
let count = 5
const handleAdd = () => {
  const number = count++
  data.value = data.value.concat({
    key: `${number}`,
    title: `New Tab ${number}`,
    content: `Content of New Tab Panel ${number}`,
  })
}
const handleDelete = (key) => {
  data.value = data.value.filter((item) => item.key !== key)
}
</script>
```

### Position

Preview configuration: `type="button"`, `value="normal"`, `value="reverse"`, `value="horizontal"`.

Example source: src/tabs/__demos__/position.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-radio-group v-model="indicatorPosition" type="button">
      <c-radio value="normal">Normal (bottom/right)</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="reverse">Reverse (top/left)</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-radio-group v-model="vertical" type="button">
      <c-radio value="horizontal">Horizontal</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="vertical">Vertical</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-radio-group v-model="componentOrder" type="button">
      <c-radio value="nav-first">TabsNavs → TabsItems</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="items-first">TabsItems → TabsNavs</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-tabs :indicator-position="indicatorPosition" :orientation="vertical">
      <template v-if="componentOrder === 'items-first'">
        <c-tabs-items>
          <c-tab-item name="1">Content of Tab Panel 1</c-tab-item>
          <c-tab-item name="2">Content of Tab Panel 2</c-tab-item>
```

### Editable

- `variant`: Selects the visual variant.

Example source: src/tabs/__demos__/editable.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-tabs variant="card" :editable="true" @add="handleAdd" @delete="handleDelete" show-add-button auto-switch>
    <c-tabs-navs>
      <template #suffix>
        <c-button>Action</c-button>
      </template>
      <c-tab-nav v-for="(item, index) of data" :key="item.key" :name="item.key" :title="item.title" :closable="index !== 2" />
    </c-tabs-navs>
    <c-tabs-items>
      <c-tab-item v-for="(item, index) of data" :key="item.key" :name="item.key">{{ item?.content }}</c-tab-item>
    </c-tabs-items>
  </c-tabs>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
let count = 5

const data = ref([
  {
    key: '1',
    title: 'Tab 1',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 1',
  },
  {
    key: '2',
    title: 'Tab 2',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 2',
  },
  {
    key: '3',
    title: 'Tab 3',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 3',
  },
  {
    key: '4',
    title: 'Tab 4',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 4',
  },
])

const handleAdd = () => {
  const number = count++
  data.value = data.value.concat({
    key: `${number}`,
    title: `New Tab ${number}`,
    content: `Content of New Tab Panel ${number}`,
  })
}
const handleDelete = (key: string | number) => {
  data.value = data.value.filter((item) => item.key !== key)
}
</script>
```

## API

TabPane, TabNav and TabItem all require unique names. Selection and navigation/panel association use `name`; Vue key controls only node reuse. Provide `:key` separately in loops.

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected tab name. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets or initialization `update:modelValue`. When provided, the parent value controls selection.

### Tabs Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value | `string / number` | `undefined` | Current selected name; controlled when provided |
| default-value | `string / number` | `undefined` | Initial uncontrolled value; defaults to the first available item |
| variant | `line / card / outline / plain / capsule / enclosed` | `line` | Visual variant |
| size | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl` | Global value or md | Size |
| tab-list-aria-label | `string` | `undefined` | Accessible name for the tab list; explicit aria-label or aria-labelledby on TabsNavs takes precedence |
| orientation | `Orientation`<br>`'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `horizontal` | Navigation orientation |
| indicator-position | `TabsIndicatorPosition`<br>`'normal' \| 'reverse'` | `normal` | Indicator on the content side or opposite side |
| editable | `boolean` | `false` | Allow closing tabs |
| show-add-button | `boolean` | `false` | Show the add button in editable mode |
| auto-switch | `boolean` | `false` | Switch to the last available tab after adding |
| lazy-load | `boolean` | `false` | Mount on first activation |
| destroy-on-hide | `boolean` | `false` | Unmount content when hidden |
| justify | `boolean` | `false` | Fill container height in horizontal orientation |
| animation | `boolean` | `false` | Content fade-in animation |
| item-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Inner class for each panel; merged with built-in classes |
| item-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Inner style for each panel; supports string, object or array |
| item-wrapper-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Outer class for each panel; merged with built-in classes |
| item-wrapper-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Outer style for each panel; supports string, object or array |
| tab-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Outer navigation-label class, including title/close button; merged with built-in classes |
| tab-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Outer navigation-label style; supports string, object or array |
| hide-content | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the content area |
| trigger | `click / hover` | `click` | Mouse trigger mode; touch always uses click |
| scroll-position | `TabsScrollPosition`<br>`'start' \| 'end' \| 'center' \| 'auto' \| number` | `auto` | Selected-tab scroll position; numbers are start offsets |
| scroll-buttons | `boolean / auto` | `auto` | Show arrows on overflow; auto hides them on touch devices |
| activation-mode | `automatic / manual` | `automatic` | Whether arrow keys immediately select |
| swipeable | `boolean` | `false` | Horizontal swipe between content panels; no looping |

### Tabs Events

| Event | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | name: string / number | Request a selected-value update |
| change | name: string / number | Notify on selecting a different available item; controlled mode still requires parent modelValue updates |
| tab-click | name, event: Event | Click an available item, including repeat clicks; hover/arrows/swipes do not emit click |
| add | event: Event | Request adding a tab; the caller updates data |
| delete | name, event: Event | Request removing a tab; the caller updates data |

### TabPane Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| title | string | undefined | Navigation title |
| disabled | boolean | false | Prevent selecting and closing |
| closable | boolean | true | Show the close button in editable mode |
| item-vertical | boolean | false | Vertical icon/text layout |
| lazy-load | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |
| destroy-on-hide | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |

### TabNav Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| title | string | undefined | Title |
| disabled | boolean | false | Prevent selecting and closing |
| closable | boolean | true | Show the close button in editable mode |
| item-vertical | boolean | false | Vertical icon/text layout |

TabNav/TabItem associate through the same `name`. Names are unique within a group; number `1` and string `'1'` differ. Vue `key` controls node reuse only; provide `:key` in loops independently. It does not determine selection.

### TabItem Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| lazy-load | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |
| destroy-on-hide | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |

Inactive panels always have hidden. The above props determine whether internal state survives. destroy-on-hide overrides lazy-load; active content remains mounted. TabsNavs/TabsItems have no business props.

### TabItem Slots

| Component | Slot | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tabs | default | TabPane list, or TabsNavs/TabsItems for advanced composition |
| TabPane | default / title | Panel content / custom navigation title |
| TabsNavs | default | TabNav list |
| TabsNavs | prefix / suffix / add-icon | Navigation prefix/suffix areas and add icon |
| TabNav | title / default / icon | title/default slots customize the title; icon supplies an icon |
| TabsItems | default | TabItem list |
| TabItem | default | Panel content |

### TabItem Methods

`TabsNavs.resize(): void` remeasures overflow and scrolls the selected tab into view. ResizeObserver watches size changes automatically.

### Keyboard and direction

Arrow keys skip disabled items and wrap; Home/End reach first/last. Delete requests closing editable tabs. Horizontal uses Left/Right, vertical uses Up/Down. Manual mode moves focus only; Enter/Space activates the native button. `dir="rtl"` supports right-to-left layout. Give TabsNavs an `aria-label` to name navigation.

After a close request, if the focused tab is removed, focus moves to an adjacent enabled tab unless the user has already moved focus elsewhere. When changing panels, focus moves to the new tab only if it was inside the panel being hidden. Horizontal start, end and numeric scroll offsets follow reading direction; the start is on the right in RTL.

In TabPane mode, use tab-list-aria-label to name the tab list. In advanced mode, TabsNavs accepts aria-label or aria-labelledby directly. When using navigation without TabItem, the application is responsible for associating and making external panels accessible.

## Types

Exports TabsName, TabsVariant, TabsTrigger, TabsIndicatorPosition, TabsScrollPosition, TabsActivationMode and Props/Instance/runtime props/`_XxxComponent` for all six components. Both platforms use the same prop definitions.

## Usage notes

Supports xs / sm / md / lg / xl sizes. Cedar inherits ConfigProvider size / rtl. Maple defaults to md and supports setPropsDefaults, explicit size and DOM dir. Inactive panels are hidden, and InfiniteScroll follows panel visibility.

Public types include TabsEmits, TabsSlots, TabPaneSlots, TabsNavsSlots, TabNavSlots, TabsItemsSlots, TabItemSlots and TabsNavsExpose. Only TabsNavs has its own method, resize(). Other members have no own imperative methods/notification events; selection/editing events belong to Tabs.
### Configuration

Matching token suffixes have matching meanings on both platforms, with platform-specific defaults. The variables and their defaults are listed below.

Both platforms keep the same API, state, lifecycle and keyboard behavior. Desktop and mobile differences use style tokens and pointer media queries; the packages remain independent at runtime.

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-tabs-background: var(--c-sys-color-surface-default);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose an axis to compare its available values with the same content and model. Other settings remain unchanged while comparing.

Example source: src/tag/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const demoCopy = useDemoLocale("comparison");
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({
  variant: "default",
  status: "default",
  size: "md",
});

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from "vue";
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: "variant", values: ["default", "outline"] },
  {
    name: "status",
    values: [
      "default",
      "primary",
      "secondary",
      "tertiary",
      "info",
      "success",
      "warning",
      "danger",
    ],
  },
  { name: "size", values: ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] },
];
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant");
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () =>
    demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)
      ?.values ?? [],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="status">
        <c-select
          v-model="__demoAppearance['status']"
          :clearable="false"
          :options="[
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
            { label: 'primary', value: 'primary' },
            { label: 'secondary', value: 'secondary' },
            { label: 'tertiary', value: 'tertiary' },
            { label: 'info', value: 'info' },
            { label: 'success', value: 'success' },
            { label: 'warning', value: 'warning' },
            { label: 'danger', value: 'danger' },
          ]"
          aria-label="status"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">{{ demoCopy.hint }}</p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      :aria-label="demoCopy.configuration"
      :options="
        demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({
          label: field.name,
          value: field.name,
        }))
      "
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <c-tag v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
          >gray</c-tag
        >
      </section>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
```

### Dynamic Tag

Preview configuration: `:closable="index !== 0"`, `size="xs"`.

Example source: src/tag/__demos__/dynamic-tag.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space wrap>
    <c-tag v-for="(tag, index) of tags" :key="tag" :closable="index !== 0" @close="handleRemove(tag)">
      {{ tag }}
    </c-tag>

    <c-input
      v-if="showInput"
      ref="inputRef"
      :style="{ width: '90px' }"
      size="xs"
      v-model.trim="inputVal"
      @keyup.enter="handleAdd"
      @blur="handleAdd" />
    <c-tag
      v-else
      :style="{
        width: '90px',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--color-fill-2)',
        border: '1px dashed var(--color-fill-3)',
        cursor: 'pointer',
      }"
      @click="handleEdit"
    >
      <template #icon>
        <c-icon-plus />
      </template>
      Add Tag
    </c-tag>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, nextTick } from 'vue'
const tags = ref(['Tag 1', 'Tag 2', 'Tag 3'])
const inputRef = ref(null)
const showInput = ref(false)
const inputVal = ref('')

const handleEdit = () => {
  showInput.value = true

  nextTick(() => {
    if (inputRef.value) {
      inputRef.value.focus()
    }
  })
}

const handleAdd = () => {
  if (inputVal.value) {
    tags.value.push(inputVal.value)
    inputVal.value = ''
  }
  showInput.value = false
}

const handleRemove = (key) => {
  tags.value = tags.value.filter((tag) => tag !== key)
}
</script>
```

## API


Loading preserves the checked state and exposes disabled and busy semantics on checkable tags. If loading starts while the close control has focus, focus moves to the tag. Independent interactive controls in the content do not toggle the tag.

The close button name defaults to the current locale’s close text and can be overridden with `close-button-aria-label`. The tag root remains single-line; `nowrap` mainly enables the inner truncation wrapper and does not control multiline wrapping.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is a selectable tag's boolean checked state. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

### Tag Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| color | Custom background (border color when outline) | `string` | - |
| text-color | Custom text color | `string` | - |
| status | Tag status `color`; mutually exclusive with `color`, which takes precedence | `'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'default'` |
| variant | Tag variant, aligned with Button | `'default' \| 'outline'` | `'default'` |
| size | Tag size | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| show **(v-model)** | Whether the tag is visible | `boolean` | - |
| default-show | Default tag visibility | `boolean` | `true` |
| loading | Whether the tag is loading | `boolean` | `false` |
| closable | Whether the tag can be closed | `boolean` | `false` |
| `close-button-aria-label` | Accessible name of the close button; defaults to the current locale | `string` | `—` |
| checkable | Whether the tag is selectable | `boolean` | `false` |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Whether a selectable tag is checked | `boolean` | - |
| default-value | Default checked state of a selectable tag | `boolean` | `true` |
| nowrap | Whether to enable the content truncation wrapper; the root remains single-line | `boolean` | `false` |
| round | Whether to use a pill shape | `boolean` | `false` |

### Tag Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------ | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| close | Triggered when the Close button is clicked and can only be used when the Close button is displayed | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| check | Emitted on user selection, only in selectable mode | `(check: boolean, event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| update:show | Visibility changed | `(show: boolean) => void` |
| update:model-value | Checked-state change | `(checked: boolean) => void` |

### Tag Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ---------- | -------------- | ---- |
| default | Tag content | - |
| icon | Icon | - |
| close-icon | Close-button icon | - |

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { TagProps, TagSlots, TagEmits } from '@cedar-design/ui-vue'
```

## Usage notes



The application updates controlled show / checked values. Hiding retains the fade-out effect; class / style apply to the actual tag. CSS variables customize mobile touch sizing.

### Color override boundaries

Preset outline stays transparent; loading does not trigger preset fill hover. Dark backgrounds consume bg/bg-hover with instance overrides. Preset icon-color is separate from text-color. Unchecked presets remain neutral, while an explicit color still applies. Preset/custom colors do not guarantee contrast on arbitrary backgrounds.

## CSS Variables

Status text and outline borders use the corresponding theme semantic colors with light colored fills. Unselected tags remain neutral; selected status colors take precedence over hover. The neutral background switches between fill-2 and fill-3. color takes precedence over status. Keep text readable on custom backgrounds and set text-color when needed.

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --c-tag-blue-border-color: transparent;
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

### Motion

Built-in motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reduced motion does not prevent loading-state or close-event updates.

<!-- Source: src/textarea/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/textarea/ -->

# Textarea

Multiline text input.

## Reading direction

The textarea inherits source `dir`, aligns text to inline start and its counter to inline end. Runtime direction changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; native caret and newline keys keep their meanings.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

`v-model.trim` follows Vue model event rules: `update:modelValue` is trimmed during input, while `input` reports the original text after length normalization. An uncontrolled editor may retain surrounding whitespace while editing and normalizes its local display on commit; committing does not repeat the same model proposal already reported. Controlled display follows the final parent value, and `change` still denotes a commit.

Example source: src/textarea/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref('')
const trimmed = ref('')
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-textarea v-model="value" clearable placeholder="请输入多行文本" aria-label="受控文本" />
    <p role="status">当前值：{{ value || '（空）' }}</p>
    <c-textarea default-value="这是一段非受控初始文本" aria-label="非受控文本" />
    <c-textarea v-model.trim="trimmed" placeholder="输入首尾空白，观察模型值" aria-label="去除首尾空白" />
    <p role="status">去除空白后的值：{{ JSON.stringify(trimmed) }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Content and presentation

### Max Length

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder text | Max Length |
| `max-length` | Finite nonnegative length or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; 0 is unlimited; invalid values diagnose and fall back to no limit | Max Length |
| `clearable` | Enables the clear action | Max Length |
| `show-word-limit` | Show the character counter | Max Length |
| `aria-label` | Accessible name when no visible label exists | Native Attrs |
| `rows` | Native visible row count | Native Attrs |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/textarea/__demos__/max-length.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg" fill>
    <p>长度按 UTF-16 码元计算；试着输入 123456789😀Z，默认截断保留 123456789，不拆开 emoji。</p>
    <c-textarea
      v-model="limited"
      placeholder="超过 10 个字符会截断"
      :max-length="10"
      clearable
      show-word-limit
    />
    <c-textarea
      v-model="errorOnly"
      placeholder="超过 10 个字符后保留内容并显示错误"
      :max-length="{ length: 10, errorOnly: true }"
      clearable
      show-word-limit
    />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const limited = ref("");
const errorOnly = ref("超过长度的内容会保留");
</script>
```

`max-length` accepts a finite nonnegative number or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; `0` means unlimited. Object `length` follows the same numeric constraint and `errorOnly` is an optional boolean. Invalid values use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and fall back to no limit; null is treated as unset. Default slicing counts UTF-16 code units. Supply `word-length / word-slice` together for custom counting and slicing.

### Auto Size

Auto sizing converts the measured box to the actual CSS box model, counting padding and the top/bottom borders once. Explicit `minRows / maxRows` override the theme minimum; excess content scrolls within the row cap. Turning auto size off restores native height and the platform resize default. Compare both box models, fill six lines, and switch the cap.

Example source: src/textarea/__demos__/auto-size.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("textareaAutoSizeInline");

import { ref } from "vue";

const content = ref(inlineCopy.value.firstLine);
const boundedContent = ref("第一行 / First line\n第二行 / Second line");
const maxRows = ref(5);
function fill() {
  boundedContent.value = "one\ntwo\nthree\nfour\nfive\nsix";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg" fill>
    <c-textarea
      :default-value="inlineCopy.nativeThreeRows"
      :rows="3"
      aria-label="Native rows"
    />
    <c-textarea
      v-model="content"
      auto-size
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.growWithContent"
    />
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="fill">{{ inlineCopy.fillSixLines }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="maxRows = maxRows === 5 ? 2 : 5"
        >{{ inlineCopy.toggleRowLimit }} {{ maxRows }}</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <template v-for="box in ['border-box', 'content-box']" :key="box">
      <p>{{ box }} · 2–{{ maxRows }} rows</p>
      <c-textarea
        v-model="boundedContent"
        :auto-size="{ minRows: 2, maxRows }"
        :textarea-attrs="{
          'aria-label': 'Bounded ' + box,
          style: {
            boxSizing: box,
            lineHeight: '20px',
            padding: '4px',
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderWidth: '1px 2px 3px 4px',
          },
        }"
      />
    </template>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Value model and interaction

### Dynamic empty values

Changing empty-value (including its factory) affects the next clear operation. Changing empty-values reformats the existing model without emitting a model update. Direct clear publishes immediately; deferred clear remains a draft until confirmation.

Example source: src/textarea/__demos__/empty-policy.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useDemoLocale as useInlineDemoLocale } from "../../__demos__/locale";
const inlineCopy = useInlineDemoLocale("textareaEmptyPolicyInline");

import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const sentinel = ref(false);
const emptyValue = computed(() => (sentinel.value ? "CLEARED" : null));
const emptyValues = [undefined, null, "", "CLEARED"];
const direct = ref("Direct draft");
const deferred = ref("Deferred draft");
function reset() {
  direct.value = "Direct draft";
  deferred.value = "Deferred draft";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-space>
      <c-button @click="sentinel = !sentinel">{{
        inlineCopy.toggleEmptyValue
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">{{ inlineCopy.resetValues }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">empty-value: {{ JSON.stringify(emptyValue) }}</p>
    <c-textarea
      v-model="direct"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :empty-value="emptyValue"
      :empty-values="emptyValues"
      clearable
      aria-label="Direct text"
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.direct"
    />
    <c-textarea
      v-model="deferred"
      edit-mode="click"
      :empty-value="emptyValue"
      :empty-values="emptyValues"
      clearable
      aria-label="Deferred text"
      :placeholder="inlineCopy.deferred"
    />
    <p>{{ inlineCopy.changeThePolicyBeforeClearing }}</p>
    <pre class="empty-policy-model">{{
      JSON.stringify({ direct, deferred })
    }}</pre>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Design notes

- Defaults to `outline` with `clearable` disabled.
- `input` means live editing; `change` commits on changed blur or clear. Enter remains a newline.
- `auto-size` lets content determine height, overriding visual effects of `rows`/manual `resize`.
- Form/FormItem own business validation/messages; Textarea supplies event signals/error appearance only.

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom `line`); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Composition input

IME composition preserves the native text being entered; external model updates do not replace it before composition completes. Existing formatting and controlled-owner acceptance apply after completion. Queued restoration from an earlier input cannot replace the text or caret of a later edit or composition. Length limits and modifiers retain their existing post-composition input/commit timing.

## Usage notes

### Sizing and native methods

size supports five FieldDecorator densities: xs/sm/md/lg/xl. rows, auto-size and Textarea tokens still control textarea height/text metrics. Cedar allows manual resize by default; Maple does not. InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit child values taking precedence. Exposes focus(options?), blur(), select() and textareaRef.

`TextareaProps`、`TextareaVariant`、`TextareaMaxLength`、`TextareaAutoSize`、`TextareaEmits`、`TextareaSlots`、`TextareaExpose`、`TextareaInstance`。

Native methods: `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`, `blur()`, `select()`; `textareaRef` is the native element.

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps editing open on failure; before-commit approval runs after validation succeeds. See the property section above for approval parameters and completion rules.

`open / default-open / update:open / open-change` control and report editor visibility; `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes reading content. See Form for composed examples.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-textarea-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

### Configuration

Both counters sit outside the textarea. counter-margin-top controls their gap and avoids covering text.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Textarea Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| empty-value | Clear output; omission clears to an empty string and manual deletion is unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `undefined` |
| model-value | Bound value | `string \| null` | `-` |
| model-modifiers | `v-model` modifiers; supports `trim` | `{ trim?: boolean }` | `{}` |
| default-value | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent | `string` | `''` |
| placeholder | Hint text | `string` | `-` |
| disabled | Disabled state; can inherit from Form | `boolean` | `-` |
| readonly | Readonly state; can inherit from Form | `boolean` | `-` |
| variant | Field appearance | `'filled' \| 'outline' \| 'standard'` | `'outline'` |
| size | Input size | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| error | Error state; can inherit from FormItem | `boolean` | `-` |
| max-length | Finite nonnegative length or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; 0 is unlimited; invalid values diagnose and fall back to no limit | `number \| { length: number; errorOnly?: boolean }` | `0` |
| show-word-limit | Show the character counter | `boolean` | `false` |
| clearable | Whether to allow the input to be cleared | `boolean` | `false` |
| word-length | Length-counting function | `(value: string) => number` | `-` |
| word-slice | Text-slicing function, used with wordLength | `(value: string, maxLength: number) => string` | `-` |
| aria-label | Native input accessible label | `string` | `-` |
| autofocus | Focus automatically after mount | `boolean` | `false` |
| enterkeyhint | Mobile virtual-keyboard enter-key hint | `string` | `-` |
| hint | Whether hint text floats | `boolean` | Inherits when unset; defaults to `false` when used independently |
| line | Whether to draw a border or underline | `boolean` | `true` |
| text-color | Input text color | `string` | `-` |
| focus-color | Focused hint and supported border colors; does not control the caret | `string` | `-` |
| blur-color | Unfocused hint color | `string` | `-` |
| rows | Positive integer native rows, including numeric strings; invalid values diagnose and restore native default rows. Theme constraints still affect visual height | `string \| number` | Native default `2` |
| resize | Allow vertical resizing; ignored while a valid automatic-height policy is active | `boolean` | `true` |
| auto-size | Automatic height; row budgets must be positive and finite, with minRows no greater than maxRows. Invalid configurations diagnose and disable measurement | `boolean \| { minRows?: number; maxRows?: number }` | `false` |
| textarea-attrs | Additional native textarea attributes; cannot override controlled value, state, rows, length policy, or component events | `Record<string, unknown>` | `undefined` |
| edit-mode | Editor mode; inherits FormItem/Form | `direct / click / dblclick` | `undefined` |
| read-pretty | Reading presentation; inherits FormItem/Form | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition set; an explicit value replaces the inherited set | `readonly unknown[]` | Inherited component-family policy |
| empty-text | Empty reading text; inherits FormItem/Form | `string` | `'-'` |
| before-commit | Deferred save approval: (payload, done, context) | `BeforeFieldCommit` | `undefined` |
| open | Controlled editor visibility in deferred modes | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| default-open | Uncontrolled initial editor visibility; creation-only | `boolean` | `false` |
| popup-container | Deferred editor portal target; false renders in place | `PopupContainer` | `undefined` |
| loading | Loading presentation; keeps the input editable | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading-mode | Loading layout: default indicator or bottom line | `default / line` | `default` |

`rows` accepts a positive integer or a numeric string convertible to one. Invalid values use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and restore native default `rows`. `auto-size` minRows/maxRows accept positive finite line-height multiples, including fractions; minRows must not exceed maxRows. Invalid objects disable automatic measurement and clear its previous calculated styles. Null is treated as unset.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` approves saving. Payload contains `{ value, previousValue }`; context provides `signal`. Synchronous void waits for done; true, done(), or fulfilled `Promise<void>` allows saving. False, done(false), `Promise<false>`, throwing, or rejection cancels. Ordinary events only notify and do not await Promises; the DOM source of `change` may be absent.

### Textarea Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | Model update proposal during input, clearing, or confirmed saving | `value: string \| null` |
| update:open | Editor visibility request | `open: boolean` |
| open-change | Editor visibility change notification | `open: boolean` |
| input | Length-normalized user input, emitted after composition completes | `value: string, event: Event` |
| change | Commit on blur, clear, or deferred saving; the source event is optional | `value: string \| null, event?: Event` |
| keydown | Native keyboard notification; Enter keeps its newline behavior in direct mode | `event: KeyboardEvent` |
| clear | Clear request, followed by input, model update, and change notifications | `event: Event` |
| focus | Native editor receives focus | `event: FocusEvent` |
| blur | Native editor loses focus | `event: FocusEvent` |

| --- | --- | --- |

| suffix | Suffix content | `-` |
| clear-icon | Clear icon or button | `{ clear(event?: Event): void }` |

### Textarea Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | Focus the mounted editor | `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` |
| blur | Blur the mounted editor | `blur(): void` |
| select | Select all text in the mounted editor | `select(): void` |
| textareaRef | Reference to the mounted native textarea | `HTMLTextAreaElement \| undefined` |

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

Native textarea uses `autocomplete="off"`, matching Input and Maple; forwarded native attributes cannot override this policy.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

### Panel Behavior

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref("09:30");
const immediate = ref(false);
const confirmations = ref(0);
const hideDisabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabledHours = () => [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="12px" style="width: 100%">
    <c-checkbox v-model="immediate"> 跳过确认，选择即提交</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="hideDisabled"> 隐藏禁用小时（00–07）</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly"> 只读（包括确认）</c-checkbox>
    <c-button variant="outline" @click="value = '13:45'"
      >外部更新为 13:45，覆盖未提交草稿</c-button
    >
    <c-time-picker
      v-model="value"
      @confirm="confirmations++"
      format="HH:mm"
      :disable-confirm="immediate"
      :hide-disabled-options="hideDisabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :disabled-hours="disabledHours"
    >
      <template #extra
        ><p>附加说明使用 extra 插槽；选择草稿后点击确认提交。</p></template
      >
    </c-time-picker>
    <span>有效确认次数: {{ confirmations }}</span>
    <span>已提交值: {{ value }}</span>
    <p>默认选择只修改草稿，点击确认后上方的已提交值才会更新。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`; direction changes do not modify time or commit drafts. Hour, minute and second columns follow reading order, with Left/Right moving focus visually between columns. Cedar Up/Down and Home/End move focus within the current column, Enter/Space selects, and disabled options are skipped. Maple wheels retain Up/Down and Home/End selection behavior. Existing confirmation configuration determines immediate commits. Popovers inherit source field direction.

## API

The panel owns one draft/confirmation state, reused by its presentation. Examples show the extra slot and valid-confirm count. Confirming the same value again emits confirm without a duplicate change.

### Pure-panel event and slot boundaries

`TimePicker`/`TimeRangePicker` do not manage fields/popups. Pass `open`, `size`, `variant`, clearing and popup configuration to `Time`/`TimeRange`.

- `select(value, date)`: edit the draft.
- `change(value, date)`: valid confirmation with a changed value; updates the model.
- `confirm(value, date)`: every valid confirmation, including unchanged values. `disableConfirm` also emits it on valid selection commits. Disabled, readonly or invalid drafts do not emit it.
- `extra`: additional explanatory content.
- `actions({ confirm, canConfirm, value })`: replace default tools. `value` is the draft; call `confirm()` to commit and disable buttons according to `canConfirm`.

Single-time events carry formatted strings and Date objects; range events carry corresponding arrays. Use field `open-change` and `update:open` to manage the popup, and field `clear` for clearing the value.

### TimePicker Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default-value` | Initial uncontrolled value, read only at creation | `TimeValue \| TimeValue[]` | `undefined` |
| `disable-confirm` | Commit a valid selection immediately; fields also request closing | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disabled` | Disable panel selection and confirmation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disabled-hours` | Return disabled hours in the 0–23 clock | `() => number[]` | `undefined` |
| `disabled-minutes` | Return disabled minutes for the selected hour | `(hour?: number) => number[]` | `undefined` |
| `disabled-seconds` | Return disabled seconds for the selected hour and minute | `(hour?: number, minute?: number) => number[]` | `undefined` |
| `format` | String parsing, display and output format; 12-hour defaults include a | `string` | From use12Hours |
| `hide-disabled-options` | Hide disabled time options; clocks retain tick positions | `boolean` | `false` |
| `max` | Maximum inclusive clock time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss | `string` | `undefined` |
| `min` | Minimum inclusive clock time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss | `string` | `undefined` |
| `model-value` | Panel external value, seeding draft and accepting later changes | `TimeValue \| TimeValue[]` | `undefined` |
| `readonly` | Readonly panel without draft changes or confirmation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `show-next-day` | Ranges only: allow an earlier end time as next day without swapping endpoints | `boolean` | `false` |
| `step` | Hour/minute/second steps from midnight; invalid steps fall back to 1 | `TimeStep` | Effective steps are all 1 |
| `type` | Single/range mode of the desktop general panel | `time \| time-range` | `time` |
| `use12-hours` | 12-hour panel; disabled-hour callbacks still use 0–23 | `boolean` | `false` |

When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

# TimeRange

A pair of time endpoints with explicit confirmation.

```ts
import type { TimeRangeProps, TimeRangeInstance } from "@cedar-design/ui-vue";
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes null unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Example source: src/time-range/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
  <c-time-range v-model="range" style="width: 252px" clearable />
</template>

const range = ref()
</script>
```

### Default State

- `format`: Controls the displayed format.

Example source: src/time-range/__demos__/default-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref(["09:00", "10:00"]);
const open = ref(false);
const acceptValue = ref(true);
const acceptOpen = ref(true);
const acceptClose = ref(true);
const commits = ref(0);
const proposal = ref();
const openProposal = ref();
const updateValue = (next) => {
  proposal.value = next;
  if (acceptValue.value) {
    value.value = next;
  }
};
const updateOpen = (next) => {
  openProposal.value = next;
  if (acceptOpen.value && (next || acceptClose.value)) {
    open.value = next;
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="12px" style="width: 100%">
    <p>非受控初始值，无需绑定 v-model</p>
    <c-time-range
      :default-value="['09:00', '10:00']"
      format="HH:mm"
      clearable
    />
    <p>受控值与展开状态</p>
    <c-checkbox v-model="acceptValue"> 接受值更新</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="acceptOpen"> 接受展开更新</c-checkbox>
    <c-time-range
      :model-value="value"
      :open="open"
      format="HH:mm"
      clearable
      @update:model-value="updateValue"
      @update:open="updateOpen"
      @change="commits++"
    />
    <span>{{ value }} / {{ open }}</span>
    <c-checkbox v-model="acceptClose"> 接受关闭请求</c-checkbox>
    <output aria-label="Commit count">{{ commits }}</output>
    <output aria-label="Controlled proposals">{{
      JSON.stringify({ value: proposal, open: openProposal })
    }}</output>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Selection Events

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.
- `format`: Controls the displayed format.

Example source: src/time-range/__demos__/selection-events.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { formatDemoTime } from "../../__demos__/locale";
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref(["09:00", "18:00"]);
const immediate = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const events = ref([]);
function record(name, value, dates) {
  const times = Array.isArray(dates)
    ? dates.map((date) => (date == null ? undefined : formatDemoTime(date)))
    : dates == null
      ? undefined
      : formatDemoTime(dates);
  events.value = [
    JSON.stringify({ event: name, value: value ?? null, time: times ?? null }),
    ...events.value,
  ].slice(0, 5);
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="12px" style="width: 100%">
    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly"> 只读：可聚焦，不可修改</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="disabled"> 禁用：释放焦点，不可修改</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="immediate"> 选择后立即提交</c-checkbox>
    <p>select 记录草稿，change 记录提交；取消不改模型，清除返回 undefined。</p>
    <c-time-range
      v-model="value"
      :disable-confirm="immediate"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :disabled="disabled"
      format="HH:mm"
      clearable
      @select="(value, dates) => record('select', value, dates)"
      @change="(value, dates) => record('change', value, dates)"
      @clear="record('clear')"
      @click="record('click')"
      @open-change="(open) => record('open-change', open)"
      @focus="record('focus')"
      @blur="record('blur')"
    />
    <span>模型: {{ value === undefined ? "undefined" : value }}</span>
    <c-button variant="outline" @click="value = ['15:30', '18:00']"
      >从外部替换模型</c-button
    >
    <small>外部替换会更新反显，不触发 select 或 change。</small>
    <div
      v-for="(event, index) in events"
      :key="index"
      style="overflow-wrap: anywhere"
    >
      {{ event }}
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>
```
